revision.text:
{{External|rs|rsc=Crandor and Karamja dungeon}} {{Confuse|Brimhaven Dungeon}} {{Infobox Location |name = Crandor and Karamja Dungeon<!--referenced as such in kb: https://web.archive.org/web/20071031074928/http://www.runescape.com/kbase/viewarticle.ws?article_id=2654--> |image = [[File:Crandor and Karamja Dungeon.png|300px]] |release = [[11 June]] [[2001]] |update = The island of Karamja is open |members = No |location = [[Karamja]] |music = [[Dangerous Road]], [[Attack 2]] |map = {{Map|mtype=focusarea|2820,9664|2914,9664|2914,9536|2820,9536|2820,9664|mapID=-1|zoom=1|y=9600|x=2867}} |type = dungeon |leagueRegion = Karamja }} The '''Karamja Dungeon''' is located underneath the [[Karamja Volcano]], and the '''Crandor Dungeon''' is located underneath [[Crandor]]. Both dungeons are connected to each other. In order for a player to gain full access to the Crandor dungeon, they must have completed or be about to engage in the final fight in the quest [[Dragon Slayer I]]. No part of the dungeons are [[multicombat]] zones.
==Transportation== The Karamja entrance to the dungeon can be accessed by travelling to [[Musa Point]] or [[Brimhaven]] via ship, then walking west or east, respectively, to the [[Karamja Volcano]]. The eastern lip of the volcano has rocks that can be climbed down.
The dungeon can also be accessed by using the [[Minigame Teleport]] to [[TzHaar Fight Pit]], travelling east through [[Mor Ul Rek]], then exiting via the cave to the north.
The Crandor side of the dungeon must first be unlocked during [[Dragon Slayer I]]. After that, it can be accessed by passing the hidden door at the north end of the Karamja side of the dungeon. The door becomes usable after crash-landing on Crandor.
==Notable features== [[File:Crandor_and_Karamja_Dungeon_map.png|thumb|right|275px|A labelled map of the dungeon.]] *There is a [[Wall (Crandor and Karamja Dungeon)|wall]] in the Crandor Dungeon, and when pushed, it will take the player to Karamja Dungeon, but only if the player has sailed to [[Crandor]] for [[Dragon Slayer I]]. That is how both dungeons are connected. *A dragon named [[Elvarg]] lives under Crandor. In order to complete Dragon Slayer I, the player must slay her. Elvarg can only be defeated once in the quest, you do not have to fight her again if you repeat the quest. *There is an entrance to the city of [[Mor Ul Rek]], which only members have access to. You go into the Karamja Dungeon main entrance and go into the big opening near the [[rope]]. *There are [[skeleton]]s, [[giant bat]]s, [[deadly red spider]]s, and [[lesser demon]]s under the volcano. So it is recommended that a player brings food if they are intending to enter. *There are 4 [[gold]] rocks in the [[Karamja Volcano mine]], but they are guarded by aggressive level 22 skeletons. *There are also [[red spiders' eggs]] respawns. *It is also quite close to the Karamja docks making the docks a useful place to fish for food to go in with. *An unreachable tunnel filled with lava stretching to the east is visible to the south-east of the dungeon, featuring three unattackable [[fire giant]]s. These fire giants are intended to reference [[Branda the Fire Queen]]'s lair being nearby.
==Monsters== *[[Elvarg]] (level 83) (aggressive) *[[Skeleton]]s (level 22, 25, and 45) (aggressive to players below twice their level) *[[Giant bat]]s (level 27) (aggressive to players below twice their level) *[[Lesser demon|Lesser demons]] (level 82) *[[Deadly red spider]]s (level 34) (aggressive to players below twice their level) *[[Fire giant|Fire giants]] (level 86) (unreachable)
==Quests== *[[Dragon Slayer I]]'s final battle is located on Crandor. *The start of [[Dragon Slayer II]] revisits [[Elvarg]]'s lair.
== Treasure Trails == * Digging directly underneath the [[red spiders' eggs]] respawn is the solution to a hard [[cryptic clue]]: ''Mine was the strangest birth under the sun. I left the crimson sack, yet life had not begun. Entered the world, and yet was seen by none.''
{{Crandor and Karamja Dungeon}} {{Dragon Slayer I}} {{Dungeons}} [[Category:Karamja]]

{{External|rs|rsc=Map (Dragon slayer)}} {{Infobox Item |name = Crandor map |image = [[File:Crandor map.png]] |release = [[23 September]] [[2001]] |update = Dragon quest online! |members = No |quest = [[Dragon Slayer I]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Study, Drop |examine = A map of the route to Crandor. |value = 1 |weight = 0.015 |id = 1538 }} [[File:Crandor map detail.png|left|120px]] The '''Crandor map''' is a [[quest items|quest item]] used only in [[Dragon Slayer I]]. It is made by using any two pieces on each other when all three map parts are in the inventory. It is given to [[Ned]] so he can sail the player to [[Crandor]]. [[File:Dragon Slayer - Crandor map.png|thumb|none|400px|Crandor map with all three pieces.]] ==Map pieces== {{Main|Dragon Slayer I}} {|class=wikitable !colspan=2 | Map part || Location |- | {{plinkt|Map part (Melzar)}} || Inside a [[Chest (Melzar's Maze)|chest]] in [[Melzar's Maze]] |- | {{plinkt|Map part (Thalzar)}} || Inside a [[Chest (Dwarven Mine)|chest]] sealed behind a [[magic door (Thalzar's room)|magic door]] in the [[Dwarven Mines]] |- | {{plinkt|Map part (Lozar)}} || Held by [[Wormbrain]] in the [[Port Sarim jail]] |} ==Obtaining a second map== To obtain extra map for memorial, one should do the following: *Prepare two sets of [[Telekinetic Grab]] runes (2 [[Law rune|laws]] and 2 [[Air rune|airs]], also requires level 33 [[Magic]]) to obtain two maps from [[Wormbrain]]. Players should kill Wormbrain once and get hold of the map for several minutes, until they can attack him again (hopping worlds resets the timer), but firstly drop their piece and grab the second, or he will not be attackable. *Players don't need double items for obtaining other double map parts, just drop the first and grab the second, and then pick the first one as well. *Combining the map is an important part. '''Never''' place a map in a [[bank]] when combining another map. Instead, once all the six pieces are in the inventory, drop three of them and combine the others. Then, pick up the three pieces and drop the map. Combine and pick up the combined map. *Before giving one of the maps to Ned, it isn't safe yet. Just drop a map and bring another to Ned. Then, pick up the dropped one and '''don't''' talk to Ned again. Bank the map or keep it in the inventory (be careful not to die with the map) and climb aboard the ''[[Lady Lumbridge]]'', talk to Ned on the ship, and go fight [[Elvarg]]. ==Creation== {{Recipe |notes = {{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Dragon Slayer I]] |members = No |ticks = 1 |mat1 = Map part (Melzar) |mat1cost = No |mat2 = Map part (Thalzar) |mat2cost = No |mat3 = Map part (Lozar) |mat3cost = No |output1 = Crandor map |output1cost = No }} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 18 June 2007 |update = The Dragonfire Shield |change = The item was graphically updated with the rework of [[Dragon Slayer I]]. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 11 – 18 April 2005 |change = The item's examine was changed from "''A map to Crandor.''" to "''A map of the route to Crandor.''" }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Crandor map detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Crandor map detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Crandor map (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Crandor map.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 –
18 June 2007 |18 June 2007 –
present |} {{Dragon Slayer I}}

{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Location |name = Crash Island |image = [[File:Crash Island.png]] |release = [[6 December]] [[2004]] |update = Monkey Madness |members = Yes |location = [[Ardent Ocean]] |race = [[Gnome]]s, [[Snake]]s, [[Scorpion]]s |teleport = [[Grand Tree]] Transportation by [[Waydar]] and [[Lumdo]] from [[Ape Atoll]] |map = {{Map|name=Crash Island|x=2914|y=2720|height=300|width=300|zoom=2}} |type = island |leagueRegion = Kandarin }} '''Crash Island''' is a small island to the east of [[Ape Atoll]]. Players gain access to it during [[Monkey Madness I]]. There is also a [[Crash Island Dungeon|dungeon]] underneath the island, which is used for the sub-quest [[Freeing King Awowogei]] in [[Recipe for Disaster]].
Before completing [[Monkey Madness II]], all attackable NPCs on this island, with the exception of birds, are [[aggressive]] and [[poison]]ous. As such, it is an unpopular place to train. After completion of Monkey Madness II, the NPCs lose their aggression toward players.
==Transportation== *[[Waydar]] from the [[Grand Tree]] in [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]]: **Talk to [[Daero]], the tree guardian, on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the Grand Tree, near [[Blurberry]]'s bar. He will blindfold you and take you to an underground hangar. **Talk to [[Waydar]], who will fly you to Crash Island. *[[Lumdo]] via [[Ape Atoll]] ([[Ape Atoll Teleport (standard)|Ape Atoll Teleport]] in the [[standard spellbook]] or [[Ape Atoll Teleport (Arceuus)|Ape Atoll Teleport]] in the [[Arceuus spellbook]])
Lumdo and Waydar remain on the island, and can transport the player to Ape Atoll and Tree Gnome Stronghold, respectively.
==Notable features== *[[Crash Island Dungeon]] - located at the centre of the island, containing poisonous level 84 [[Big Snake]]s. *The Big Snakes have extremely high attack, and can consistently hit through high levelled armour such as [[Barrows armour|Barrows]], [[dragon armour|dragon]], etc. *There is a [[coordinate clue]] spot on the east side of this island.
==Quests== *[[Recipe for Disaster]] *[[Monkey Madness I]] *[[Monkey Madness II]]
==Monsters== *[[Bird]] (level 11) *[[Snake (Ape Atoll)|Snake]] (level 24) - not visible on [[minimap]] *[[Scorpion]] (level 38) - not visible on [[minimap]]
==Personalities== *[[Lumdo]] *[[Waydar]]
{{Monkey Madness I}}

revision.text:
{{Infobox Location |name = Crash Site Cavern |image = [[File:Crash Site Cavern.png|300px]] |release = [[6 May]] [[2016]] |update = Monkey Madness II |members = Yes |floors = 1 |location = [[Gnome Empire]] |race = [[Demons]] |music = {{plainlist| * [[Monkey Badness]] * [[Monkey Business]]}} |map = [[File:Crash Site Cavern map.png|300px]] |type = dungeon |leagueRegion = Kandarin }} The '''Crash Site Cavern''' is a cave located a very short distance north of the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]]. It is visited during [[Monkey Madness II]], where the final battle is fought. It remains accessible after completing the quest, after talking to Steve, where it is inhabited by [[tortured gorilla|tortured]] and [[demonic gorilla]]s, which drop the components used to create the [[light ballista|light]] and [[heavy ballista]], as well as [[zenyte shard]]s used to create [[zenyte jewellery]].
Outside the cavern are the remains of [[Glough]]'s airship along with [[Assistant Le Smith]]'s remains. A [[crate (Crash Site)|crate]] near the cavern entrance can be searched to obtain a [[Monkey (Monkey Madness II)|monkey]], which is worn in the cape slot. The monkey will return to this crate if lost in any way.
Upon entering the cavern entrance, two messages will appear in the chat box stating {{Mes|You enter the cavern beneath the crash site.}} and {{Mes|Why would you want to go in there?}}.
The caverns consist of both single and multi-way combat zones, with the singles zone being just ahead of the archway near the two demonic gorillas in the single-way area. A path near the exit rope in the caves leads to a large area filled with demonic gorillas in single-way combat. Past this archway, the entire area is exclusively multi-way. Gorillas killed in the multi-way zones will broadcast their drop within the nearby vicinity.
==Transportation== The entrance to the Crash Site Cavern may be found north-west of the [[Grand Tree]] through the opening in the fence. Once through the fence run north-east to enter the cavern.
There are a few ways to get to the Grand Tree from which you can run to the cavern.
* Use the [[royal seed pod]]'s teleport option which takes you to the base of the Grand Tree. This is the fastest travel option. * Use a [[Spirit tree]] to the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold|Gnome stronghold]] and run north and then north-west to the gap in the fence. * Use the [[Gnome glider]] to '''Ta Quir Priw''' which will take you to the top of the Grand Tree. Descend the tree and run north-west to the gap in the fence.
{| |{{Map|align=left|caption=The Opening players can Pass-through which leads to the entrance of the Crash Site Cavern|mtype=square|r=3|name=Crash Site Cavern|x=2436|y=3520}} |[[File:Crash Site Cavern entrance.png|none|thumb|300px|The entrance to the Crash Site Cavern. The crate in front of the player can be searched to receive an equipable [[Monkey (Monkey Madness II)|monkey]].]] |}
==Trivia== *When entering the area outside the entrance to the caves, the player is put into an [[instance]]d zone regardless if the quest is completed or not. Prior to completing the quest, this area is filled with aggressive tortured gorillas, who no longer appear once the quest is completed. *At the entrance to the caves, there are three skeletal remains that appear to be that of demonic gorillas, although this contradicts their [[Malicious ashes|ash]] remains when the player kills them. Likewise, [[Assistant Le Smith]]'s skeletal remains resemble more of an unknown humanoid rather than that of a gnome.
{{Monkey Madness II}} {{Dungeons}} [[Category:Quest locations]] [[Category:Kandarin]]

{{External|rs|rsc}} {{otheruses|the scenery object found scattered around Gielinor|other uses|Crate (disambiguation)}} [[File:Crates.png|right|166x166px]] '''Crates''' can be found in many buildings across [[Gielinor]]. Crates serve almost no purpose, apart from being used during some [[Treasure Trails]]. Clues for Treasure Trails are often hidden inside of them. For example, a clue might say something such as "Search the crate in a house in Varrock." Crates are also used in a few [[quests]].
Strangely, crates cannot be shot over using [[ranged]] or [[magic]].
Crates have a "search" or "loot" option. Formerly, when searched, crates would give random items, such as [[damaged armour]], [[broken arrow]]s, [[broken staff]]s, [[broken glass]], [[leather boots]], [[leather gloves]], and small amounts of [[coins]]. Now searching crates does not have a purpose.
Crates can be found in nearly every city, town, or village. Some areas with a particularly large number of crates include: *[[Varrock]] *[[Falador]] *[[Keldagrim]] *[[Nardah]]
==Trivia== *In the [[Black Knights' Fortress (location)|Black Knight's Fortress]], there are crates with an unimplemented "loot" option. When the player attempts to loot the crate, the game gives the message "Nothing interesting happens." This is a catch-all message for interactions that haven't been programmed into the game. *If a player is in [[Karamja]], they can pack [[banana]]s into a crate next to [[Luthas]]'s house. This is the only crate a player may pack things into. *At the [[Wintertodt]], examining some of the crates gives the text "No bananas in this one.", likely referring to the crate mentioned above. *In [[Death to the Dorgeshuun]], the player must pick up the crate [[Zanik]] was hiding in. A player could walk around holding the [[Crate with zanik]], creating an awkward walking posture *In [[Gertrude's Cat]] you need to find a [[kitten]] in a crate in Varrock [[lumberyard]]. *In the [[witch's house (location)|witch's house]] in [[Taverley]], a player can search a crate in her cellar and find [[cabbage]]s, [[needle]]s, [[leather]] items, [[thread]], etc. *The player can be teleported to a crate in the Ardougne [[Gielinor Parcel Delivery Team|GPDT depot]] by talking to [[Wizard Cromperty]] before partial completion of [[Tribal Totem]]. This crate does not have a search option. Investigating gives the text "There is a label on this crate. It says; Senior Patents Clerk, Chamber of Invention, The Wizards' Tower, Misthalin. This crate is securely fastened shut and ready for delivery." *In the [[Abandoned Mine]] of [[Morytania]] there exist "crates" with a lower case 'c'. These can be found floating in the swamped area around the lift on Level 5. *In the [[Goblin Cave]] south of the [[Fishing Guild]] there are crates which, when searched, may spawn an aggressive [[rat]], [[chicken]], or [[spider]]. *On the [[Seers' Village]] [[Seers' Village Rooftop Course|rooftop agility course]] there is a crate that, when examined, gives the text "It's not doing anything wrong... Stop bullying it!" When a player searches this crate, the game gives the message "You search the crate.... ...and find plenty of valuables, but decide to leave it alone; they're not yours." *In the [[Goblin Village]] there are three crates that contain [[Goblin mail]]. Only one Goblin mail can be obtained from each crate; searching them afterwards will give the message, "You search the crate, but find nothing of interest." [[Category:Interactive scenery]]

{{Gone}} {{Infobox Scenery |name = Crate |image = [[File:Crate (Shop of Distaste).png|250x250px]] |release = [[29 March]] [[2004]] |update = RS2 Launched! |removal = [[6 July]] [[2022]] |removalupdate = PvP Arena: Soft Launch |members = Yes |location = [[Duel Arena]] |options = Buy |examine = Smells pretty bad! |map = No |id = 3195 }} The '''crate''' could previously be found at the [[Duel Arena]] bank. It was filled with [[Rotten tomato|rotten tomatoes]] which players could purchase. Clicking on the crate would give the player access to the [[Shop of Distaste]].
With the release of the [[Emir's Arena]] in July 2022, the crate was removed, and replaced by a different [[Crate (Pelters' Veg Stall)|crate]] which gives access to [[Pelters' Veg Stall]] instead. Since [[Fadli]] still runs the Shop of Distaste, this is presumably an oversight.

{{Infobox Scenery |name = Crate |image = [[File:Crate (Spare controls).png|250x250px]] |release = [[6 December]] [[2004]] |update = Monkey Madness |members = Yes |quest = [[Monkey Madness I]] |location = [[Underground Military Glider Hangar]] |options = Search |examine = This crate is marked 'Deliver to Glough'... |map = {{Map|name=Crate (Spare controls)|x=2396|y=9884|plane=0|mapID=-1|mtype=pin}} |id = 4746 }} A '''crate''' containing [[spare controls]] can be found within the [[Underground Military Glider Hangar]] during the [[Monkey Madness I]] [[quest]]. During the quest, players can search the crate to obtain the controls to use a reference for the picture sliding puzzle on the [[Reinitialisation Panel]]. After the completion of the quest, the crate changes and is no longer searchable for the spare controls.
{{Monkey Madness I}}

It is filled with [[wooden cat]]s before telling [[Dr Fenkenstrain]] to get into the box to go to [[Mos Le'Harmless]]. It can be built with 30 [[Construction]], 6 [[crate part]]s, [[nails]], and a [[hammer]]. Once built, there will be a false bottom that can be built using 4 [[plank]]s, nails, and a hammer. Players who attempt to build the crate with fewer than the required nails will result in the crate reverting to its original state, losing the progress the player has made during the build.
{{The Great Brain Robbery}}

{{external|rs}} {{Infobox NPC |name = Crate goblin |image = [[File:Crate goblin.png|160px]] |release = [[20 March]] [[2007]] |update = Dorgesh-Kaan |members = Yes |race = [[Dorgeshuun]] |location = [[Dorgesh-Kaan]] |gender = Male |options = Talk-to |examine = Taking a terribly important box from one place to another. |map = {{Map|x = 2733|y = 5274|plane=0|r=4|mapID=-1|mtype=square}} |id = 2300 |leagueRegion = Misthalin }} [[File:Crate goblin chathead.png|left]] The '''crate goblin''' is a [[Dorgeshuun]] [[cave goblin]] that lives in the Dorgeshuun capital of [[Dorgesh-Kaan]]. He can be found wandering many parts of the city, such as the city's marketplace, homes, and shops. About every 2–4 minutes, he arrives at the marketplace to deliver goods.
The crate goblin delivers boxes to many different areas of the city, and can be hard to find at times. He often changes levels and enters little-known side corridors. The crate goblin will only stop when you talk to him, and will not continue to move until the player is 2-5 steps away.
==Dialogue== {{Hastranscript|npc}}
{{Dorgesh-Kaan}} [[Category:Dorgeshuun]]

It can be found by talking to the [[Shop keeper]] in the [[Al Kharid General Store]]. The crate of baskets is requested by the [[Travelling merchant]] and can be exchanged with him for [[dried cocoa]]. The dried cocoa is then given to the [[Easter Bunny]] to progress in the event.
{{2019 Easter event}}

revision.text:
{{Dangerous}} {{External|rs}} [[File:Homunculus in dungeon.png|300px|right|thumb|The Homunculus in the Tower of Life dungeon.]] '''Creature Creation''' is a solo activity that involves creating unique hybrid monsters and killing them for their drops. It can be found in the [[Tower of Life (building)|Tower of Life]] dungeon after completing the [[Tower of Life]] quest. A [[trapdoor (Tower of Life)|trapdoor]] on the ground floor of the tower leads to the dungeon. The [[Builder's costume]] is not required to enter the tower once the quest has been completed. Some of the monsters drop multiples of items that are otherwise hard to get or expensive to purchase, such as [[Unicorn horn]]s, which are used to make [[Unicorn horn dust]] for [[Herblore]]. Players who have completed the medium tier of the [[Ardougne diary]] will receive these drops in [[Bank note|noted]] form. Some of the monsters are dangerous, so bringing food may be advised. Players needing food while creating creatures can pickpocket the workers outside the tower to obtain [[triangle sandwich]]es. [['Black-eye']], [['Gummy']], [['The Guns']], and [['No fingers']] can be pickpocketed, but not [[Bonafido]]. A [[Dwarf multicannon]] can be used here. ==Altars of Life== [[File:Symbol of life.png|thumb|200px|left|An Altar of Life.]] There are six Altars of Life, each dedicated to a different hybrid monster. Placing one each of two ingredients at the correct altar primes the altar. '''Noted items cannot be used as ingredients.''' The primed altar must be activated to create the mixed creature. All but one of the monsters in turn drop one of their ingredients, which makes continuous creation easier; however, after completion of the easy and medium [[Ardougne Diary|Ardougne Diaries]], these drops will be noted. The monsters occasionally also drop various types of [[satchel]]s (the colour depends on the creature) and [[tea flask]]s. The satchels are held in the shield slot and can hold one [[triangle sandwich]], one [[cake]], and one [[banana]]. The tea flasks can hold the contents of up to five [[Cup of tea|cups of tea]]. [[File:Creature Creation dungeon map.png|right|thumb|A map of the Tower of Life dungeon]] Players use several items to create the monsters: *[[Eye of newt]]. These are purchasable for 3 coins each at [[Herblore]] shops or the [[Port Sarim]] [[Magic shops|magic shop]], either individually or in packs of 100. *[[Feathers]]. These can be obtained by killing [[chicken]]s, which can be found on many farms throughout [[Gielinor]] or purchased at any [[Fishing shops|Fishing Shop]] for 2 coins each individually or in packs of 100. *[[Raw jubbly]]. These can be obtained by hunting [[Jubbly]] birds. The ability to hunt them requires the completion of a considerable amount of the [[Recipe for Disaster]] quest. *[[Raw lobster]]. Lobsters can be caught using the [[Fishing]] skill. *[[Raw sardine]]. Sardines can be caught using the Fishing skill. Some fishing shops sell sardines (You can buy these in Rellekka and quickly deposit them at [[Peer the Seer]] with completion of the [[Fremennik Diary#Easy|Fremennik Easy Diary]]). *[[Red spiders' eggs]]. These can be gathered in places inhabited by [[deadly red spider]]s. The spider chamber in the wilderness section of the [[Edgeville Dungeon]] has several egg spawns. *[[Raw swordfish]]. Swordfish can be caught using the Fishing skill. *[[Raw chicken]]. These can be obtained by killing chickens. *[[Giant frog legs]]. Theses are dropped by [[Giant frog]]s, which inhabit the [[Lumbridge Swamp Caves]]. *[[Raw cave eel]]. [[Cave eel]]s inhabit the Lumbridge Swamp Caves and can be caught using the [[Fishing]] skill. *[[Unicorn horn]]. [[Unicorn]]s can be slain for their horns. Unicorns can be found near [[Varrock]], [[Edgeville]], and [[Rellekka]] in small numbers. Larger herds of [[black unicorn]]s can be found in the [[Wilderness]], but beware of [[Player killing|player killers]]. *[[Cowhide]]. [[Cow]]s can be killed for their hides and are found at many farms. {|class="wikitable" !Altar !colspan=2|Creature (level) !Ingredients !Always DropsAll creatures also drop [[bones]]. !May DropAll creatures may also drop a [[tea flask]]. !Average ProfitAssuming non-dropped ingredients are bought from the Grand Exchange. |- |North-east |[[File:Newtroost.png|center|100px]] |[[Newtroost]] (19) |1 {{plink|Eye of newt}}
1 {{plink|Feather}} |4-10 {{plink|Eye of newt}}Noted after completion of the [[Medium Ardougne Diary]]. |{{plink|Rune satchel}} |{{Coins|{{Average drop value|mob=Newtroost|raw=y}}-{{GEP|Feather}}}} |- |North-west |[[File:Unicow.png|center|100px]] |[[Unicow]] (25) |1 {{plink|Cowhide}}
1 {{plink|Unicorn horn}} |2-4 {{plink|Unicorn horn}}s |{{plink|Green satchel}} |{{Coins|{{Average drop value|mob=Unicow|raw=y}}-{{GEP|Cowhide}}}} |- |South-east |[[File:Spidine.png|center|100px]] |[[Spidine]] (42) |1 {{plink|Red spiders' eggs}}
1 {{plink|Raw sardine}} |3-6 {{plink|Red spiders' eggs}} |{{plink|Red satchel}} |{{Coins|{{Average drop value|mob=Spidine|raw=y}}-{{GEP|Raw sardine}}}} |- |South-west |[[File:Swordchick.png|center|100px]] |[[Swordchick]] (46) |1 {{plink|Raw swordfish}}
1 {{plink|Raw chicken}} |10-40 {{plink|Feather}}s |{{plink|Black satchel}} |{{Coins|{{Average drop value|mob=Swordchick|raw=y}}-{{GEP|Raw swordfish}}-{{GEP|Raw chicken}}}} |- |East |[[File:Jubster.png|center|100px]] |[[Jubster]] (87) |1 {{plink|Raw jubbly}}
1 {{plink|Raw lobster}} |3-7 {{plink|Raw jubbly}}Noted after completion of the [[Easy Ardougne Diary]]. |{{plink|Gold satchel}} |{{Coins|{{Average drop value|mob=Jubster|raw=y}}-{{GEP|Raw lobster}}}} |- |West |[[File:Frogeel.png|center|100px]] |[[Frogeel]] (103) |1 {{plink|Raw cave eel}}
1 {{plink|Giant frog legs}} |5-10 {{plink|Raw cave eel}}s |{{plink|Plain satchel}} |{{Coins|{{Average drop value|mob=Frogeel|raw=y}}-{{GEP|Giant frog legs}}}} |} {{Reflist}} ==Tips== *For fast banking, players may wish to use the bank at [[Shayzien Encampment]] (Fairy ring code {{fairycode|DJR}}) with partial completion of the [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen]] quest, or walk from the [[Ardougne Teleport]] location. *For players who have not completed the Easy Ardougne Diary, when killing the creatures to get the 'ingredient drops', bring one of the ingredient that is always dropped and several of the other ingredient. This allows the altar to be used multiple times in one trip. For efficiency, the goal is to fill inventory as much as practical with the desired item. Use trial and error to determine how many of the always-consumed ingredient to bring. (This method does not work with swordchicks, since they do not drop raw chickens.) *For more efficiency and convenience, before leaving the dungeon, prime the altar with both ingredients without activating the altar. The items will still be present when the player returns, allowing the altar to be activated, no matter how long a time the player is away. This method is particularly recommended for forgetful players who might forget to take the 'single' item (for example, the player brought a load of cow hides but not one unicorn horn). *The spidine, which requires red spider eggs and raw sardines, is useful as it drops red spider eggs in larger numbers (3-5). Use [[Ishmael's Fish He Sells]] in the [[Ruins of Unkah]] to stock up on raw sardines. One raw sardine will yield about 3.5 red spider's eggs on average. It takes around 8 raw sardines to collect a full load of red spider eggs. *The unicow is perhaps the fastest method in the game to obtain unicorn horns in quantity without spending money. Kill some cows close to a bank and bank the cow hides (or buy cowhides). There is a cow pen just north of the Ardougne market outside the city walls. Each cowhide creates one unicow, which drops 2 to 4 unicorn horns. However, you will need one of the horns to make the next unicow, so bring lots of cow hides to get a full inventory of unicorn horns. It typically takes 10-13 cow hides to get a full inventory of unicorn horns. *The different levels of the Ardougne Diary cause some of the drops from the creatures to be noted. This may mean that you are unable to re-use drops to summon the creatures again. However, the Ardougne south [[bank]] is not too far away. *It is possible to find ranged/magic [[safespot]]s, although it may be impractical to do so most of the time. ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 11 October 2022 |update = Quest Speedrunning Launch |change = Spam-clicking the altars no longer accidentally consumes a player's ingredients. }} {{Subject changes |date = 5 October 2022 |update = Clan Hall Upgrades & More |change = The altars have had their dialogue boxes streamlined to reduce the clicking required to use them. }} {{Subject changes |date = 5 March 2015 |update = Achievement Diaries |poll = Old School Achievement Diary Rewards Poll |change = Drops from creatures become noted depending on the tier of [[Ardougne diary]] completed; the items that will be noted increases from easy to hard diaries. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== *A {{Wp|Homunculus}} was a mythological creature said to be created by using {{Wp|alchemy|Alchemy}} to combine parts of different animals to create a {{Wp|hybrid}}. They were said to be human-like in manner and appearance but lacked a soul. {{Creature Creation}} {{Tower of Life}} {{Minigames}} {{Dungeons}} [[Category:Quest locations]]

{{External|rs}} {{Otheruses|the quest|the actual creature|Lord Rologarth}} {{Has quick guide}} {{Infobox Quest |name = Creature of Fenkenstrain |number = 69 |image = [[File:Creature of Fenkenstrain.png|300px]] |release = [[31 January]] [[2005]] |update = Creature of Fenkenstrain |members = Yes |series = None |developer = Martin B }} '''Creature of Fenkenstrain''' is a quest where you become the assistant of [[Dr Fenkenstrain]] and slowly uncover the history of his castle: the [[Lordship of the North Coast]].
==Details== {{Quest details |start = Read the [[signpost (Creature of Fenkenstrain)|signpost]] in the middle of [[Canifis]]. |startmap = 3488,3485 |difficulty = Intermediate |description = [[Dr Fenkenstrain]], master and sole occupant of the castle to the north-east of [[Canifis]], needs a new servant to go on a dark errand for him.
Do you have the stomach to help Fenkenstrain complete his twisted purpose? |length = Medium |requirements = * Completion of [[Priest in Peril]] * Partial completion of [[The Restless Ghost]] * {{SCP|Crafting|20|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} {{Questreqstart|no}} * {{SCP|Thieving|25|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} {{Questreqstart|no}} * Able to defeat a level 51 monster and run past level 72 monsters |items = * [[Ghostspeak amulet]] * [[Silver bar]] * 3 [[bronze wire]] (unnoted) * [[Needle]] ([[costume needle]] does not work) * 5 [[thread]] * [[Spade]] * 50 [[coins]] '''OR''' 1 [[law rune|law]] & 1 [[air rune]] for [[Telekinetic Grab]] (requires {{SCP|Magic|33|link=yes}}) |recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|30|link=yes}} *Combat equipment to defeat a level 51 [[Experiment]] * [[Food]] and [[Holy symbol]] (protection against [[Feral Vampyre]]s) for low combat levels *[[Weight-reducing clothing]] and [[Stamina potion|stamina]] or [[energy potion]]s *Fast travel to several locations **[[Canifis]] to start the quest - [[Salve Graveyard Teleport]] or [[Kharyrll Teleport]] or [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|cks}} **[[Fenkenstrain's Castle]] (2 trips) - [[Fenkenstrain's Castle Teleport]] *Quick access to a furnace: **[[Ectophial]] or 2 [[ecto-token]]s for access to the [[Port Phasmatys]] furnace **[[Amulet of glory]] to [[Edgeville]] |kills = * [[Experiment]] ''(level 51)'' - can be safespotted or flinched |ironman = * {{SCP|Smithing|4|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} (to make a [[bronze wire]]) |leagueRegion = <poem> Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Desert}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Morytania}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest </poem> }}
==Walkthrough== {{Map|3549,3551|align=right|mtype=square|width=200|height=200|zoom=1|caption=The start point.}}
:'''Note:''' If you are only interested in unlocking access to the [[Experiment Cave]], you do not need any of the required items - follow the Gravedigging section to obtain the star amulet, then skip digging at the grave and go straight to the memorial to enter the cave.
===Job interview=== [[File:Dr Fenkenstrain chathead.png|left|frameless]] To start the quest, read the [[signpost (Creature of Fenkenstrain)|signpost]] located in [[Canifis]] - it is advertising a job vacancy for a 'Braindead Butler'. If the signpost says you do not meet the requirements, speak to Dr Fenkenstrain directly and he will still offer you the job, allowing you to start the quest.
Pick up the [[pickled brain]] from the table in the pub to the south, and [[Roavar]] the innkeeper will offer to sell it to you for 50 coins. Alternatively, use [[Telekinetic Grab]] to avoid paying.
Follow the path to the north east to [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]], and talk to [[Dr Fenkenstrain]] located just inside. As part of the job interview, he will ask you to describe yourself in one word; answer "braindead", then tell him that your best skill is "grave-digging". He will ask you to find some "dead stuff" - he is planning to stitch together a body and bring it to life.
The body parts you need to find are the [[pickled brain]] you already picked up, a [[decapitated head]], [[Torso (Creature of Fenkenstrain)|torso]], [[arms]] and [[legs]]; you can retrieve these in any order.
===Gravedigging=== {{Needed|A [[spade]]|recommended=[[Armour]], [[food]], and a [[holy symbol]] is recommended for protection against [[Feral Vampyre]]s and [[leech]]es.}} {{Map|3608,3491|align=right|mtype=square|width=200|height=200|r=2|caption=[[Gardener Ghost]]'s grave location.}} [[File:Star amulet detail.png|left|70px|frameless]] Upstairs in [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]], there are bookcases in both the west and the east rooms. Search the west bookcase for "The Joy of Grave Digging" and you will find a [[marble amulet]]. Search the east bookcase for "Handy Maggot Avoidance Techniques" and you will find an [[obsidian amulet]]. Use them on each other to get a [[star amulet]].
Head to the [[grave (Haunted Woods)|grave]] located slightly south-east of [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|ALQ}} (see map). Using "Read" on the grave will confirm the grave as Ed Lestwit's. Right click to dig the grave, and you will receive a [[decapitated head]]. '''Use the [[pickled brain]] on it'''. {{Map|3578,3527|align=right|mtype=square|width=200|height=200|r=4|caption=The location of the memorial.}}
Just east of [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]] and west of the Farming patches, there are some tombstones. Use the [[star amulet]] on the furthest [[memorial (Experiment cave)|memorial]] to the east with the indent on it and push it to enter a dungeon that contains unaggressive level 25 and 51 [[Experiment]]s.
[[File:Experiment safespot.png|thumb|left|200px|Experiment safespot.]] Kill a level 51 wolf-woman [[Experiment]] to get a [[cavern key]]. An experiment in a crevice to the south west may be [[safespotted]] with ranged or magic, or [[flinched]] with melee by attacking from the crevice entrance.
:'''Note''': If you have started [[Rag and Bone Man II]], you may wish to kill the level 25 experiments here until you receive an [[Experiment bone]].
Once you have the cavern key go through the north-west passage until you reach a gate. Go up the ladder, then dig at the three [[grave (Creature of Fenkenstrain)|grave]]s to the north and you get [[legs]], [[arms]], and a [[torso]]. {{Clear|left}}
===Lightning=== {{Needed|[[Ghostspeak amulet]], [[decapitated head]], [[pickled brain]], [[arms]], [[legs]], [[torso]], [[needle]], 5 [[thread]], 3 [[bronze wire]], and a [[silver bar]].|skills={{SCP|Crafting|20}} {{Boostable|yes}} to create an [[extended brush]]}} [[File:Creature of Fenkenstrain - The Body.png|thumb|200px|The body after all that trouble.]] [[File:Creature of Fenkenstrain - repairing conductor.gif|thumb|left|160px|The conductor is repaired.]] Push the memorial you came out of, and retrace your steps through the cavern. Exit the cavern and follow the path west until you reach [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]].
If you haven't already, use the [[pickled brain]] on the [[decapitated head]], and give the body parts to [[Fenkenstrain]]. He will ask you for a [[needle]] and five spools of [[thread]] to sew the body together. Give them to him, and he will ask you to repair the lightning conductor, so that he may harness the power of lightning to bring the creature to life. [[File:Creature of Fenkenstrain - Cleaning the Fireplace.png|thumb|200px|Cleaning the Fireplace.]]
Wearing your ghostspeak amulet, ask the [[Gardener Ghost]] in the back of the castle for the [[shed key]], then go inside the shed next to him and search the [[Cupboard (Creature of Fenkenstrain)|cupboard]] for the [[garden brush]].
Take three of the [[garden cane]]s just east of the shed and use them on the brush with the [[bronze wire]] in your inventory ({{SCP|Crafting|20}}). This will create an [[extended brush]], making it suitable for chimney sweeping. Go back inside, take the staircase to the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} and use it on the fireplace in the west room to get a [[conductor mould]]. Make sure you use it on the [[Fireplace (Fenkenstrain's Castle)|centre of the fireplace]] and not the [[fireplace surround]].
Once you have the mould, you need to go to any [[furnace]] with a [[silver bar]] in your inventory to make a [[conductor]] (via the 'make lightning rod' option). The nearest furnace is in [[Port Phasmatys]] (2 ecto-tokens needed to enter, free if [[Ghosts Ahoy]] has been completed). Alternatively, use a teleport to a furnace (such as [[Amulet of glory]] teleport to [[Edgeville]]) if you have a method to easily return to the castle (such as [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|ALQ}}).
'''Note:''' On some occasions, you cannot make the conductor. Re-logging may fix this issue; in some cases, you have to talk to the gardener to get the option to make the conductor in the furnace.
Go back to [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]]; take the stairs on either the eastern or western side of the castle up to the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}, walk to the room furthest south, and climb the ladder to the roof. Click on the [[lightning conductor]] to fix it. Lightning will instantly strike, and the monster comes to life!
===Lord Rologarth=== {{Needed|skills={{SCP|Thieving|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to pickpocket Dr Fenkenstrain}} [[File:Creature of Fenkenstrain - He Lives!.png|thumb|200px|It's alive! ...and it talks!]] [[File:Lord Rologarth chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Talk to [[Dr Fenkenstrain]] again. He will tell you that the monster tried to kill him, so he locked it in the tower. He will give you the [[tower key]] and tell you to kill the monster. Go upstairs again, and enter the central room of the upstairs section, climb the ladder, and talk to Fenkenstrain's monster.
The monster will introduce himself as [[Lord Rologarth]]. He will tell you the true story of how Fenkenstrain tricked him into selling all of his subjects and himself to the [[vampyre]]s, and ask you to stop him from carrying out any more experiments.
You need to steal from Fenkenstrain a powerful ring which is allowing him to raise the dead. Go back downstairs and pickpocket him to obtain the [[ring of charos]] ({{SCP|Thieving|25}}).
'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
==Rewards== {{Quest rewards |name = Creature of Fenkenstrain |image = [[File:Creature of Fenkenstrain reward scroll.png|centre]] |qp = 2 |rewards = *{{SCP|Thieving|1,000}} [[Thieving]] experience *The [[Ring of charos]], which allows access to the [[Werewolf Agility Course]], and, when activated during [[Garden of Tranquillity]], reduced cost to many transport links. }}
==Required for completing== Completion of Creature of Fenkenstrain is required for the following: *[[Garden of Tranquillity]] *[[The Great Brain Robbery]] *[[Rag and Bone Man II]] (Only partial completion of Creature of Fenkenstrain required)
==Transcript== {{hastranscript|Quest}}
==Trivia== *Although not necessary for the completion of this quest, you can find a [[Letter (Creature of Fenkenstrain)|letter]] when winding the clock upstairs in [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]]. This letter, written by [[Lord Rologarth]] (the true owner of the castle), reveals the dark story of [[Dr Fenkenstrain]]'s past. *The grave examine reveals a bit of funny wordplay regarding the unlucky gardener's name, "Here lies Ed Lestwit". Roughly pronounced Headless Twit. *The quest is based heavily on the concept of the story of ''{{wp|Frankenstein}}'' by {{wp|Mary Shelley}}. *Dr Fenkenstrain's examine text ''Dr Fenkenstrain, I presume'' is likely a reference to the famous quote ''Dr Livingstone I presume''. *After the quest Dr Fenkenstrain's note on the signpost in Canifis is replaced by a new note just saying "AAARRGGGHHHHH!!!!!" *Based on the body parts that were exhumed, you can calculate the average weight of an NPC to be around 35kg. *The book "The Joy of Grave Digging" is a reference to Irma S. Rombauer's famous cooking book "The Joy of Cooking".
{{Creature of Fenkenstrain}}

{{External|rs=Crest_part_(Avan)|rsc=Crest fragment}} {{Infobox Item |version1 = Caleb |version2 = Avan |version3 = Johnathon |name = Crest part |image1 = [[File:Crest part (Caleb).png]] |image2 = [[File:Crest part (Avan).png]] |image3 = [[File:Crest part (Johnathon).png]] |release = [[9 April]] [[2002]] |update = New members quest online! |members = Yes |quest = [[Family Crest]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Drop |examine = A fragment of the Fitzharmon family crest. |value = 1 |weight1 = 1.360 |weight2 = 1.814 |weight3 = 1.360 |id1 = 780 |id2 = 779 |id3 = 781 }} {{Synced switch |version1 = [[File:Crest part (Caleb) detail.png|left|110px]] |version2 = [[File:Crest part (Avan) detail.png|left|150px]] |version3 = [[File:Crest part (Johnathon) detail.png|left|150px]] }} The '''crest parts''' are items obtained during the [[Family Crest]] [[quest]]. Each part is owned by one of three Fitzharmon brothers, who have all left their family home. Each brother took a separate piece of the crest with him to prevent the other two brothers from inheriting the family fortune. The player must complete a set of tasks for each of the brothers as follows: *[[Caleb]] ([[Catherby]]): Collect five different cooked fish: [[swordfish]], [[bass]], [[tuna]], [[salmon]], and [[shrimp]] *[[Avan]] ([[Al Kharid]]); Make a [['perfect' ring]] and [['perfect' necklace]]. *[[Johnathon]] ([[Varrock]]): Defeat the demon [[Chronozon]] in [[Edgeville Dungeon]]. Once the player has all three crest pieces, they can be combined to make the whole [[Family crest (item)|family crest]], which can then be given back to [[Dimintheis Fitzharmon]], the boys' father, in [[Varrock]]. ==Products== {{Uses material list|Crest part}} ==Item sources== ===Johnathon=== {{Drop sources|Crest part (Johnathon)}} ==Transcript== {{Hastranscript|item}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 20 July 2004 |update = Quest Journals and Chompy Hats |change = The model for Johnathon's part was corrected; previously it used the same model as Caleb's part. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Crest part (Johnathon) detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Crest part (Johnathon) detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Crest part (Johnathon) (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Crest part (Johnathon).png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 –
20 July 2004 |20 July 2004 –
present |} ==Trivia== *Upon first being received, Avan's crest part may not be retrieved after being lost or dropped. Therefore, it also can't be immediately [[drop trick|drop tricked]]. However, after obtaining Johnathon's crest part from Chronozon, the player may speak to Avan to retrieve his crest part. *When the three crest parts are dropped on the same tile on the ground, they're oriented to still visually form the full family crest. {{Family Crest}}

{{Infobox Scenery |name = Crevice |image = [[File:Crevice (Revenant Caves).png|250x250px]] |release = [[22 September]] [[2021]] |update = Wilderness & Equipment Rebalance Changes |members = No |quest = None |location = [[Wilderness]] |options = Jump-Down |examine = What's the worst that could happen? |map = {{Map|name=Crevice (Revenant Caves)|x=3067|y=3740|plane=0|zoom=1|mapID=-1|mtype=pin}} |id = 40386 |leagueRegion = Wilderness }} A '''crevice''' can be found within the [[Wilderness]], located north of the [[Bandit Camp]]. The crevice is a one-way entrance leading down to the [[Revenant Caves]]. Players can leave the caves via the [[stairs (Revenant Caves)|stairs]] located in the caves.
Upon attempting to jump down the crevice, players will be prompted to pay a fee of 100,000 coins, which will be dropped to the player's killer if they are killed by another player. The fee can be taken from the player's bank if they are not currently carrying enough. For as long as the player is not killed within the cave, the fee does not need to be paid again.
==Trivia== * The crevice was originally a [[cavern (Revenant Caves)|cavern]], but was changed to a one-way crevice as part of balancing changes to the Revenant Caves.
{{Revenant Caves}} {{Wilderness}}

{{HasStrategy}} [[File:Crew slot unlock detail.png|left|130px]] [[File:Crew management interface.png|thumb|right|The crew management interface.]] '''Crew management''' is an interface accessible from the [[Crew Registrar]] on [[The Pandemonium]] or [[Port Roberts]], where players can distribute tasks whilst [[Sailing]]. The interface can alternatively be accessed at the starting points of [[Barracuda Trials]] if the boat already has a crew. Once a crew member is recruited, they can be assigned or cleared from the crew without any restrictions. Different crew members have different levels of Helmsmanship (H), Privateering (P), and Deckhandiness (D) skills. For example, [[Jobless Jim]] is unlocked at level 40 Sailing and has H2-P1-D3, while [[Adventurer Ada]] is unlocked at level 55 and has H3-P2-D1. Players should choose their crew depending on which [[Facilities|facility]] slots they are using, taking advantage of crew members' specialties. A [[raft]] can support 0 crew members, a [[skiff]] can support 2, and a [[sloop]] can support 5. If more crew members are assigned than a boat can hold, they are picked in order from the crew management interface. Sailing levels can be [[Sailing#Temporary boosts|boosted]] to recruit crew members, but not to unlock the first and additional crew slots. ==Crewmates== Players must first talk to the crewmate on land before assigning them to a role on a raft or boat. Then, players must talk to the [[Crew Registrar]] to assign the unlocked crewmate to an open slot in their raft or boat. It does not cost anything to unlock or employ a crewmate. Below shows a table of each crewmate's attributes: {| class="wikitable lighttable sortable" !Crewmate ! style="white-space:nowrap;" | {{SCP|Sailing|}} Level !Location ![[Helmsmanship]] ![[Privateering]] ![[Deckhandiness]] !'''Courier''' Crates !Other requirements |- |{{chatl|Jobless Jim}} || {{SCP|Sailing|40}} || [[Port Sarim]] || 2 || 1 || 3 |2|| None |- |{{chatl|Ex-Captain Siad}} || {{SCP|Sailing|50}}{{Boostable|y}} || [[Desert Mining Camp]] || 3 || 2 || 3 |2|| {{SCP|Quest}} [[The Tourist Trap]] |- |{{chatl|Adventurer Ada}} || {{SCP|Sailing|55}}{{Boostable|y}} || [[The Pandemonium]] || 3 || 2 || 1 |1|| None |- |{{chatl|Cabin Boy Jenkins (ghost)|txt=Cabin Boy Jenkins}} || {{SCP|Sailing|60}}{{Boostable|y}} || [[Crandor]] || 2 || 2 || 4 |2|| {{SCP|Quest}} [[Dragon Slayer I]] [[Ghostspeak amulet]] or [[Morytania legs 2]] (or higher) |- |{{chatl|Oarswoman Olga}} || {{SCP|Sailing|65}}{{Boostable|y}} || [[Burgh de Rott]] || 2 || 4 || 2 |1|| {{SCP|Quest}} [[In Aid of the Myreque]] |- |{{chatl|Jittery Jim}} || {{SCP|Sailing|70}}{{Boostable|y}} || [[Port Khazard]] || 1 || 4 || 1 |1|| None |- |{{chatl|Bosun Zarah}} || {{SCP|Sailing|80}}{{Boostable|y}} || [[Etceteria]] || 3 || 3 || 2 |1|| {{SCP|Quest}} [[Royal Trouble]] Completion of the Hard [[Fremennik Diary]] |- |{{chatl|Jolly Jim}} || {{SCP|Sailing|85}}{{Boostable|y}} || [[Brimhaven]] || 1 || 1 || 4 |2|| None |- |{{chatl|Spotter Virginia}} || {{SCP|Sailing|90}}{{Boostable|y}} || [[Ruins of Unkah]] || 4 || 2 || 2 |1|| 100 [[Tempoross]] subdues |- |{{chatl|Sailor Jakob}} || {{SCP|Sailing|95}}{{Boostable|y}} || [[Catherby]] || 4 || 1 || 1 |1|| None |} As the player's Sailing level increases, they will be able to assign tasks to more crewmates at once. {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" |- !{{SCP|Sailing|}}
Level !! Crew
size |- | 40 || 1 |- | 55 || 2 |- | 70 || 3 |- | 85 || 4 |- | 95 || 5 |} ==Seafaring== [[File:Sailing Options - Crewmates.png|frame|The [[Sailing Options]] tab can show players an overview of their crew's stats and active assignments.]] ===Helmsmanship=== Helmsmanship allows crewmates to operate the helm and trim the sails, allowing the player to operate another facility while still controlling ship movement. Players will still need to manually click to aim the ship towards their preferred heading, as well as click on the icons in the sailing tab to manage speed. Any crewmate can pilot a [[skiff]] and level 3 helmsmanship is required to pilot a [[sloop]]. Crewmates assigned to navigation will automatically trim the sails, granting a percentage of full trimming experience. {| class="wikitable sortable" !Helmsmanship !Trimming experience |- |1 |40% |- |2 |50% |- |3 |60% |- |4 |70% |} ===Privateering=== Privateering controls crewmate cannon usage, with higher privateering levels allowing operation of better cannons and higher max hits. If a player does not have the required level to operate the cannon, crewmates will be unable to operate it as well even if they have the required privateering level. {| class="wikitable sortable" !Privateering !Facility |- |1 | *[[Bronze cannon]] |- |2 | *[[Iron cannon]] *[[Steel cannon]] |- |3 | *[[Mithril cannon]] *[[Adamant cannon]] |- |4 | *[[Rune cannon]] *[[Dragon cannon]] |} Cannons operated by crewmates use the player's visible Sailing level to calculate their max hit. The max hit (+1 if using a [[keg of perildance bitter]]) is then multiplied by a factor of (\text{Privateering + 13})/20 and rounded down. Cannons operated by the player instead use their own Ranged level. In both cases, visible skill boosts or drains can affect the max hit. Crewmates also have a greater restriction on what angle they can fire cannons at and can only shoot at enemies more directly in front of the cannon barrel. ===Deckhandiness=== Deckhandiness affects the ship's manual tasks, such as [[shipwreck salvaging|salvaging]] with a [[Salvaging hook (disambiguation)|salvaging hook]] and [[deep sea trawling|fishing]] with a [[trawling net]]. Crewmates using a salvaging hook provide reduced experience rates; efficiency scales with Deckhandiness, starting at '''10% XP (Level 1)''' and rising to '''40% XP (Level 4)'''. Crewmates will also have a higher success rate for obtaining salvage with a higher deckhandiness. It also changes the number of crates a crewmate can carry during a [[courier task]], with levels 1 and 2 allowing one crate per crewmate, and level 3 and 4 allowing two crates. Deckhandiness also affects how much your boat will heal when the crewmate repairs your boat with a [[repair kits|repair kit]], with levels of 2 or more providing a bonus of deckhandiness-1 healing, scaling with the level. {| class="wikitable sortable" !Deckhandiness !Best salvaging hook !Salvaging experience !Best trawling net !Crates !Bonus repair kit healing |- |1 |[[Steel salvaging hook]] |10% |[[Rope trawling net]] |1 |0 |- |2 |[[Adamant salvaging hook]] |20% |[[Linen trawling net]] |1 |0-1 |- |3 |[[Rune salvaging hook]] |30% |[[Hemp trawling net]] |2 |0-2 |- |4 |[[Dragon salvaging hook]] |40% |[[Cotton trawling net]] |2 |0-3 |} ==Other features== While the player is not on a ship, the crewmate in slot 1 will stand on the pier to assist the player in moving (non-port task) cargo. If you use the "Bank Cargo" option on a crewmate, the player can have all items in their active ship's cargo hold moved to their bank. If the player wishes to move cargo from a ship other than the active one, they can select other boats through dialogue with the crewmate after inquiring about the contents of the cargo hold. Boats must be docked at the same port where the player is located to move cargo to the bank. ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 5 December 2025 |update = An Update On the Sailing XP Review |type = hotfix |change = The experience modifier for crewmate salvaging was reduced: * Level 4 Deckhandiness modifier reduced from 70% to 40% * Level 3 Deckhandiness modifier reduced from 60% to 30% }} {{Subject changes |date = 3 December 2025 |update = Sailing XP Review & Further Fixes |change = Crewmates will now remember their assigned task after the player logs out or hops worlds. }} {{Subject changes footer}} {{Sailing}} {{Sailing crew}}

The total number of crates that can be carried in a single board or disembark is equal to 1 for the player, plus 1 for each crew mate with level 1 or 2 in deckhandiness, plus 2 crates for each crew mate with level 3 or 4 in deckhandiness. For example, with a crew of [[Jobless Jim]] and [[Ex-Captain Siad]], each crew mate will carry 2 crates while the player carries 1 crate. {{Future Content}} [[File:Blood Moon Rises Rewards (1).jpg|right|thumb|200px|Concept art of the crimson kisten.]] The '''crimson kisten''' is a crush weapon that will be dropped by the [[Maggot King]], fought after completion of [[The Blood Moon Rises]]. It will require 60 [[Attack]] and 85 [[Strength]] to wield.
==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 80 |amagic = 0 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 56 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = 2h |speed = 4 |attackrange = 1 }}
==Special attack== The crimson kisten has a [[special attack]], ''Brutal Swing'', which consumes 50% of the player's special attack energy. ''Brutal Swing'' makes four separate accuracy rolls in a single hit. If at least one roll succeeds, the attack deals 70-110% of the player's maximum hit, with additional successful rolls increasing the attack's minimum and maximum hit by 20%. When all four accuracy rolls succeed, the kisten's maximum hit is reduced by 1.
In practice, the damage scales as follows: * 1 successful roll: 70-110% * 2 successful rolls: 90-130% * 3 successful rolls: 110-150% * 4 successful rolls: 130-170%, though its max hit is reduced by 1
==Trivia== * The item is named after the {{WP|Flail (weapon)#The military flail|kiścień}}, a type of one-handed medieval flail. * The item was initially proposed as the '''crimson bludgeon''', but was renamed after player feedback stated the weapon resembled a flail more than a bludgeon.
==See also== * [[Update:The Blood Moon Rises - Overview]] * [[Update:Blood Moon Rises Rewards]]

revision.text:
{{Infobox Monster |name = Crocodile |image = [[File:Crocodile (Tombs of Amascut).png|280px]] |release = [[24 August]] [[2022]] |update = Tombs of Amascut |members = Yes |combat = 71 |size = 2 |examine = Never smile at a... |xpbonus = |max hit = 18 |aggressive = No |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Crush]] |attack speed = 7 |hitpoints = 30 |att = 150 |str = 60 |def = 100 |mage = 30 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 100 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 150 |dslash = 350 |dcrush = 350 |dmagic = 5 |dlight = 150 |dstandard = 150 |dheavy = 150 |elementalweaknesstype = Earth |elementalweaknesspercent = 40 |poisonresistance = 100 |venomresistance = 100 |immunecannon = Yes |immunethrall = No |id = 11705 }} '''Crocodiles''' are a monster encountered in the Path of Crondis within the [[Tombs of Amascut]]. They attack the [[Palm of Resourcefulness]] and hinder its growth.
They will prioritise their attack targets in the following order: # Players with a [[water container]] that is not empty and is within aggro range. # The Palm of Resourcefulness when it has any amount of growth. # Players without a water container who have also attacked the crocodile. This means that any player who attacks a crocodile while holding an empty water container will be safe from the crocodile's attacks.
When attacking a player, the crocodile will always hit a predetermined damage on successful attacks. This damage is increased based on the number of obstacles (acid pools or statue spears) that the player has been hit by in the last 30 seconds. If the player has not been hit by an obstacle, the damage is 18. For each obstacle, the crocodile's damage will increase by 3, up to a max of 36, regardless of raid level. For example, if the player has been hit by 2 obstacles in the last 30 seconds, the crocodile's damage dealt on a successful attack is 24. The damage is determined only by obstacles that hit the player. Other players in the raid do not affect this damage. In other words, if another party member is hit by an acid pool or statue spear, only the damage the crocodile does to that party member is changed. It is possible to delay the Crocodiles' advance with [[Binding spell|Binding]] or [[Ice spells|Ice Spells]]. As long as they cannot reach the Palm or a Player, the former's growth or the latter's water levels will not be drained.
If the player is using [[Protect from Melee]], then successful attacks from the crocodile will drain the player's [[Prayer]] points by 12 and hit a guaranteed damage of 1/3 of its damage. If the player is holding a non-empty water container, then each successful attack from the crocodile (whether using Protect from Melee or not) will also reduce the container's water by 50% of its total amount, similarly to getting hit by the traps.
A maximum of eight crocodiles can be alive at any given time.
[[File:Path of Crondis - Palm of Resourcefulness.png|thumb|left|300px|Crocodiles stunting the palm's growth.]]
==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 25 June 2025 |update = Summer Sweep Up: Combat |change = Crocodiles now have a 40% [[elemental weakness]] to [[earth spells]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 21 September 2022 |update = Tombs of Amascut Changes & Beta Tweaks |change = The spawn pattern of crocodiles on the Path of Crondis should now be more consistent. }} {{Subject changes footer}}
==Trivia== * The examine text is a reference to the vocal version of a song from [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peter_Pan_(1953_film) Disney's Peter Pan], "Never Smile at a Crocodile". * Despite being a crocodile, defeating one does not count for completion of the "In a while..." elite clue step.
{{Tombs of Amascut}}

revision.text:
{{Infobox Location |name = Crombwick Manor |image = [[File:Crombwick Manor.png|300px]] |release = [[24 May]] [[2018]] |update = A Taste of Hope |aka = The Sleepers Manor |members = Yes |location = [[Slepe]] |map = {{Map|name=Crombwick Manor|x=3726|y=3358|height=350|zoom=3}} |type = building |leagueRegion = Morytania }} '''Crombwick Manor''' is a large manor located in the town of [[Slepe]]. Its owner is [[Lord Crombwick]]. According to the [[deed]] found on the ground floor of the manor, the manor itself was called "The Sleepers Manor", and was given to the Crombwick family by [[Lord Drakan]] himself during the early [[Fourth Age]].
As the entrances to the manor are locked, it is only accessible via the ladder in [[Kroy]]'s laboratory in the [[Sisterhood Sanctuary]].
The manor was taken over by the [[vampyre]] [[Damien Leucurte]], who brought several [[vampyre juvenile]]s and [[vyrewatch]] to the manor, keeping Lord Crombwick inside, and had his servant [[Kroy]] develop the [[Elixir of Everlasting]]-infused [[bloody bracer]]s to spread the sleeper sickness to the inhabitants of Slepe in its basement. During [[Sins of the Father]], the player and [[Veliaf Hurtz]] uncover Leucurte's scheme and manages to slay him, but unable to save Lord Crombwick, who is killed by Leucurte to strengthen himself.
While the upper level of the manor appears dark and unlit, a [[light source]] can be used to brighten the area, although it is not mandatory.
==Gallery== <gallery> Sisterhood_Sanctuary_Kroy%27s_laboratory.png|Kroy's laboratory, which is directly under the manor. Crombwick Manor interior.png|The interior of the Crombwick Manor. Damien Leucurte's painting.png|Upstairs, Damien Leucurte stares intensely at a painting, with Lord Crombwick cowering behind him. </gallery>
{{Slepe}} [[Category:Morytania]] [[Category:Manors and mansions]]

{{External|rs}} {{Infobox NPC |version1 = Freed |version2 = Imprisoned |name = Crondis |image1 = [[File:Crondis.png|140px]] |image2 = [[File:Crondis (imprisoned).png|230px|class=notpageimage]] |release = [[24 August]] [[2022]] |update = Tombs of Amascut |members = Yes |race = Crocodile |quest = [[Into the Tombs]] |location = [[Jaltevas Pyramid]] |gender = Female |options1 = Talk-to |options2 = None |examine = Tumeken's avatar of resourcefulness. |map = No |id1 = 11659,11660 |id2 = 11657 |leagueRegion = Desert }} [[File:Crondis chathead.png|left]] '''Crondis''' is the lesser [[Gods|goddess]] of resourcefulness and one of the four minor gods of the [[Menaphite Pantheon]], a collection of deities that rule over the [[Kharidian Desert]]. According to legend from the [[Book of Light and Day]], she was created from one of the four dreams that the main god [[Tumeken]] once had over four days.
A [[Apparition#Crondis|manifestation]] of her can be encountered during [[Icthlarin's Little Helper]]. If the player picks up the crocodile-headed [[canopic jar]] containing the lungs, the player can fight the manifestation. However, fighting her is not necessary to finish the quest.
During [[Beneath Cursed Sands]] it is revealed that she, alongside [[Apmeken]], [[Het]], and [[Scabaras]], have been captured and corrupted by [[Amascut]] who had hunted them down over the centuries, with Amascut having manipulated [[Zebak]] into assisting her. They have all been taken to the [[Jaltevas Pyramid]], the tomb of [[Osmumten]], where Amascut plans to use two ancient weapons against them to steal their divine energy and ascend from a demi-goddess to a true [[god]]dess.
==Dialogue== {{Hastranscript|speaksin}}
==Gallery== <gallery> File:Crondis (monster).png|The [[Apparition#Crondis|apparition]] of Crondis appearing during [[Icthlarin's Little Helper]]. File:Statue (Crondis).png|A statue of Crondis found in the [[Tombs of Amascut]]. File:Crondis statue.png|A statue of Crondis found in the [[Uzer Mastaba]]. File:Crocodile emblem detail.png|A [[crocodile emblem]] dedicated to Crondis. File:Canopic jar (Crondis) detail.png|A [[Canopic jar#Crondis|canopic jar]] containing a pair of lungs bearing the visage of Crondis. File:Menaphite Pantheon lesser gods concept art.png|Concept art of the Avatars of Tumeken, by Mod Jerv. File:Crondis symbol.png|The symbol representing Crondis as seen in the [[Tombs of Amascut]] </gallery>
==Trivia== *Crondis is probably based on the Egyptian god {{Wp|Sobek}}. *With the release of the Do No Evil quest in 2010, Crondis's alignment was reinterpreted to pertain to resourcefulness and modesty, rather than egregious enjoyment. For this reason, the richer people of [[Menaphos]] were said to shun her, and the [[Pharaoh]] particularly so. This was also changed in ''Old School RuneScape'' with the release of [[Beneath Cursed Sands]].
{{Gods}} {{Into the Tombs}} {{Tombs of Amascut}}

{{External|rs|rsc}} {{Otheruses|def=no|the weapon type|Crossbow (weapon)}} {{Infobox Item |name = Crossbow |image = [[File:Crossbow.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = This fires crossbow bolts. |value = 70 |weight = 8.000 |respawn = 500 |exchange = Yes |id = 837 }} [[File:Crossbow detail.png|left|130px]] The '''crossbow''' is the weakest type of [[Crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]], along with the [[Phoenix crossbow]], and requires a [[Ranged]] level of 1 to wield. It can only fire [[bronze bolts]] and [[mith grapple]]s. The crossbow and the bolts can be bought from [[Lowe's Archery Emporium]] in [[Varrock]]. There is a crossbow spawn in the [[Graveyard of Shadows]], [[Bone Yard]], and [[Hugor]]'s house at [[Land's End]] (south-west of the [[Kourend Woodland]]). It possesses the longest range of any crossbow in the game, with 10 tiles of range on rapid. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = +6 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = weapon |speed = 6 |attackrange = 10 |combatstyle = Crossbow |image = [[File:Crossbow equipped male.png|150px]] |altimage = [[File:Crossbow equipped female.png|140px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Crossbow|speed=6|attackrange=10}} ==Item sources== ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Crossbow}} ===Item spawns=== {{ItemSpawnTableHead}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Crossbow|location=[[Land's End]] - [[Hugor]]'s house|members=Yes|1512,3423|leagueRegion=Kourend}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Crossbow|location=[[Wilderness]] - [[Graveyard of Shadows]]|members=No|3174,3663|leagueRegion=Wilderness}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Crossbow|location=[[Wilderness]] - south-east of the [[Bone Yard]]|members=No|3284,3719|leagueRegion=Wilderness}} {{ItemSpawnTableBottom}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 7 July 2021 |update = Small Changes & Tweaks |poll = |change = The weapon's position on female players has been adjusted so that they appear to be equipped properly. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 24 – 30 April 2007 |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Crossbow (historical) detail.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Crossbow detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Crossbow (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Crossbow.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
24-30 April 2007 |24-30 April 2007 ⁠–
present |} ==Trivia== * The crossbow is the heaviest one-handed weapon in the game. {{Crossbow}} {{Ranged weapons}}

{{External|rs=Crossbow (weapon type)|rsc=Crossbows}} {{Infobox Ranged Weapon Group |name = Crossbow |images = {{plinkp|Bronze crossbow}}{{plinkp|Blurite crossbow}}{{plinkp|Iron crossbow}}{{plinkp|Steel crossbow}}{{plinkp|Mithril crossbow}}{{plinkp|Adamant crossbow}}{{plinkp|Rune crossbow}}{{plinkp|Dragon crossbow}}
{{plinkp|Crossbow}}{{plinkp|Phoenix crossbow}}{{plinkp|Dorgeshuun crossbow}}{{plinkp|Hunters' crossbow}}{{plinkp|Hunters' sunlight crossbow}}{{plinkp|Dragon hunter crossbow}}{{plinkp|Karil's crossbow}}{{plinkp|Armadyl crossbow}}{{plinkp|Zaryte crossbow}}{{plinkp|Light ballista}}{{plinkp|Heavy ballista}} |ammunition = [[Bolts]] |twohanded = No |speed = 6 }} '''Crossbows''' are a [[Weapons/Categories|category]] of weapons used in [[Combat classes#Ranger|ranged combat]] that require a certain [[Ranged]] level to wield. They are different than [[bow]]s in that they are horizontal and can be held with one hand (except for the [[Karil's crossbow]], [[Light ballista]] and [[Heavy ballista]]), allowing a player to carry a [[shield]] with the other. [[Free-to-play]] players are recommended to stay with bows as the crossbows available to them are weak, while [[members]] have very strong crossbows. Crossbows require [[ammunition]] in the form of [[bolts]]. Most crossbows (including the dragon hunter crossbow) have a normal attack range of 7 and a long distance range of 9. However, there are some exceptions: * The Phoenix crossbow has a normal attack range of 5 and a long distance range of 7. * The Dorgeshuun crossbow has a normal attack range of 6 and a long distance range of 8. * Karil's crossbow, the hunter's/hunters' sunlight crossbows, Armadyl crossbow, and Zaryte crossbow have a normal attack range of 8 and a long distance range of 10. * The light and heavy ballistae have a normal attack range of 9 and a long distance range of 10. * The "plain" crossbow has an attack range of 10 regardless of attack style. ==Combat styles== {{CombatStyles|Crossbow}} ==Free-to-play crossbows== [[Free-to-play]] has access to only two crossbows that are both available from [[level]] 1 Ranged. They have both +6 Ranged accuracy and are only capable of shooting [[bronze bolts]]. {{Infotable Bonuses|Crossbow|Phoenix crossbow|sort=arange|nototals=yes|attackrange=yes}} ==Standard crossbows== Metal crossbows can be created through the [[Fletching]] skill. Most limbs and stocks can be purchased at the [[crossbow shop]] in the dwarven city of [[Keldagrim]], or in the [[Dwarven Mine]]. {{Infotable Bonuses|Bronze crossbow|Blurite crossbow|Iron crossbow|Steel crossbow|Mithril crossbow|Adamant crossbow|Rune crossbow|Dragon crossbow|sort=arange|nototals=yes|attackrange=yes}} ==Ballistae== Two-handed crossbows that shoot [[javelin]]s instead of bolts. {{Infotable Bonuses|Light ballista|Heavy ballista|nototals=yes|attackrange=yes}} ==Other crossbows== {{Infotable Bonuses|Dorgeshuun crossbow|Hunters' crossbow|Karil's crossbow#Undamaged|Dragon hunter crossbow|Armadyl crossbow|Zaryte crossbow|sort=arange|nototals=yes|Hunters' sunlight crossbow|attackrange=yes}} ==Demonic Pacts League== The [[King's barrage]] is only available during [[Demonic Pacts League]] as a unique drop from the [[King Black Dragon (Echo)]]. {{Infotable Bonuses|King's barrage|sort=arange|nototals=yes|attackrange=yes}} ==Ammunition table== {| class="wikitable sortable align-left-3 align-left-5" style="text-align:center;" !{{SCP|Ranged}} Level ! colspan=2 |Crossbow !Accuracy
bonus !Ammo |- |1 |{{plinkt|Crossbow}} | +6 |[[Bronze bolt]]s |- |1 |{{plinkt|Phoenix crossbow}} | +6 |[[Bronze bolt]]s |- |1 |{{plinkt|Bronze crossbow}} | +18 |[[Bronze bolt]]s |- |16{{efn|Also requires completion of [[The Knight's Sword]].}} |{{plinkt|Blurite crossbow}} | +30 |Up to [[blurite bolt]]s |- |26 |{{plinkt|Iron crossbow}} | +42 |Up to [[iron bolt]]s |- |28 |{{plinkt|Dorgeshuun crossbow}} | +42 |Up to [[iron bolt]]s (except [[silver bolts|silver]])

[[Long kebbit bolt]]s |- |61 |{{plinkt|Rune crossbow}} | +90 |Up to [[runite bolt]]s |- |64 |{{plinkt|Dragon crossbow}} | +94 |Up to [[dragon bolt]]s |- |65 |{{plinkt|Light ballista}} | +110 |[[Javelin]]s |- |66{{efn|Also requires 50 [[Hunter]].}} |{{plinkt|Hunters' sunlight crossbow}} | +79 |[[Sunlight antler bolt]]s
[[Moonlight antler bolt]]s |- |70 |{{plinkt|Karil's crossbow}} | +84 |[[Bolt rack]]s |- |70 |{{plinkt|Dragon hunter crossbow}} | +95 |Up to [[dragon bolt]]s |- |70 |{{plinkt|Armadyl crossbow}} | +100 |Up to [[dragon bolt]]s |- |75{{efn|Also requires completion of [[Monkey Madness II]].}} |{{plinkt|Heavy ballista}} | +125 |[[Javelin]]s |- |80 |{{plinkt|Zaryte crossbow}} | +110 |Up to [[dragon bolt]]s |} {{Notelist}} ==Fletching table== {{Table/Fletching/Crossbows}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 24 September 2015 |update = New Animations & Barbarian Assault Changes |change = It is now possible to boost your fletching level to make crossbows like most other equipment. }} {{Subject changes footer}} {{Weapon}} {{Crossbow}} [[Category:Ranged weapons]]

{{Infobox Item |name = Crowbar |image = [[File:Crowbar.png]] |release = [[19 November]] [[2025]] |update = Sailing is OUT TODAY! |members = Yes |quest = [[Prying Times]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Inspect, Destroy |destroy = ''Before completing the quest:'' You can get another by making one with Thurgo.
''after completing the quest:'' You can get another from the cargo hold on your boat. |examine = Not actually smelted from crow ore. |value = 50 |alchable = No |weight = 1.500 |id = 31807 }} [[File:Crowbar detail.png|130px|left]] A '''crowbar''' is a tool used to open [[sealed crate]]s as part of [[sea charting]]. The ability to open sealed crates at sea is unlocked upon completion of [[Prying Times]], which requires a [[Sailing]] level of 12. If lost, another can be obtained from the [[cargo hold]] of a [[boat]], or from the [[crate of crowbars]] behind the counter of [[The Pandemonium (pub)|the Pandemonium pub]]. ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Crowbar}} ==Transcript== {{Hastranscript|transclude=yes}} {{Prying Times}} {{Sea charting}}

{{Infobox Scenery |version1 = 1 |version2 = 2 |version3 = 3 |name = Crowd of dwarves |image1 = [[File:Crowd of dwarves (1).png|250px]] |image2 = [[File:Crowd of dwarves (2).png|250px]] |image3 = [[File:Crowd of dwarves (3).png|250px]] |release = [[24 April]] [[2007]] |update = Another Slice of H.A.M. |members = Yes |quest = [[Another Slice of H.A.M.]] |location = [[Another Slice of H.A.M.]] Cutscene |options = None |examine = Elated dwarves. |map = no |id1 = 23315 |id2 = 23316 |id3 = 23317 }} A '''crowd of dwarves''' can be seen in the ending cutscene of [[Another Slice of H.A.M.]], alongside [[council members]] and [[cave gobins]]{{sic}}. During the cutscene, they are cheering for the grand opening of the [[Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system]].
{{Another Slice of H.A.M.}} [[Category:Dwarves]]

{{Infobox Scenery |name = Crown of Ralos |image = [[File:Crown of Ralos.png|250x250px]] |release = [[20 March]] [[2024]] |update = Varlamore: Part One |members = Yes |quest = No |location = [[Grand Museum]] |options = Inspect |examine = A display showing the Crown of Ralos. |map = {{Map|name=Crown of Ralos|x=1721|y=3160|plane=0|mtype=pin|mapID=-1}} |id = 52695 }} The '''Crown of Ralos''' can be found on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of the [[Grand Museum]] of [[Civitas illa Fortis]]. When inspected it reads: {{Blockquote|The crown on display here is the original Crown of Ralos. When King Marhuitz was crowned the first king of Fortis, it was this crown that was placed upon his head.
Since its creation, the crown has been worn by every ruler of the Tullus dynasty. However, after the execution of Emperor Imafore and the passing of the throne to the Arkan dynasty, King Mezpah had a new crown created.}} {{Grand Museum}}

{{Infobox Scenery |version1 = During quest |version2 = Unusable |version3 = Empty |version4 = Partial |version5 = Full |name1 = Crucible |name2 = Crucible |name3 = Crucible (empty) |name4 = Crucible (partially full) |name5 = Crucible (full) |image1 = [[File:Crucible.png|160px]] |image2 = [[File:Crucible.png|160px]] |image3 = [[File:Crucible (empty).png|160px]] |image4 = [[File:Crucible (partially full).png|160px]] |image5 = [[File:Crucible (full).png|160px]] |release = [[8 June]] [[2022]] |update = Giants' Foundry |members = Yes |quest = [[Sleeping Giants]] |location = [[Giants' Plateau]] |options1 = Inspect |options2 = None |options3 = Fill, Check, Empty |options4 = Fill, Check, Empty |options5 = Pour, Check, Empty |examine1 = Wonder what this was used for. |examine2 = Wonder what this was used for. |examine3 = A big bucket. |examine4 = A big bucket. |examine5 = A big bucket. |map = {{Map|name=Crucible|3374,11489|mapID=-1|mtype=pin}} |id1 = 43864 |id2 = 44611 |id3 = 44622 |id4 = 44623 |id5 = 44624 }} A '''crucible''' can be found within the [[Giants' Foundry]]. It can be used by players to fill the [[mould jig]] with a desired liquid metal. The crucible can '''only''' be filled with metal [[bar]]s or metal items that can be produced using the [[Smithing]] skill, and that have a cost of at least 2 bars. This specifically excludes items such as [[black equipment|black]]/[[white equipment]], [[dragon equipment]], as well as [[ornamental armour|trimmed armour]] sets, among others, as they cannot be made using this skill. [[Lead bar|Lead]] and [[Cupronickel bar|cupronickel]] bars, and [[keel parts]] also cannot be added to the crucible. The crucible will accept up to 28 standard metal bars, as well as metal weapons and armour, though the weapons and armour will be worth one less bar than it takes to make them.
Attempting to insert items worth more bars than the crucible has space for will warn the player that any excess metal will be destroyed. The crucible can be emptied if incorrect items are inserted, but this will '''destroy''' all metal inside.
Once the crucible has been filled, the molten metal can be poured into the mould. A crucible cannot be poured if another preform has already been poured and not yet handed in.
{{Giants' Foundry}}

{{Cache}} {{Infobox Item |name = Crude wooden chair |image = [[File:Crude wooden chair icon.png]] |release = |update = |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Check materials |examine = |value = 1 |weight = 0.000 |id = interface8309 }} [[File:Crude wooden chair icon detail.png|left|100px]] The '''Crude wooden chair''' is an [[interface item]] that can be seen in the [[Construction]] skill guide representing the [[Crude wooden chair]].
The actual item cannot be obtained by players.
[[Category:Interface items]]

{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Cruder carving |image = [[File:Cruder carving.png]] |release = [[10 April]] [[2007]] |update = Olaf's Quest |members = Yes |quest = [[Olaf's Quest]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Destroy |destroy = This carving will be destroyed if you drop it and you will need to see Olaf Hradson to get another. |examine = Another log with some sort of bird hacked into it. |value = 0 |weight = 0.050 |id = 11033 }} [[File:Cruder carving detail.png|left|150px]] The '''cruder carving''' is a quest item used during [[Olaf's Quest]]. It is made by [[Olaf Hradson]] when the player presents him with some [[windswept logs]] from the [[windswept tree]] near where Olaf is. The player must then take this carving and a [[crude carving]] to Olaf's wife and son in [[Rellekka]].
{{Olaf's Quest}}

{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Crumbling tome |image = [[File:Crumbling tome.png]] |release = [[9 May]] [[2005]] |update = Barrows |aka = Legend of the Brothers |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Read, Drop |examine = This book must be really old! |value = 5 |weight = 0.510 |respawn = 100 |id = 4707 }} [[File:Crumbling tome detail.png|left|130px]] The '''crumbling tome''', or '''Legend of the Brothers''', is found on a desk in a building just east of the entrance to the [[Barrows]]. It is also obtained from the [[Strange Old Man]] in the Barrows if the conversation begins as ''"what? I didn't ask for a book!"''
It describes the story of the brave heroes that are buried there and what just happened to them to bring about the beginning of their end.
Players can also find it in the bookshelf in their [[player-owned house]]s, under the name ''Legend of the Brothers''.
