Crushed gems may be one of the items required in the [[Fairytale I - Growing Pains]] [[quests|quest]] to make the [[magic secateurs]]. revision.text:
{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Organisation |name = Crux Eqal |image = [[File:Guthix symbol.png|100px]] |release = [[10 July]] [[2024]] |update = While Guthix Sleeps |founded = Unknown |leader = [[Thaerisk|Thaerisk Cemphier]] |headquarters = Unknown }} The '''Crux Eqal''' are a group of Guthixians founded by [[Thaerisk|Thaerisk Cemphier]], whose duty is to ensure the balance of the world from the chaos of imbalance. The group is first encountered during the events of [[While Guthix Sleeps]]. The group appears to be made up, at least in part, from [[druids]] residing in [[Taverley]].
== Members == * [[Thaerisk]] * [[Ivy Sophista]]
== While Guthix Sleeps == During the events of While Guthix Sleeps [[Thaerisk]] states that the groups had been monitoring the activities of the [[Mahjarrat]] for some time. Thaerisk discusses how [[Lucien]] from the quest [[Temple of Ikov]] had obtained and allied the [[Staff of Armadyl]] to himself. The Crux Eqal fears that Lucien may be able to ascend to Godhood in a similar manner that [[Zamorak]] did when they possessed the staff. While telling the player this information, Lucien sends assassins to disrupt the activities of the Crux Eqal.
After defeating the assassins, Theaerisk informs the player that the assassins have been attacking them for some time. Thaerisk discloses that the Crux Eqal has formed an alliance with the [[Guardians of Armadyl]], and that they had "reached out" to the [[Temple Knights]] to form an alliance also.
{{While Guthix Sleeps}} [[Category:Guthixians]]

{{External|rs}} [[File:Crwys Clan.png|left|x130px]] [[File:Crwys Banner.png|right|120px]] [[File:Prifddinas - Crwys district.png|thumb|right|300px|The Crwys district of Prifddinas.]] The '''Crwys Clan''' is one of the eight [[elven clans]] who were originally brought to [[Gielinor]] from [[Tarddiad]] by [[Guthix]] and [[Seren]] in the early [[First Age]]. They are skilled in botanic arts such as [[Farming]] and [[Woodcutting]]. They are located north-east of the [[Tower of Voices]] in [[Prifddinas]], off the eastern path. {{clear|left}}
==Features of the district== *Three [[teak]] trees, three [[mahogany]] trees and a [[sawmill]] near them. *Two [[allotment patch]]es and a [[flower patch]]; there is no [[herb patch]]. *A [[crystal tree]] patch, which yields [[crystal shard]]s when harvested. *[[Branwen's Farming Shop]], a farming shop run by [[Branwen]]. A [[cooking range]] can be found in the house west of the shop as well.
==Known Crwys elves== *[[Lord Crwys]] (current leader) *[[Oswallt]] *[[Branwen]] *[[Pennant]] *[[Sawmill Operator]] *[[Enel]] *[[Edrahil]] *[[Fingon]] *[[Nimrodel]]
==Trivia== *Crwys translates to "cross" in {{WP|Welsh language|Welsh}}.
{{Elven Clans}} {{Prifddinas}} [[Category:Organisations]]

{{Infobox Scenery |name = Crypt |image = [[File:Crypt.png|250x250px]] |release = [[25 June]] [[2020]] |update = Death Changes |members = No |quest = None |location = [[White Knight's Castle]] |options = Enter |examine = A place of rest for fallen knights. |map = {{Map|x:2965,y:3330|plane=0|mapID=0|mtype=pin}} |id = 39617 }}
The '''Crypt''' entrance leads to a [[Crypt (White Knights' Castle)|small crypt]] below the [[White Knight's Castle]] in [[Falador]]. This crypt serves as the entrance to [[Death's Office]] from the Falador [[respawn point]].

'''Crypt''' may refer to: *[[Cryptic clues]] *Monsters: **[[Crypt rat]] **[[Crypt spider]] **[[Giant crypt rat]] **[[Giant crypt spider]] *The [[Barrows crypt]]s *[[Shayzien Crypts]] *The [[Crypt_(White_Knights'_Castle)|crypt]] beneath the [[White Knights' Castle]]. *The [[Rimmington church crypt]] beneath the [[Rimmington church]] * The [[Varrock crypt]]
{{Disambig}}

{{Infobox Scenery |name = Crypt Entrance |image = [[File:Crypt Entrance.png|250x250px]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2018]] |update = Dragon Slayer II |members = Yes |quest = [[Dragon Slayer II]] |location = [[Great Kourend]] |options = Enter |examine = It looks rather dark down there. |map = {{Map|x:1483,y:3548|plane=0|mapID=0|mtype=pin}} |id = 32403 }}
The '''Crypt Entrance''' is the entrance to the [[Shayzien Crypts]] located in the [[Graveyard of Heroes]] in the western part of [[Shayzien]]. The crypts are entered during the [[Dragon Slayer II]] quest to find the [[Dragon key piece#Kourend piece|Kourend dragon key piece]]. The player will be warned if they attempt to enter the crypts without a [[Light sources|light source]].

{{Infobox Item |name = Crypt key |image = [[File:Crypt key.png]] |release = [[28 July]] [[2021]] |update = A Night At The Theatre Rework |members = Yes |quest = [[A Night at the Theatre]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = |options = Destroy |destroy = You can obtain another from a vyrewatch in Ranis' Crypt. |examine = The key to a crypt (Used in the A Night at the Theatre quest). |value = 30 |alchable = No |weight = 0.010 |id = 25963 }} [[File:Crypt key detail.png|left|150px]] The '''crypt key''' is an item obtained during [[A Night at the Theatre]], in which players kill a [[vyrewatch]] in [[Ranis Drakan]]'s crypt to access the chamber containing his coffin.
{{A Night at the Theatre}} {{Keys}}

{{otheruses|the holy site and crypt|the dungeon below the crypt|Tonali Cavern}} {{Infobox Location |name = Crypt of Tonali |image = [[File:Crypt of Tonali.png|300px]] |release = [[23 July]] [[2025]] |update = Varlamore: The Final Dawn Out Now |members = Yes |location = [[Tlati Rainforest]] |map = {{Map|name=Crypt of Tonali|1311,9410|mapID=-1|plane=1|zoom=1}} |type = dungeon |leagueRegion = Varlamore }} The '''Crypt of Tonali''' is one of seven holy sites of the [[Losanium]] religion, located in the [[Tlati Rainforest]]. Built by the [[Old Ones]], the entrance to the crypt is a ziggurat with a large tree atop it, with a passageway in the tree allowing access to the underground caverns as well as the [[Ruins of Mokhaiotl]]. The entrance and the interior is guarded by [[Tonali Warrior]]s and [[Tonali Archer|Archer]]s.
The crypt is the location where the Teok Xiki, or the Gathering, is performed to select a new Teokan upon the death of the previous one. As a holy site, the teoki of Ralos and Ranul - [[Xopanatl, Teoki of Ralos|Xopanatl]] and [[Nenetl, Teoki of Ranul|Nenetl]] - are responsible for the crypt.
==Transportation== {{Map|1309,3104|1305,3033|caption=Entrances to the crypt|align=left|mtype=pin|width=250|height=250}} *[[Mokhaiotl waystone]]s can be used to teleport directly inside the [[Ruins of Mokhaiotl]], which is deep beneath the crypt. *The [[pendant of ates]] can be used to teleport to [[Kastori]] just east of the cavern's entrances. *The [[Quetzal Transport System]] can be used to land at [[Tal Teklan]] or [[Kastori]], both near the cavern's entrances.
==Features== The [[Tonali Cavern]] is an area beneath the crypt filled with monsters, including [[earthen nagua]], [[grimy lizard]]s, [[skeleton]]s, [[moss giant]]s, [[giant rock crab]]s, and [[rockslug]]s; as well [[moonlight moth]]s that can be caught with the [[Hunter]] skill. Teleporters around the area and a [[Stepping stone (Tonali Cavern)|stepping stone]] and [[Log balance (Tonali Cavern)|log balance]] [[Agility]] [[shortcut]] (both requiring level 46 Agility) can be used to navigate the cavern. A dwarf multicannon cannot be used here as "An ancient magical force won't let you set up a cannon here."
Further north contains a [[Lift Platform (Crypt of Tonali)|lift platform]] that can be activated to allow a two-way transit from the central section of the [[Tlati Rainforest]], allowing quick access to this part of the crypt. West of this lift is a chest which can be looted to obtain two [[Tonali teleporter]]s, which allow instant teleportation between the two nodes placed in this area within a 30 tile range from each other. The western moon chamber contains grimy lizards, while the eastern sun chamber contains earthen nagua, both of which are in a [[multicombat area]] and only appear after completion of [[The Final Dawn]].
Beyond the crypt is the entrance to the [[Ruins of Mokhaiotl]].
==Gallery== <gallery mode="packed" heights="150" style="text-align:left"> Tonali Cavern.png|The cavern beneath the crypt. Ruins of Mokhaiotl entrance.png|The entrance to the [[Ruins of Mokhaiotl]] at the northern end of the crypt. Crypt of Tonali concept art.png|Concept art for the Crypt of Tonali, by [[Mod Jerv]]. Tonali Cavern concept art.png|Concept art for the underground cavern, by [[Mod Jerv]]. Crypt of Tonali characters concept art.png|Concept art for characters around the crypt, by [[Mod Jerv]]. </gallery>
==Trivia== * Tonali is likely derived from the Nahuatl word "tonalli". In Mesoamerican religion, the {{WP|tonalli}} was considered to be part of the soul, located in one's hair. It represents the warmth of the sun, and it is said that losing the tonalli results in illness and eventually death.
{{Losanium}} {{Varlamore}} {{Dungeons}}

{{Infobox Item |name = Crystal blessing |image = [[File:Crystal blessing.png]] |release = [[27 November]] [[2024]] |update = Leagues V: Raging Echoes OUT NOW! |removal = |removalupdate = |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = No |bankable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Equip, Drop |examine = A powerful crystal blessing that warps the crystalline nature of reality. |value = 50000 |weight = 0.453 |id = 30384 |leagueRegion = Tirannwn }} [[File:Crystal blessing detail.png|130px|left]] The '''crystal blessing''' is an [[echo item]] that can be obtained from [[Echo Corrupted Hunllef]] during the [[Demonic Pacts League]]. Equipped in the ammunition slot, the blessing expands the accuracy and damage bonus from [[crystal armour]] (which is usually only applied to the [[crystal bow]] and [[Bow of Faerdhinen]]) to all melee weapons (including barehanded attacks) and all magic powered weapons. Additionally, the blessing provides +2% magic damage and +20 Magic attack bonus per [[crystal armour]] piece equipped (this is '''additive''' with the negative magic attack bonuses from the crystal armour pieces themselves; as the full crystal armour set has a negative magic attack bonus of -40 by default, equipping the blessing along with all three pieces of crystal armour will result in a total magic attack bonus of +20). ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = +5 |slot = ammo }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Crystal blessing}} ==Crystal set effects== When the crystal blessing is equipped, the accuracy and damage bonuses from each piece of [[crystal armour]] applies to all melee and powered staff attacks. The blessing also provides additional magic accuracy and damage for each piece. However, existing equipment stats still apply, so the negative magic bonus on each piece is present. The total magic attack bonus for the armour set is normally -40, but the blessing adds +60 magic attack (+20 for each piece), for a net total of +20 wearing the whole set. {|class="wikitable align-left-2 align-right-7" style="text-align:center" ! colspan="2" | Item ! Accuracy bonus ! Damage bonus ! Additional
magic damage ! Additional

{{Infobox Scenery |name = Crystal bomb |image = [[File:Crystal bomb.png|250x250px]] |release = [[5 January]] [[2017]] |update = Chambers of Xeric |members = Yes |quest = None |location = [[Chambers of Xeric]] |options = None |examine = Tick tock. |map = No |id = 29766 }}
The '''crystal bomb''' is one of the [[Great Olm]]'s attacks. The olm spits out up to three bombs which land at random locations in the room and blow up after a short delay. If a player is within the blast radius of the bomb when it explodes they will take between 15 and 60 damage, based on their distance from the centre of the explosion. In particular, standing on the same tile as the bomb will deal the full 60 damage, reducing by 15 every tile away. Standing on the 4th tile away (3 visible tile gaps in between the player and the bomb) is safe and will deal no damage.

revision.text:
{{External|rs}} [[File:Crystal armour seed detail.png|left|140px]]'''Crystal equipment''' is a range of [[Degradation|degradable]] weapons and armour made from elven [[crystal]]. Crystal combat equipment requires completion of [[Roving Elves]] to use, as well as 50 [[Agility]] (although 56 Agility is a boostable requirement to travel through [[Tirannwn]]), among other skill requirements unique to each piece. Crystal tools and crystal armour can only be obtained after [[Song of the Elves]]. There are also the [[crystal saw]] and [[crystal chime]], which are rewards from the [[quest]]s [[The Eyes of Glouphrie]] and [[The Path of Glouphrie]] respectively.
Upon death in the [[Wilderness]], the killer will receive the seed form of the crystal equipment.
{{clear|left}}
==Creation== {{#vardefine:crystalshardvalue|{{#ifexpr:{{#vardefineecho:seedvalue|{{GEP|Enhanced crystal teleport seed}} / 150}} > {{#vardefineecho:divinesupercombatvalue|({{GEP|Divine super combat potion(4)}} - {{GEP|Super combat potion(4)}}) / 0.4}} | {{#var:seedvalue}} | {{#var:divinesupercombatvalue}}}}}} All crystal equipment may be sung from a certain type of crystal seed and varying amounts of [[crystal shard]]s by the player via the use of a [[singing bowl]], which requires various levels in [[Crafting]] and [[Smithing]]. If players do not have the requirements, they can have [[Conwenna]] or [[Reese]] nearby create the items for them for additional crystal shards.
However, for items created via [[crystal weapon seed]]s, players can take them to [[Ilfeen]], who will create the items for [[coins]] rather than crystal shards.
{{:Crystal singing}}
==Crystal weapons== Standard [[crystal weapon seed]]s can be used to create three types of equipment: [[crystal bow]]s, [[crystal shield|shields]], and [[crystal halberd|halberds]]. However, the halberd can only be created after completion of the [[Hard Western Provinces Diary]].
[[Enhanced crystal weapon seed]]s can be used to create the [[blade of Saeldor]] and the [[bow of Faerdhinen]]. These weapons can then be overcharged with [[crystal shard]]s to create corrupted versions, which no longer degrade.
{{Infotable Bonuses|Blade of saeldor#Charged|Bow of faerdhinen#Charged|Crystal bow#Active|Crystal halberd#Active|Crystal shield#Active|nototals=yes}}
{|class="wikitable align-center-1 align-right-3" ! colspan="2" | Item ! Material cost<ref group="n">Using ([[Enhanced crystal weapon seed|enhanced]]) [[crystal weapon seed]] value, plus equivalent value of [[crystal shard]]s needed.</ref> |- | {{plinkt|Blade of saeldor}} | {{Coins|{{GEP|Enhanced crystal weapon seed}} + ({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 100)}} |- | {{plinkt|Bow of faerdhinen}} | {{Coins|{{GEP|Enhanced crystal weapon seed}} + ({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 100)}} |- | {{plinkt|Crystal bow}} | {{Coins|{{GEP|Crystal weapon seed}} + ({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 40)}} |- | {{plinkt|Crystal halberd}} | {{Coins|{{GEP|Crystal weapon seed}} + ({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 40)}} |- | {{plinkt|Crystal shield}} | {{Coins|{{GEP|Crystal weapon seed}} + ({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 40)}} |- | {{plinkt|Blade of saeldor (c)}} | {{Coins|{{GEP|Enhanced crystal weapon seed}} + ({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 1000)}} |- | {{plinkt|Bow of faerdhinen (c)}} | {{Coins|{{GEP|Enhanced crystal weapon seed}} + ({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 2000)}} |} <references group="n" />
===Enchantment costs=== While players can use a [[singing bowl]] to create crystal combat equipment out of [[crystal weapon seed]]s, they can alternatively have [[Ilfeen]] enchant them to [[crystal bow]]s, [[crystal shield|shield]]s, and [[crystal halberd|halberd]]s for coins. Having her sing halberds requires completion of the [[Hard Western Provinces Diary]]. Ilfeen '''cannot''' "recharge" the crystal items themselves, players must manually revert their item to a crystal weapon seed and choose the item that they want to pay her for. While singing yourself with [[Crystal shard|shards]] always costs {{NoCoins|({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 40) round 0|c}}, the price she charges depends on how many times she has previously been paid to enchant weapon seeds, down to a minimum price:
{|class="wikitable align-center-1 align-left-2" style="text-align:right" ! rowspan="2" colspan="2" | Item ! colspan="5" | Enchantment cost |- ! First ! Second ! Third ! Fourth ! Fifth and thereafter |- | {{plinkt|Crystal bow}} | {{Coins|900,000}} | {{Coins|720,000}} | {{Coins|540,000}} | {{Coins|360,000}} | {{Coins|180,000}} |- | {{plinkt|Crystal halberd}} | rowspan="2" | {{Coins|750,000}} | rowspan="2" | {{Coins|600,000}} | rowspan="2" | {{Coins|450,000}} | rowspan="2" | {{Coins|300,000}} | rowspan="2" | {{Coins|150,000}} |- | {{plinkt|Crystal shield}} |}
==Crystal armour== [[Crystal armour seed]]s can create three pieces of armour: the [[crystal helm]], [[crystal body|body]], and [[crystal legs|legs]]. These can only be created by the player at a [[singing bowl]], or by having [[Conwenna]] or [[Reese]] sing the crystal for them for an extra 60 [[crystal shard]]s per piece.
The armour pieces start off at 2,500 charges; the maximum charges that can be stored is 20,000. One charge is depleted for each successful hit that is received from combat, except in the following cases:
* Damage that is completely negated by [[protection prayers]] and [[Absorption]] potions does not deplete charges. * Damage from non-monster sources such as divine potions and [[Wintertodt]] attacks does not deplete charges, with the exception of damage taken from a [[strange device#Master|strange device]] which ''does'' deplete charges.
Using the shard value of making [[divine super combat potion]]s, the cost per charge is {{NoCoins|({{GEP|Divine super combat potion(4)}}-{{GEP|Super combat potion(4)}})*0.025}}. Using the shard cost of trading in [[enhanced crystal teleport seed]]s to [[Amrod]], the most efficient option for buying crystal shards directly, the cost per charge is {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Enhanced crystal teleport seed}}*0.00006666666}}. Assuming continuous unprotected combat against an enemy with an attack speed of 4 ticks, each piece of armour will lose 1,500 charges per hour, costing {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Enhanced crystal teleport seed}}*0.09999999}} per hour per piece (or {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Enhanced crystal teleport seed}}*0.09999999*3}} per hour with all 3 armour pieces) using the cost of trading in enhanced crystal teleport seeds.
To recharge the armour pieces, the player must load in crystal shards (this can be done before it is inactive as well), with each shard granting 100 charges. Dismantling a crystal armour piece will return the crystal armour seeds to the player but all crystal shard charges that were previously loaded will be '''lost'''.
{{Infotable Bonuses|Crystal helm#Active|Crystal body#Active|Crystal legs#Active}}
Each crystal armour piece has a bonus effect when equipped to give a damage and accuracy increase to the [[crystal bow]] and [[bow of Faerdhinen]], adding up to a total 15% damage and 30% accuracy bonus when the full set is equipped.
While wearing the [[crystal body]] and/or [[crystal legs]] with the [[Slayer helmet (i)]], the damage bonus from crystal armour pieces is multiplied by the 15% ranged damage boost from the helmet. With both crystal body and legs, this results in a combined damage bonus of approximately 29.375%.
{|class="wikitable align-left-2 align-right-5" style="text-align:center" ! colspan="2" | Item ! Accuracy bonus ! Damage bonus ! Material cost<ref group="n">Using [[crystal armour seed]] value plus equivalent value of [[crystal shard]]s needed.</ref> |- | {{plinkt|Crystal helm}} | 5% | 2.5% | {{Coins|{{GEP|Crystal armour seed|1}} + ({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 50)}} |- | {{plinkt|Crystal body}} | 15% | 7.5% | {{Coins|{{GEP|Crystal armour seed|3}} + ({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 150)}} |- | {{plinkt|Crystal legs}} | 10% | 5% | {{Coins|{{GEP|Crystal armour seed|2}} + ({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 100)}} |- ! colspan="2" | Totals | 30% | style="text-align:center;" | 15% | style="text-align:right;" | {{Coins|{{GEP|Crystal armour seed|6}} + ({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 300)}} |} <references group="n" />
==Crystal tools== [[Crystal tool seed]]s can create three pieces of equipment: the [[crystal axe]], [[crystal pickaxe|pickaxe]], and [[crystal harpoon|harpoon]], which share the same combat stats as their [[Dragon equipment|dragon]] equivalents but offer faster gathering speeds. These can only be created by the player at a [[singing bowl]], or by having [[Conwenna]] or [[Reese]] sing the crystal for them for an extra 60 [[crystal shard]]s per piece.
The tools start off at 10,000 charges; the maximum charges that can be stored is 20,000. One charge is depleted for each item that is obtained using the tool. To recharge the tools, the player must load in crystal shards (this can be done before it is inactive as well), offering 100 charges per shard. Dismantling a crystal tool will return the dragon equivalent and crystal tool seed to the player and doing so will lose all crystal shard charges that were previously loaded.
{{Infotable Bonuses|Crystal axe#Active|Crystal harpoon#Active|Crystal pickaxe#Active|nototals=yes}}
{|class="wikitable align-center-1 align-right-3" ! colspan="2" | Item ! Material cost<ref group="n">Using dragon tool value, [[crystal tool seed]] value, and equivalent value of [[crystal shard]]s needed.</ref> |- | {{plinkt|Crystal axe}} | {{Coins|{{GEP|Dragon axe}} + {{GEP|Crystal tool seed}} + ({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 120)}} |- | {{plinkt|Crystal harpoon}} | {{Coins|{{GEP|Dragon harpoon}} + {{GEP|Crystal tool seed}} + ({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 120)}} |- | {{plinkt|Crystal pickaxe}} | {{Coins|{{GEP|Dragon pickaxe}} + {{GEP|Crystal tool seed}} + ({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 120)}} |} <references group="n" />
==Miscellaneous== Other equipment made from crystal includes the [[crystal saw]], [[crystal chime]], and [[celestial signet]].
A crystal saw provides a +3 [[Construction]] boost for constructing furniture using a [[saw]] which stacks with other Construction boosts. The crystal chime is required to slay [[warped creature]]s. The celestial signet combines the [[elven signet]] and [[celestial ring]] to enable the benefits of both to be used with a [[crystal pickaxe]].
While not equipment, it may also be worth noting [[divine potion]]s and [[enhanced crystal key]]s which are made from [[crystal shard]]s; as well as [[teleport crystal]]s and [[eternal teleport crystal]]s which are created from their own crystal seeds.
==Recolouring== The [[Crystal equipment#Crystal armour|crystal armour]], [[Blade of saeldor (c)|corrupted blade of Saeldor]], and [[Bow of faerdhinen (c)|corrupted bow of Faerdhinen]] can be recoloured to colours representing the eight [[Elven Clans]] of [[Prifddinas]] by use of crystals purchased from [[Lliann's Wares]] for {{Nocoins|500,000|c}} each. You will need one crystal per piece of armour or weapon you wish to recolour and they are used up when applied to the item. In their default colouration, the armour has the colours of the Meilyr clan, and the corrupted weapons have the colours of the Hefin clan.
A Deadman variant can be unlocked for the crystal armour and corrupted bow of Faerdhinen by giving [[Nigel]] an [[annihilation weapon scroll]]. Crystal equipment reverted from the Deadman variant will be reset to the default colours of the item; the Meilyr clan colours for the armour, and the Hefin clan colours for the bow.
{{Tabber |tab1 = Default (Meilyr) |tab1content = <gallery heights="250" style="text-align:left"> Crystal armour equipped male.png|The crystal armour set on body type A. ==Trivia== *There was once a [[glitch]] that allowed players to cast [[High Level Alchemy]] on crystal bows and crystal shields in [[free-to-play]] worlds and make several thousand coins per piece. Players could buy crystal seeds from other players, pay the reduced recharge cost, and make large sums of money. Because of this glitch, it is no longer possible to alchemise crystal equipment at all.

revision.text:
{{External|rs}} {{Otheruses|def=no|the historical version|Crystal halberd (historical)|other uses|Crystal halberd (disambiguation)}} {{Infobox Item |version1 = Active |version2 = Inactive |version3 = New |name1 = Crystal halberd |name2 = Crystal halberd (inactive) |name3 = Crystal halberd |image = [[File:Crystal halberd.png]] |release = [[25 July]] [[2019]] |update = Song of the Elves |aka = Chally |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = No |options1 = Wield, Check, Revert, Drop |options2 = Wield, Revert, Drop |options3 = Wield, Check, Revert, Drop |wornoptions1 = Check |wornoptions2 = None |wornoptions3 = Check |examine = A nice sturdy pike. |value = 300000 |alchable = No |weight = 1.814 |id1 = 23987 |id2 = 23989 |id3 = 24125 |leagueRegion = Tirannwn & Kandarin }} [[File:Crystal halberd detail.png|left|120px]] The '''crystal halberd''' is a [[Degradation|degradable]] two-handed [[Weapons/Categories#Polearm|polearm]] made from a [[crystal weapon seed]]. It requires completion of the [[Hard Western Provinces Diary]] to wield, as well as 70 [[Attack]], 35 [[Strength]] and 50 [[Agility]]. In order to obtain a crystal halberd (with 2,500 charges), one must talk to [[Islwyn]] who will offer to sell a crystal halberd for 750,000 coins. Alternatively, one can take a [[crystal weapon seed]] to [[Ilfeen]] to be recharged into a crystal halberd with 2,500 charges starting at a price of 750,000 coins, lowering by 150,000 each time afterwards, eventually reaching a recharge price of 150,000 coins. With access to [[Prifddinas]] and completion of the [[Hard Western Provinces Diary]], the [[singing bowl]] can be used with 78 Crafting and Smithing and 40 [[crystal shard]]s to turn a crystal weapon seed into a crystal halberd. Players without the stat requirements can speak to [[Conwenna]] or [[Reese]] and have them create the crystal halberd for you for 20 additional crystal shards. The crystal halberd is significantly more powerful than a [[dragon halberd]], making it a good choice as a melee [[safespot]] weapon. The crystal halberd can deal full damage to the [[Corporeal Beast]], despite not being a spear, but it '''must''' be on the stab attack style. The crystal halberd is used for its special attack, which can deal high damage against large enemies or groups of enemies. However, its special attack is bested in DPS by the special attacks of both the [[dragon dagger]] and [[dragon claws]] against most monsters, making its use largely centred around last-hitting and AoE damage. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |bucketname = Active |astab = +85 |aslash = +110 |acrush = +5 |amagic = -4 |arange = 0 |dstab = -1 |dslash = +4 |dcrush = +5 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = +118 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = 2h |speed = 7 |attackrange = 2 |combatstyle = Polearm |image = [[File:Crystal halberd equipped male.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Crystal halberd equipped female.png|170px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Polearm|speed=7|attackrange=2}} ==Special attack== [[File:Sweep (crystal halberd).gif|thumb|250px|A player performing the crystal halberd's special attack, ''Sweep''.]] [[File:Sweep (crystal halberd, PvP).gif|thumb|250px|A player performing the crystal halberd's special attack in PvP.]] The crystal halberd shares the same [[special attacks|special attack]] as the [[dragon halberd]], consuming 30% of the player's special attack energy. In addition to a 10% damage boost, if used against "large" monsters (anything that is larger than 1x1, such as [[General Graardor]]), the special attack will deal an additional second hit onto them, although with 25% reduced accuracy. It can also hit up to 10 NPCs in a [[multi-combat area]] in a 3x1 area centred on the main target (unless it is used on an NPC larger than 1x1, in which case it will hit the target twice and ignore the rest of the NPCs). In [[PvP]], it can only hit up to three players. The crystal halberd's special attack's accuracy rolls against the opponent's slash defence.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/690476787806158848|date=22 January 2016|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/100957|archivedate=28 May 2020}} When using gear with the highest strength bonus and a [[Slayer helmet]] or [[black mask]] on task, the highest possible hit with the special attack is 74–74 (total of 148) on large monsters. While this is higher than what [[dragon claws]] and [[dragon dagger]] can achieve, the much slower attack speed of the halberd is a major downside, so the claws and dagger generally lead to faster damage output in combat. The crystal halberd's special attack can still be particularly useful in certain situations. Anywhere that players have a forced amount of downtime (time where it is impossible to continue attacking), a crystal halberd special attack can be substituted for extra damage without incurring the 7-tick penalty. This is a common tactic against the [[Pestilent Bloat]]; due to his long period of time where you have to run away, players typically use a crystal halberd special attack as their last damaging attack before running away to increase their potential damage cap. This tactic is also commonly utilized when fighting [[Zulrah]] with a melee setup; the crystal halberd special attack is used right before Zulrah dives into the swamp, with the damage registering after she resurfaces. Because she is temporarily untargetable after diving, the special attack's downside of a 7-tick attack penalty is made irrelevant, allowing its high damage output to be more beneficial. In a similar manner, it is often used when the opponent is on low health and the special attack is likely to finish them faster than using standard weapons (a strategy known as "last-hitting"). Although halberds are the only weapon category alongside [[spear]]s to ignore the damage reduction on the [[Corporeal Beast]], the crystal halberd has limited use on it; as the special attack rolls against the opponent's slash defence, which is particularly high on the Corporeal Beast, it is very inaccurate against it (typically to the point where [[dragon claws]] are more effective despite the damage reduction) unless its Defence level is severely reduced. The special attack's ability to hit up to ten enemies can prove useful as well; when on a [[Slayer]] task where stacking enemies up in one pile to cast multi-combat spells is efficient, such as [[smoke devil]]s, the crystal halberd can deal a large amount of additional damage, often twice that of an [[Ice Barrage]]. It is often used for this purpose in efficient [[Barbarian Assault]] teams by the attacker. ==Creation== {{#vardefine:crystalshardvalue|{{#ifexpr:{{#vardefineecho:seedvalue|{{GEP|Enhanced crystal teleport seed}} / 150}} > {{#vardefineecho:divinesupercombatvalue|({{GEP|Divine super combat potion(4)}} - {{GEP|Super combat potion(4)}}) / 0.4}} | {{#var:seedvalue}} | {{#var:divinesupercombatvalue}}}} round 1}} |-| Crafting = {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 78 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 2,000 |skill2 = Crafting |skill2lvl = 78 |skill2boostable = Yes |skill2exp = 2,000 |notes = {{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Song of the Elves]]
{{SCP|Diary}} Completion of [[Hard Western Provinces Diary]] |members = Yes |ticks = 3 |ticksnote = Takes 3 ticks to create an entire inventory |facilities = Singing bowl |mat1 = Crystal weapon seed |mat2 = Crystal shard |mat2quantity = 40 |mat2cost = {{#var:crystalshardvalue}} |mat2itemnote = Value based on {{#ifexpr:{{#var:seedvalue}} > {{#var:divinesupercombatvalue}} | the cost of obtaining by exchanging [[enhanced crystal teleport seed]]s with [[Amrod]] | the potential profit of using the crystal shards to create [[divine super combat potion]]s}} |output1 = Crystal halberd |output1cost = No |output1subtxt = Crafting }} |-| Islwyn = {{Recipe |notes = {{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Roving Elves]]
{{SCP|Diary}} Completion of [[Hard Western Provinces Diary]] |members = Yes |ticks = 0 |facilities = Islwyn |mat1 = Coins |mat1quantity = 750000 |mat1cost = 1 |output1 = Crystal halberd |output1cost = No |output1subtxt = Islwyn }} |-| Ilfeen = {{Recipe |notes = {{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[ Roving Elves]]
{{SCP|Diary}} Completion of [[Hard Western Provinces Diary]] |members = Yes |ticks = 0 |facilities = Ilfeen |mat1 = Crystal weapon seed |mat2 = Coins |mat2quantity = 150000 |mat2quantitynote = Cost from fifth re-enchantment onwards. Initial enchantment is {{NoCoins|750,000|c}}, decreasing with each re-enchantment. |mat2cost = 1 |output1 = Crystal halberd |output1cost = No |output1subtxt = Ilfeen }} ==Degradation== The crystal halberd degrades over time until it reverts into an inactive form. The player must either recharge it with [[crystal shard]]s (if they have completed [[Song of the Elves]]) or revert it into a [[crystal weapon seed]] and re-enchant it via [[Ilfeen]]. [[Ilfeen]] will recharge [[crystal weapon seed]]s into [[crystal bow]]s, [[crystal shield]]s or crystal halberds. She can be found teleporting back and forth between two clearings in [[Isafdar]], or after completion of the [[Song of the Elves]] quest, she can be found south of the [[Prifddinas]] house portal. Initially, Ilfeen charges 750,000 coins to re-enchant a crystal seed into a crystal halberd. However, the price is decreased by 150,000 coins each time Ilfeen re-enchants a seed for a player, in the following manner, until reaching the minimum recharge cost of 150,000 coins: {| class="wikitable" !Enchantment !Cost for re-enchantment !Cost per charge |- |First |{{Coins|750000}} |{{Coins|300}} |- |Second |{{Coins|600000}} |{{Coins|240}} |- |Third |{{Coins|450000}} |{{Coins|180}} |- |Fourth |{{Coins|300000}} |{{Coins|120}} |- |Fifth and thereafter |{{Coins|150000}} |{{Coins|60}} |} The amount that Ilfeen charges is dependent on the number of crystal seeds she has re-enchanted, '''not''' the number of crystal halberds she has recharged. For example, a player who pays Ilfeen 900,000 coins to re-enchant a crystal seed into a crystal bow will only have to pay her 600,000 coins to recharge a seed into a crystal halberd. For players who have completed [[Song of the Elves]], an alternative way of making crystal weapons is using a crystal weapon seed and 40 [[crystal shard]]s along with 78 [[Smithing]] and 78 [[Crafting]] on a [[singing bowl]] in [[Prifddinas]]. Players who do not meet the skill requirements can pay a nearby elf to create the weapon for an additional 20 shards. Crystal shards can be used to recharge the weapon to a maximum of 20,000 charges, with each shard providing 100 charges. However, it is far more cost efficient in the long term to instead use the [[Crystal shard#Value|crystal shards on potions]] and use the money from selling them to re-enchant your crystal equipment. ==Shop locations== {{Store locations list|Crystal halberd}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Crystal halberd}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 12 March 2025 |update = Permanent Deadman: World 345 Improvements |change = The crystal halberd, [[crystal bow]], and [[crystal shield]] supports a bank item option for changing charges, with all three items sharing the same "Quantity" value, using crystal charges instead of coins. }} {{Subject changes |date = 25 July 2019 |update = Song of the Elves |poll = Song of the Elves rewards |change = Crystal equipment stats no longer become gradually lower as the weapon degrades, converting all imbued crystal halberds into crystal weapon seeds and removing the ability to imbue them through [[Nightmare Zone]]. The crystal halberd can now alternatively be made and charged through crystal shards instead of paying Ilfeen. }} {{Subject changes |date = 23 May 2019 |update = Hosidius Rework and Deadman Beta |change = The offensive and defensive stats of the unimbued crystal halberd now correctly lower as the weapon degrades. }} {{Subject changes |date = 26 April 2019 |type = hotfix |change = The crystal halberd special attack was limited to three targets in PvP, to prevent unintentionally high [[experience]] rates.{{CiteTwitter|author=Old School RuneScape|url=https://twitter.com/OldSchoolRS/status/1121800161104019457|date=26 April 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/101623|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=A hotfix has been deployed to cap the Crystal halberd, Crystal halberd (i), Dragon halberd, and Dragon two handed sword special attacks to hit a maximum of 3 players in PvP. This is to prevent players achieving unintentionally high xp rates while a long term fix is discussed.}} }} {{Subject changes |date = 7 June 2018 |update = The Theatre of Blood |change = The crystal halberd's special attack used to only hit the main target on the central tile, but hit an unlimited amount of monsters on the two adjacent tiles. Now, it caps the maximum number of monsters to 10, but allows monsters standing on the same tile as the primary target to also be affected by the attack. }} {{Subject changes |date = 19 May 2016 |update = Sand Crabs & Soul Bearers |change = The "uncharge" option on the crystal halberd now properly removes the weapon's imbue. Previously, it would result in the message "Nothing interesting happens". }} {{Subject changes |date = 25 June 2015 |update = Boss Room Counters & Platinum Tokens |change = The crystal halberd now becomes cheaper when re-enchanted. }} {{Subject changes |date = 23 April 2015 |update = Crystal Halberd Special & More |poll = Old School Content Poll 32: Resizable Mode |change = A special attack was added. }} {{Subject changes |date = 26 March 2015 |update = System Update (26 March 2015) |change = The New crystal halberd full (i) now functions as a [[halberd]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 12 March 2015 |update = Diary Skillcape Emote |change = The combat interface no longer shows unarmed option for the crystal halberd, and attacking an opponent no longer shows the message "Unrecognised ranged weapon". }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== [[File:2014 Birthday event - Crystal halberd rack.png|thumb|A rack of crystal halberds found in ''Old School RuneScape's'' first birthday party.]] *It is one of the few pieces of equipment that requires three different skill levels to wield ([[Agility]], [[Attack]], [[Strength]]), as well as having several skill requirements, including [[Combat level|level 100 combat]], to obtain from the [[Hard Western Provinces Diary]]. *The crystal halberd replaced a previous item, also named [[Crystal halberd (historical)|Crystal halberd]]. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Slash weapons}} {{Crystal items}} {{Nightmare Zone}} {{2014 Birthday event}} [[Category:Weapons with Special attacks]] [[Category:Items with charges]]

{{External|rs|rsc}} {{otheruses|def=no|the corresponding chest|crystal chest}} {{Infobox Item |name = Crystal key |image = [[File:Crystal key.png]] |release = [[27 February]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (27 February 2002) |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = A mysterious key for a mysterious chest. |value = 150 |weight = 0.010 |exchange = Yes |id = 989 }} [[File:Crystal key detail.png|left|150px]] The '''crystal key''' is created by combining a [[tooth half of key]] with a [[loop half of key]], displaying the message, "''You join the two halves of the key together.''" Key halves can be obtained as rewards from [[Barrows]], the [[Gnome Restaurant]] [[Minigames|minigame]], [[Managing Miscellania]], [[Treasure Trails]], looting [[magpie impling]]s, [[random events]], the [[rare drop table]], etc. It is used to open the [[crystal chest]] located inside a house in [[Taverley]]. The chest always contains an [[uncut dragonstone]] in addition to a variety of other items. Some items of note are 3 [[runite bar]]s, [[rune platelegs]]/[[Rune plateskirt|plateskirt]] (depending on the player's gender), or another half of the crystal key. After the key is used, it disappears and the player must use another one if they want to open the chest again. The crystal key may not be placed on the [[steel key ring]], as it is non-reusable. The crystal key can be upgraded to an [[enhanced crystal key]] at a [[singing bowl]] in [[Prifddinas]], for the cost of 10 [[crystal shard]]s. One is required for a medium [[Falador Diary]] task of opening a [[Crystal chest|Crystal chest.]] {{Map|name=Closed chest|x=2914|y=3452|mapID=0|mtype=pin|caption=The location of the [[crystal chest]].|align=left}} ==Money Making== {{Mmgsection|Opening crystal chests|Creating crystal keys}} ==Creation== {{Recipe |members = Yes |ticks = 0 |mat1 = Loop half of key |mat2 = Tooth half of key |output1 = Crystal key }} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Crystal key}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Crystal key}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 12 December 2013 |update = Patch Notes (12 December 2013) |change = The item's value was increased from 1 to 150. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Crystal key detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Crystal key detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Crystal key (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Crystal key.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2

As such, using the [[drop trick]] is necessary when talking to them for players who want to keep this pendant after the quest. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = neck |image = [[File:Crystal pendant equipped.png|130px]] |altimage = [[File:Crystal pendant equipped female.png|130px]] }} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 12 June 2020 |update = Darkmeyer Improvements |change = Lord Iorwerth's Crystal Pendant is now the same colour on male and female characters. }} {{Subject changes |date = 25 July 2019 |update = Song of the Elves |change = The colour of the pendant was changed from green to cyan. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 17 – 24 November 2004 |change = The item's examine was changed from "''Lord Iorwerths{{sic}} crystal pendant.''" to "''Lord Iorwerth's crystal pendant.''" }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Crystal pendant (v1) detail.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Crystal pendant detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Crystal pendant v1.png|center]] |[[File:Crystal pendant.png|center]] |- |20 September 2004 –

revision.text:
{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Crystal saw |image = [[File:Crystal saw.png]] |release = [[15 August]] [[2006]] |update = The Eyes of Glouphrie |members = Yes |quest = [[The Eyes of Glouphrie]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Check, Destroy |destroy = Maybe Brimstail will have another... |examine = A magical saw. |value = 10 |weight = 1.000 |id = 9625 |leagueRegion = Kandarin }} [[File:Crystal saw detail.png|left|150px]] A '''crystal saw''' is an item made from a [[crystal saw seed]] by invoking a [[singing bowl]] in either [[Brimstail's cave]] or [[Prifddinas]]. The seed is awarded to players who complete [[The Eyes of Glouphrie]] quest.
When in the inventory, the saw allows the player to build furniture up to 3 levels higher than their current [[Construction]] level. Note that this boost only works on furniture that requires both a [[saw]] and a hammer to make ([[STASH]] units, [[Fire pit|Fire Pits]], and [[Shipbuilding]] included); as such, the saw '''cannot''' assist in building new rooms or planting flowers in a [[garden]]. This bonus stacks with all other visible [[Construction#Temporary boosts|boosts to Construction]], making it possible to build items up to 8 levels higher than the player's current Construction level when used in conjunction with a +5 boost from [[spicy stew]]. However, given the erratic nature of spicy stew boosts, it is more common for players to combine it with a [[Cup of tea (trimmed)|trimmed cup of tea]] for a +6 boost.
If players lose or destroy the saw, they can get it back by talking to [[Brimstail]] in his cave and selecting his first dialogue option. He will not give players a seed if they have either the seed or the saw in the bank or inventory. The saw is destroyed upon death.
The saw can be used to boost your construction level for [[Sailing]] [[Facilities]] and [[Shipbuilding#Core_boat_parts|core boat parts]], despite the latter not requiring a saw. When used to construct core boat parts the crystal saw will not lose any charges.
The saw cannot be used to get higher-level contracts in [[Mahogany Homes]].
==Creation== {{Recipe |notes = {{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[The Eyes of Glouphrie]] |members = Yes |ticks = |facilities = Singing bowl |mat1 = Crystal saw seed |mat1cost = no |output1 = Crystal saw |output1cost = no }}
==Degradation== The saw has 28 charges (56 if the [[medium Western Provinces Diary]] has been completed). One charge is used each time the player constructs a piece of furniture while using the saw's invisible boost; thus, players using the saw to build furniture that they already have the base level to build will not consume charges. Charges are not consumed when building [[STASH]] units beyond the player's level.
Once the saw runs out of charges, it reverts to its seed form and will need to be re-enchanted by returning to Brimstail's cave. The player can also re-enchant the seed at the singing bowl in [[Prifddinas]].
==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 26 August 2020 |update = Mahogany Homes |change = The crystal saw now has an option for checking its remaining charges. }} {{Subject changes |date = 5 March 2015 |update = Achievement Diaries |poll = Old School Achievement Diary Rewards Poll |change = Crystal saws now hold up to 56 charges if players have completed the [[Medium Western Provinces Diary]]. }} {{Subject changes footer}}

revision.text:
{{External|rs}} {{Otheruses|the present day Crystal shield|the item as it functioned before 2019|Crystal shield (historical)}} {{Infobox Item |version1 = Active |version2 = Inactive |version3 = New |name1 = Crystal shield |name2 = Crystal shield (inactive) |name3 = Crystal shield |image = [[File:Crystal shield.png]] |release = [[25 July]] [[2019]] |update = Song of the Elves |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = No |options1 = Wield, Check, Revert, Drop |options2 = Wield, Revert, Drop |options3 = Wield, Check, Revert, Drop |wornoptions1 = Check |wornoptions2 = None |wornoptions3 = No |examine = A nice sturdy crystal shield. |value = 300000 |alchable = No |weight = 2.721 |id1 = 23991 |id2 = 23993 |id3 = 24127 |leagueRegion = Tirannwn }} [[File:Crystal shield detail.png|left|130px]] The '''crystal shield''' is a powerful [[Degradation|degradable]] [[Shields|shield]] available after a player completes the [[Roving Elves]] quest, and a possible reward from this quest along with the [[crystal bow]]. To wield the crystal shield, a player must have 70 [[Defence]], 50 [[Agility]], and have completed the Roving Elves quest.
It can be made by combining 40 [[crystal shard]]s with one [[crystal weapon seed]] at a [[singing bowl]] in [[Prifddinas]]. Alternatively, the crystal shield can be purchased from [[Islwyn]] for 750,000 [[coins]] even if the player chose the [[crystal bow]] as their initial quest reward for completing Roving Elves. It can be considered similar to [[Barrows equipment]] due to its substantial power and expensive repair costs. The crystal shield's melee defence bonuses are comparable to those of a [[Dragon sq shield|dragon square shield]]. However, its ranged defence bonus is the highest of any one-handed shield.
==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |version1 = Active |version2 = Inactive |version3 = New |bucketname = Active |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic1 = -10 |amagic2 = 0 |amagic3 = -10 |arange1 = -10 |arange2 = 0 |arange3 = -10 |dstab1 = +51 |dstab2 = 0 |dstab3 = +51 |dslash1 = +54 |dslash2 = 0 |dslash3 = +54 |dcrush1 = +53 |dcrush2 = 0 |dcrush3 = +53 |dmagic = 0 |drange1 = +80 |drange2 = 0 |drange3 = +80 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = shield |image = [[File:Crystal shield equipped male.png|190px]] |altimage = [[File:Crystal shield equipped female.png|190px]] }}
==Uses== The crystal shield's extremely high Ranged defence bonus and high melee defence bonuses makes it ideal for prolonged encounters where the player will take a lot of damage over time from multiple attack styles, such as when fighting the [[Dagannoth Kings]] or the [[Moons of Peril]]. While the [[elysian spirit shield]] and [[Dinh's bulwark]] are considered to be the best shields for tanking damage, the crystal shield being extremely cheap in relation to the elysian spirit shield and it allowing the player to wield a weapon at the same time compared to the bulwark makes it a solid choice even in late-game encounters like the [[Inferno]] and the [[Fortis Colosseum]], where it is commonly used among learners of the content.
Despite this, the shield has no Magic defence bonuses whatsoever, along with having a small penalty to Ranged and Magic attack bonuses. While the former can be mitigated with [[Protect from Magic]], the latter may prove troublesome if the player does not bring any armour switches. Additionally, the shield forbids the use of most Ranged weapons like bows and the [[toxic blowpipe]], along with not allowing melee weapons to benefit from the accuracy and strength bonuses granted by [[defender]]s.
==Creation== {{#vardefine:crystalshardvalue|{{#ifexpr:{{#vardefineecho:seedvalue|{{GEP|Enhanced crystal teleport seed}} / 150}} > {{#vardefineecho:divinesupercombatvalue|({{GEP|Divine super combat potion(4)}} - {{GEP|Super combat potion(4)}}) / 0.4}} | {{#var:seedvalue}} | {{#var:divinesupercombatvalue}}}} round 1}} <tabber> |-| Crafting = {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 78 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 2000 |skill2 = Crafting |skill2lvl = 78 |skill2boostable = Yes |skill2exp = 2000 |notes = {{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Song of the Elves]] |members = Yes |ticks = 3 |ticksnote = Takes 3 ticks to create an entire inventory |facilities = Singing bowl |mat1 = Crystal weapon seed |mat2 = Crystal shard |mat2quantity = 40 |mat2cost = {{#var:crystalshardvalue}} |mat2itemnote = Value based on {{#ifexpr:{{#var:seedvalue}} > {{#var:divinesupercombatvalue}} | the cost of obtaining by exchanging [[enhanced crystal teleport seed]]s with [[Amrod]] | the potential profit of using the crystal shards to create [[divine super combat potion]]s}} |output1 = Crystal shield |output1cost = No |output1subtxt = Crafting }} |-| Ilfeen = {{Recipe |notes = {{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[ Roving Elves]] |members = Yes |ticks = 0 |facilities = Ilfeen |mat1 = Crystal weapon seed |mat2 = Coins |mat2quantity = 150000 |mat2quantitynote = Cost from fifth re-enchantment onwards. Initial enchantment is {{NoCoins|750,000|c}}, decreasing with each re-enchantment. |mat2cost = 1 |output1 = Crystal shield |output1cost = No |output1subtxt = Ilfeen }} </tabber>
==Degradation== The crystal shield starts with 2,500 charges but degrades 1 charge for every non-zero hit while it is equipped. Once the shield runs out of charges, it becomes inactive, losing all stats. In order to use it again, the player must either recharge it with [[crystal shard]]s (if they have completed [[Song of the Elves]]), or revert it into a [[crystal weapon seed]] and convert it via [[Ilfeen]]. Note that if the player chooses the shield as a reward for completing [[Roving Elves]], the crystal shield given to them will only begin with '''500 charges''' instead.
Once the crystal shield has reverted to a crystal seed, a player has the option of either buying a new crystal shield for the cost of 750,000 [[coins]] from [[Islwyn]], which doesn't require a seed, or having the seed converted back into a full shield or bow for a fee.
Ilfeen will recharge crystal weapon seeds into [[crystal bow]]s, [[crystal halberd]]s, or crystal shields. She can be found teleporting back and forth between two clearings in [[Isafdar]]. After completing Song of the Elves, she can be found in the south-west part of [[Prifddinas]].
Initially, Ilfeen charges 750,000 coins to re-enchant a crystal seed into a crystal shield. However, the price is decreased by 150,000 coins each time Ilfeen re-enchants a seed for a player, in the following manner, until reaching the minimum recharge cost of 150,000 coins:
{| class="wikitable" !Enchantment !Cost for re-enchantment !Cost per hit |- |First |{{Coins|750000}} |{{Coins|300}} |- |Second |{{Coins|600000}} |{{Coins|240}} |- |Third |{{Coins|450000}} |{{Coins|180}} |- |Fourth |{{Coins|300000}} |{{Coins|120}} |- |Fifth and thereafter |{{Coins|150000}} |{{Coins|60}} |}
The amount that Ilfeen charges is dependent on the total number of crystal seeds she has re-enchanted, not the number of crystal shields she has recharged. For example, a player who has previously paid Ilfeen to re-enchant a crystal seed into a [[crystal bow]] would only have to pay her {{NoCoins|600000|c}} to re-enchant a seed into a crystal shield.
For players who have completed [[Song of the Elves]], an alternative way of making crystal weapons and shields is using a crystal weapon seed and 40 [[crystal shard]]s along with 78 [[Smithing]] and 78 [[Crafting]] on a [[singing bowl]] in [[Prifddinas]]. Players who do not meet the skill requirements can pay a nearby elf to create the weapon for an additional 20 shards. Crystal shards can be used on the shield to recharge the shield to a maximum of 20,000 charges, with each shard providing 100 charges, adding the shards to the shield does not require the Smithing and Crafting levels.
However, it is far more cost efficient in the long term to instead use the [[Crystal shard#Value|crystal shards on potions]] and use the money from selling them to re-enchant your crystal equipment.

The crystal shield can now alternatively be made through crystal shards instead of paying Ilfeen. }} {{Subject changes |date = 16 April 2015 |update = Clan Wars Game Modes & More |change = A "Check" option was added to see the remaining charges. }} {{Subject changes |date = 13 March 2014 |update = Rejuvenating the Wilderness: More risk, more reward |change = Crystal equipment now reverts to a seed when dropped on death. }} {{Subject changes |date = 26 September 2013 |update = Patch Notes (26 September 2013) |poll = Old School feature poll 10: New Rewards |change = Crystal bows and shields can be imbued, making them keep their combat stats unchanged as they degrade. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== *During the [[Demonic Pacts League]], due to [[regenerate (Demonic Pacts League)]], it was possible for the crystal shield to have more than 20,000 charges.

{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Crystal tool seed |image = [[File:Crystal tool seed.png]] |release = [[25 July]] [[2019]] |update = Song of the Elves |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = A seed to be sung into the best tools of the craft. |value = 500000 |weight = 0.000 |exchange = Yes |id = 23953 |leagueRegion = Tirannwn }} [[File:Crystal tool seed detail.png|80px|left]] The '''crystal tool seed''' is an [[elves|elven]] [[crystal]] that can be turned into the [[crystal axe]], [[crystal harpoon]], or [[crystal pickaxe]], using 120 [[crystal shard]]s and the [[Dragon equipment|dragon]] counterpart on a [[singing bowl]]. It can be obtained as a drop from [[Zalcano]]. The crystal tools start off at 10,000 charges and degrades, like other [[crystal equipment]]. One charge is depleted for each time an item is obtained using the tool, with some exceptions for particular uses of the [[crystal axe|axe]] and [[crystal pickaxe|pickaxe]] where the crystal version has no additional benefit (duplicates from items such as the [[Varrock armour]] do not deplete an extra charge). The player may add charges with [[crystal shard]]s, with each shard granting 100 charges, up to a maximum of 20,000 charges. Dismantling a crystal tool will return the dragon equivalent and crystal tool seed to the player and doing so will lose all crystal shard charges that were previously loaded. Players can also exchange the tool seed for 100 [[crystal shard]]s by speaking to [[Amrod]] in [[Prifddinas]]' [[Hefin Inn]]. A dangerous death in PvP causes the crystal tools to revert to their dragon equivalents which will then be dropped for the killer. All crystal shards will be lost as well. ==Tool information== Players who do not meet the Crafting and Smithing requirements for each tool can talk to [[Conwenna]] or [[Reese]] to sing the tools for them for an additional 60 crystal shards per tool. {|class="wikitable align-left-2" style="text-align:center;" !colspan=2|Item !{{SCP|Smithing}} Level !{{SCP|Crafting}} Level !Seeds !Shards !Shards

{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Crystal trinket |image = [[File:Crystal trinket.png]] |release = [[17 October]] [[2005]] |update = Mourning's Ends Pt II |members = Yes |quest = [[Mourning's End Part II]] |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Destroy |destroy = '''After Mourning's End Part II:''' You can get another from Arianwyn in Lletya.
'''After Song of the Elves:''' You can get another from a chest in Lletya. |examine = A small crystal trinket. |value = 1 |weight = 0.010 |id = 6653 }} [[File:Crystal trinket detail.png|left|150x150px]] The '''crystal trinket''' is a reward from [[Arianwyn]] after completing [[Mourning's End Part II]]. It is used to enter the [[Temple of Light]] after the quest. For players who have not completed [[Song of the Elves]], this also requires [[mourner gear]] or a [[slayer ring]] since the entrance is via the Mourner headquarters' basement in [[West Ardougne]]. Players will still need the trinket after completing [[Song of the Elves]]. If players lose it, they can obtain another from [[Arianwyn]] in [[Lletya]]. During and after [[Song of the Elves]], it is instead found in a [[Closed Chest (Lletya)|chest]] on the east side of the ground floor in Lletya in the main building. If you try to enter the temple after completing the quest without the trinket, players will be bounced back and get the message "A strange force blocks your path." This is not necessary when crafting [[death rune]]s through the [[Abyss]], the Underground Pass, or through [[Guardians of the Rift]]. ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 29 May 2007 |update = Varrock's New Look |change = The "Drop" option was replaced with a "Destroy" option. }} {{Subject changes footer}} {{Mourning's End Part II}}

revision.text:
{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Crystal weapon seed |image = [[File:Crystal weapon seed.png]] |release = [[7 February]] [[2005]] |update = Roving Elves |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = A seed to be sung into the finest crystal weapons. |value = 1 |weight = 0.014 |exchange = Yes |id = 4207 |leagueRegion = Tirannwn }} [[File:Crystal weapon seed detail.png|left|130px]] A '''crystal weapon seed''' is an [[elves|elven]] [[crystal]] that can be turned into [[crystal weapons]]. Completing the [[Gauntlet]] will yield a chance of gaining these seeds. The crystal weapon seed can be bought from [[Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing]] for 12 [[Last Man Standing]] points. This seed can be restored into a [[crystal bow]], a [[crystal shield]], or a [[crystal halberd]], the latter only with completion of the [[Hard Western Provinces Diary]]. Before completion of [[Song of the Elves]], [[Ilfeen]] is the only one to offer this service to the player. She can be found at either of two clearings in [[Isafdar]], teleporting between them periodically. If the player is mid-quest, and she is occupied with the fight against [[Lord Iorwerth]], an [[Elven Scout]] will fulfil her role. After completion of the quest, [[Ilfeen]] is found in [[Prifddinas]], slightly south of the house portal. After completion of [[Song of the Elves]], players may enchant the seeds themselves at a [[Singing bowl]], requiring 78 [[Crafting]] and [[Smithing]]. Players can also exchange the weapon seed for 10 [[crystal shard]]s by speaking to [[Amrod]] in [[Prifddinas]]' [[Hefin Inn]]. The seed can additionally be traded to [[Pennant]] in [[Prifddinas]] for one [[crystal acorn]], which can be grown into a crystal tree that yields up to 28-32 crystal shards when harvested. When converting a crystal seed to a [[crystal bow]] and [[crystal shield]], they '''cannot''' be traded or be used for [[High Level Alchemy|high alchemy]]. ==Enchantment costs== ===Ilfeen=== {{#vardefine:crystalshardvalue|{{#ifexpr:{{#vardefineecho:seedvalue|{{GEP|Enhanced crystal teleport seed}} / 150}} > {{#vardefineecho:divinesupercombatvalue|({{GEP|Divine super combat potion(4)}} - {{GEP|Super combat potion(4)}}) / 0.4}} | {{#var:seedvalue}} | {{#var:divinesupercombatvalue}}}}}} If the player has a crystal weapon seed, [[Ilfeen]] can enchant it into a [[crystal bow]], [[crystal shield|shield]], or [[crystal halberd|halberd]] for coins. Having her sing halberds requires completion of the [[Hard Western Provinces Diary]]. Ilfeen '''cannot''' "recharge" the crystal items themselves, players must manually revert their item to a crystal weapon seed and choose the item that they want to pay her for. While singing yourself with [[Crystal shard|shards]] always costs {{NoCoins|({{#var:crystalshardvalue}} * 40) round 0|c}}, the price she charges depends on how many times she has previously been paid to enchant weapon seeds, down to a minimum price. The price of enchantment is contingent on the number of crystal seeds Ilfeen has recharged, and '''not''' on the number of individual equipment pieces she has recharged. For example, a player who pays Ilfeen {{NoCoins|900,000|c}} to enchant a crystal seed into a crystal bow would then only have to pay her {{NoCoins|600,000|c}} to recharge a seed into a crystal shield. Therefore, players who wish to stock up on many pieces of equipment are advised to pay for the shields or halberds first. {|class="wikitable align-center-1 align-left-2" style="text-align:right" ! rowspan="2" colspan="2" | Item ! colspan="5" | Enchantment cost |- ! First ! Second ! Third ! Fourth ! Fifth and thereafter |- | {{plinkt|Crystal bow}} | {{Coins|900,000}} | {{Coins|720,000}} | {{Coins|540,000}} | {{Coins|360,000}} | {{Coins|180,000}} |- | {{plinkt|Crystal halberd}} | rowspan="2" | {{Coins|750,000}} | rowspan="2" | {{Coins|600,000}} | rowspan="2" | {{Coins|450,000}} | rowspan="2" | {{Coins|300,000}} | rowspan="2" | {{Coins|150,000}} |- | {{plinkt|Crystal shield}} |} ===Singing bowl=== After completion of the [[Song of the Elves]] quest players will be able to use crystal shards to sing weapons themselves, requiring 78 [[Crafting]] as well as 78 [[Smithing]]. This can be done at the [[singing bowl]] located just south of the player-owned house portal in the city of [[Prifddinas]]. Another singing bowl can be found in the south-east corner of Prifddinas just east of the mining shop. Players who do not meet the skill requirements can pay a nearby elf to create the weapon for an additional 20 shards. The amount of crystal shards needed to sing a piece of legacy crystal equipment are as follows: *[[Crystal shield]] - 40 [[crystal shard]]s and 1 crystal weapon seed *[[Crystal bow]] - 40 [[crystal shard]]s and 1 crystal weapon seed *[[Crystal halberd]] - 40 [[crystal shard]]s and 1 crystal weapon seed ==Products== {{Uses material list|Crystal weapon seed}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Crystal weapon seed}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Crystal weapon seed}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 25 July 2019 |update = Song of the Elves |change = *The item was graphically updated. *The item was renamed from "Crystal seed" to "Crystal weapon seed". }} {{Subject changes |date = 5 March 2015 |update = Achievement Diaries |poll = Old School Achievement Diary Rewards Poll |change = Crystal seeds can now be enchanted into [[crystal halberd]]s by [[Ilfeen]] if you have completed the [[Hard Western Provinces Diary]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 22 June 2005 |update = Rogues Den + Tweaks |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Crystal weapon seed detail (historical).png|center|200x150px]] |[[File:Crystal weapon seed (v1) detail.png|center|200x150px]] |[[File:Crystal weapon seed detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Crystal weapon seed (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Crystal weapon seed v1.png|center]] |[[File:Crystal weapon seed.png|center]] |- |7 February 2005 –
22 June 2005 |22 June 2005 –
25 July 2019 |25 July 2019 –
present |} ==Trivia== *When [[Song of the Elves]] was released, crystal weapons and crystal seeds were turned into crystal weapon seeds. *The book, '[[Crystal singing for beginners]]', states that there is no known way to destroy a crystal seed. However, players are able to do so through the [[bank]]'s incinerator feature. *Once the equipment runs out of charges, the crystal seed remains "equipped" by the player, but it offers no stats and results in [[unarmed]] combat. *Although crystal seeds are rarely found by players, their exchange price had steadily declined until the release of Song of the Elves, when it could be exchanged for [[crystal acorn]]s via [[Pennant]], as it is very rare for a player to lose a seed without discarding it on purpose. Moreover, it is available from [[Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing]] and, due to being a very popular boss, [[Zulrah]]'s rare crystal seed drop had been encountered many times before its removal from the drop table. {{Crystal items}} [[Category:Collection log items]]

{{Infobox Construction |version1 = Regular |version2 = Raging Echoes |name = Crystalline portal nexus |image1 = [[File:Crystalline portal nexus built.gif]] |image2 = [[File:Crystalline portal nexus (Raging Echoes) built.gif]] |icon1 = [[File:Crystalline portal nexus icon.png]] |icon2 = [[File:Crystalline portal nexus (Raging Echoes) icon.png]] |furniturename = Portal Nexus |release1 = [[8 November]] [[2018]] |release2 = [[15 January]] [[2025]] |update1 = The Portal Nexus |update2 = Leagues V: Raging Echos Rewards Are Here |level = 92 |experience1 = 2,600 |experience2 = 0 |room = [[Portal nexus]] |hotspot = [[Portal nexus space]] |flatpack = No |examine1 = A gateway to your dreams. |examine2 = A raging gateway to your dreams. |id1 = 33410 |id2 = 56075 |itemid1 = 22707 |itemid2 = 30497 }} The '''crystalline portal nexus''' can be built in the [[portal nexus space]] of the [[portal nexus]] in a [[player-owned house]]. It requires 92 [[Construction]] to build and gives 2,600 [[experience]] when built. The player must have a [[hammer]] and a [[saw]] in their inventory to build it, meaning it can be built at 84 construction through the use of a [[crystal saw]] and a +5 [[spicy stew]] boost. The crystalline portal nexus can be directed to '''forty-one''' locations of a player's choosing, in which each destination directed requires 1,000 times the required [[runes]] for casting the [[teleport]] spell. Refer to the [[Portal nexus#Adding a teleport|Adding a teleport]] page for estimated rune cost per teleport and relevant information on upgrading. The crystalline portal nexus can be redecorated into a [[Raging Echoes League]]-themed portal nexus by using the [[Raging echoes nexus scroll]] on it. ==Creation== ===Upgrade=== {{Recipe |skill1 = Construction |skill1lvl = 92 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 2,600 |members = Yes |ticks = 5 |tools = Saw, Hammer |mat1 = Gilded portal nexus |mat1pic = Gilded portal nexus icon |mat1cost = 0 |mat2 = Magic stone |mat2quantity = 2 |mat3 = Gold leaf |mat3quantity = 2 |output1 = Crystalline portal nexus |output1pic = Crystalline portal nexus icon |output1cost = 0 |output1subtxt = Upgrade }} ===Total=== ''The experience shown is the total amount accumulated from the base furniture to this built furniture.'' {{Recipe |skill1 = Construction |skill1lvl = 92 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 7,200 |members = Yes |ticks = 5 |tools = Saw, Hammer |mat1 = Marble block |mat1quantity = 8 |mat2 = Magic stone |mat2quantity = 2 |mat3 = Gold leaf |mat3quantity = 4 |output1 = Crystalline portal nexus |output1pic = Crystalline portal nexus icon |output1cost = 0 |output1subtxt = Total }} ==Gallery== File:Crystalline portal nexus built.png|Static render of the crystalline portal nexus File:Crystalline portal nexus (Raging Echoes) built.png|Static render of the Raging Echoes League crystalline portal nexus ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 25 February 2026 |update = Cow Boss is Out Today! |change = The amount of destinations that can be added has been increased from 31 to 41. }} {{Subject changes |date = 19 November 2025 |update = Sailing is OUT TODAY! |change = The sizes of portal nexuses have been decreased. }} {{Subject changes |date = 3 April 2024 |update = Varlamore Tweaks & Drop Rates |change = The amount of destinations that can be added has been increased from 30 to 31. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== Regular= {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Crystalline portal nexus built v1.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Crystalline portal nexus built.png|center|300x150px]] |- |8 Nov 2018 –

Although they were in fact items, they could never be obtained by players.
These cube parts were difficult for colour-blind players to identify. As a result in 2006, the Strange box was updated to use numbers instead of colours. As a result, they have never been present in ''Old School RuneScape'' - however, they remain in the game cache.

'''Cult''' may refer to: *[[Hazeel Cult]], a [[quest]]. *The [[Cult of Hazeel]], followers of the [[Mahjarrat]] [[Hazeel]]. **[[Hazeel Cultist]]s, members of the Cult of Hazeel. *[[Humans Against Monsters]] (H.A.M.), a human-supremacist cult. *[[Voodoo Cult]], a music track unlocked in the [[Viyeldi caves]].
{{Disambig}}

{{External|rs}} [[File:Coffin (Hazeel Cult).png|thumb|width=418x418|The coffin of Hazeel.]] The '''Cult of Hazeel''' are a group of zealots who worship [[Hazeel]], a [[Zamorakian]] [[Mahjarrat]]. They play a focal part in the [[Hazeel Cult]] quest, in which they attempt to resurrect him. Their base is in a sewer found south of [[Ardougne]] and east of the [[Clock Tower (building)|Clock Tower]]. Before the player can enter, they must first correctly manipulate the sewer valves.
In the quest, players have the option to either join the cult or side with the [[Carnillean family]]; if the player joins the cult, Hazeel will successfully be resurrected. If the player opposes the cult, [[Evelot]], a member of the [[Khazard Army]], is hired to recover the [[Hazeel scroll]] and successfully does so at some point after the events of the quest, leading to Hazeel being resurrected regardless of the player's choice.
==Members== There are eight known members of the cult, not including Hazeel himself. As indicated by their dialogue and the symbols they wear, they are Zamorakians, due to the fact that Hazeel helped betray [[Zaros]] at the end of the [[Second Age]]. *[[Alomone]] *[[Clivet]] *[[Butler Jones]] *[[Hazeel Cultist]]
==See also== *[[Battle of Ardougne]] *[[Betrayal of Zaros]]
{{Hazeel Cult}} [[Category:Zamorakians]]

{{External|rs=Cup of tea (player-owned house)}} A '''cup of tea''' is a [[drink]] that [[boost]]s [[Construction]]. There are three different teas available based on the cup the tea is poured into: [[Empty cup (clay)|clay]], [[Porcelain cup (porcelain)|porcelain]], and [[Porcelain cup (trimmed)|trimmed porcelain cup]]s which boost Construction by 1, 2, and 3 respectively. Making tea requires 20 [[Cooking]], and a [[kitchen]] in a [[player-owned house]] with a built [[Stove space|stove]] that isn't a [[firepit]], a [[Larder space|larder]], a [[Sink space|sink]], and the appropriate [[Shelf space|shelves]] for the right tea cup. Making tea yields 52 Cooking [[experience]], however a [[servant]] can also make tea for the player. This type of tea cannot be put into a [[tea flask]]. '''Note:''' Leaving the player-owned house will cause all tea-related items to disappear from the inventory. ==Milky tea== A [[bucket of milk]] may also be added to any of the teas, but this only changes the image and the drink text and does not affect the stat boosting abilities. ==Tea types== Tea made at a player-owned house can boost Construction by 1-3 levels depending on the shelves in the kitchen. {|class="wikitable align-center-6 align-center-7" !colspan=2|Cup of tea !colspan=2|Cup type ![[Shelves]] !{{SCP|Construction}} Shelf !{{SCP|Construction}} Boost |- |{{plinkt|Cup of tea (clay)}} |{{plinkt|Empty cup (clay)|rowspan=2}} |rowspan="2"|[[Wooden shelves 1]]

56 |rowspan="2"|+2 |- |{{plinkt|Cup of tea (porcelain, milky)}} |- |{{plinkt|Cup of tea (trimmed)}} |{{plinkt|Porcelain cup (trimmed)|rowspan=2}} |rowspan="2"|[[Teak shelves 2]] |rowspan="2"|67 |rowspan="2"|+3 |- |{{plinkt|Cup of tea (trimmed, milky)}} |} ==Making a cup of tea== Making tea requires 20 [[Cooking]], and a [[kitchen]] in a [[player-owned house]] with a built [[Stove space|stove]] that isn't a [[firepit]], a [[Larder space|larder]], a [[Sink space|sink]], and the appropriate [[Shelf space|shelves]] for the right tea cup. Making tea yields 52 Cooking [[experience]]. {{Instructions |step1 = Take a [[kettle]], a [[teapot]], and a cup from the shelf. |step2 = Take [[tea leaves]] from the larder. |step3 = Use the kettle on the sink to fill it with water. |step4 = Use the [[full kettle]] on the stove to bring it to a boil. |step5 = Use the tea leaves on the teapot to fill the teapot. |step6 = Remove the kettle from the range once "''The kettle boils.''" in the chatbox. |step7 = Use the [[hot kettle]] on the [[teapot with leaves]] to create four servings of tea, yielding the Cooking experience. |step8 = Use the [[pot of tea]] on a cup to pour a cup of tea. |step9 = (Optional) Add a [[bucket of milk]] to the cup of tea to make it milky. }} ==Trivia== * When leaving a player-owned house the tea is deleted. Anything that causes a loading screen counts, except when enabling or disabling [[Building mode]] from inside the house. * Because this kind of tea is not tradeable, it cannot be placed on tables. {{Tea}}

revision.text:
{{external|rs}} {{Infobox Item |version1 = Regular |version2 = Milky |name = Cup of tea |image1 = [[File:Cup of tea (clay).png]] |image2 = [[File:Cup of tea (clay, milky).png]] |release = [[31 May]] [[2006]] |update = PLAYER-OWNED HOUSES! |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Drink, Empty, Drop |examine1 = A nice cup of nettle tea. |examine2 = A milky cup of nettle tea. |value = 10 |weight = 0.150 |id1 = 7730 |id2 = 7731 }} {{Synced switch |version1 = [[File:Cup of tea (clay) detail.png|left|150px]] |version2 = [[File:Cup of tea (clay, milky) detail.png|left|150px]] |version3 = [[File:Thieving tome (red) detail.png|left|130px]] }} A '''cup of tea''' is a drink made in a [[player-owned house]] by using a [[pot of tea]] on an [[Empty cup (clay)|empty clay cup]]. This requires 20 [[Cooking]] and gives 52 experience. The tea gives a 1 level [[Construction]] boost when drunk. The following shelves contain empty clay cups: *[[Wooden shelves 1]] *[[Wooden shelves 2]] *[[Oak shelves 1]]
Players can also ask their [[servant]] to serve tea, and if the best shelves in your kitchen are one of those, the servant will serve this type of tea.
A [[bucket of milk]] can be added to the tea to make a milky cup of tea. This has no effect besides changing the colour of the tea and the message when drunk.
Tea from player-owned houses can not be put into a [[tea flask]]. If a player leaves the house in any way, then this item will disappear from their inventory.
==Making a cup of tea== Making a cup of tea requires level 20 Cooking and gives the player 52 experience. The following furniture must be present in the [[kitchen]]: a built [[stove space]], a [[larder]], a [[Shelves|shelf]], and a built [[sink space]]. #Remove a [[kettle]], a [[teapot]] and one or more [[Empty cup (clay)|cup]] from the shelf. #Remove one unit of [[tea leaves]] from the larder. #Use the kettle on the built sink space to fill it with water. #Use the [[full kettle]] of water on the build stove space to bring it to a boil. #Use the tea leaves on the [[teapot]] to turn it into a [[teapot with leaves]]. #Remove the kettle from the range when the message "The kettle boils." is received. #Use the [[hot kettle]] on the [[teapot with leaves]] to create four servings of tea. This is the only step that grants Cooking experience. #Use the [[pot of tea]] on a cup to pour a cup of tea.
{{Tea}} [[Category:Temporary skill boost]] [[Category:Construction boosting items]]
