{{External|rs=Cup of tea (white)}} {{Infobox Item |version1 = Regular |version2 = Milky |name = Cup of tea |image1 = [[File:Cup of tea (porcelain).png]] |image2 = [[File:Cup of tea (porcelain, milky).png]] |release = [[31 May]] [[2006]] |update = PLAYER-OWNED HOUSES! |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Drink, Empty, Drop |examine1 = Some nettle tea in a porcelain cup. |examine2 = Some milky nettle tea in a porcelain cup. |value = 10 |weight = 0.150 |id1 = 7733 |id2 = 7734 }} {{Synced switch |version1 = [[File:Cup of tea (porcelain) detail.png|left|150px]] |version2 = [[File:Cup of tea (porcelain, milky) detail.png|left|150px]] }} A '''cup of tea''' is a drink made in a [[player-owned house]] by using a [[pot of tea]] on an [[Porcelain cup (porcelain)|empty porcelain cup]]. This requires 20 [[Cooking]] and gives 52 experience. The tea gives a 2 level [[Construction]] boost when drunk. The following shelves contain empty porcelain cups: *[[Wooden shelves 3]] *[[Oak shelves 2]] *[[Teak shelves 1]]
Players can also ask their [[servant]] to serve tea, and if the best shelves in your kitchen are one of those, the servant will serve this type of tea.
A [[bucket of milk]] can be added to the tea to make a milky cup of tea. This has no effect besides changing the colour of the tea and the message when drunk.
Tea from player-owned houses can not be put into a [[tea flask]]. If a player leaves the house in any way, then this item will disappear from their inventory.
==Making a cup of tea== Making a cup of tea requires level 20 Cooking and gives the player 52 experience. The following furniture must be present in the [[kitchen]]: a built [[stove space]], a [[larder space|larder]], a [[Shelves|shelf]], and a built [[sink space]]. #Remove a [[kettle]], a [[teapot]] and one or more [[Porcelain cup (porcelain)|cup]] from the shelf. #Remove one unit of [[tea leaves]] from the larder. #Use the kettle on the built sink space to fill it with water. #Use the [[full kettle]] of water on the built stove to bring it to a boil. #Use the tea leaves on the [[teapot]] to turn it into a [[teapot with leaves]]. #Remove the kettle from the range when the message "The kettle boils." is received. #Use the [[hot kettle]] on the [[teapot with leaves]] to create four servings of tea. This is the only step that grants Cooking experience. #Use the [[pot of tea]] on a cup to pour a cup of tea.
==Trivia== * The examine text says that this is nettle tea, however no nettles are used to make this cup of tea.
{{Tea}} [[Category:Temporary skill boost]] [[Category:Construction boosting items]]

{{External|rs=Cup of tea (gold)}} {{Infobox Item |version1 = Regular |version2 = Milky |name = Cup of tea |image1 = [[File:Cup of tea (trimmed).png]] |image2 = [[File:Cup of tea (trimmed, milky).png]] |release = [[31 May]] [[2006]] |update = PLAYER-OWNED HOUSES! |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Drink, Empty, Drop |examine1 = Some nettle tea in a porcelain cup. |examine2 = Some milky nettle tea in a porcelain cup. |value = 10 |weight = 0.150 |id1 = 7736 |id2 = 7737 }} {{Synced switch |version1 = [[File:Cup of tea (trimmed) detail.png|left|150px]] |version2 = [[File:Cup of tea (trimmed, milky) detail.png|left|150px]] }} A '''cup of tea''' is a drink made in a [[player-owned house]] by using a [[pot of tea]] on an [[Porcelain cup (trimmed)|empty trimmed porcelain cup]]. This requires 20 [[Cooking]] and gives 52 experience. The tea gives a 3 level [[Construction]] boost when drunk. [[Teak shelves 2]] are the only shelves that contain gold-trimmed cups.
Players can also ask their [[servant]] to serve tea, and if the best shelves in your kitchen are one of those, the servant will serve this type of tea.
A [[bucket of milk]] can be added to the tea to make a milky cup of tea. This has no effect besides changing the colour of the tea and the message when drunk.
Tea from player-owned houses can not be put into a [[tea flask]]. If a player leaves the house in any way, then this item will disappear from their inventory. This boost persists outside of your player-owned home.
==Making a cup of tea== Making a cup of tea requires level 20 Cooking and gives the player 52 experience. The following furniture must be present in the [[kitchen]]: a built [[stove space]], a [[larder]], a [[Shelves|shelf]], and a built [[sink space]]. #Remove a [[kettle]], a [[teapot]] and one or more [[Empty cup|cups]] from the shelf. #Remove one unit of [[tea leaves]] from the larder. #Use the kettle on the built sink space to fill it with water. #Use the [[full kettle]] of water on the built stove space to bring it to a boil. #Use the tea leaves on the [[teapot]] to turn it into a [[teapot with leaves]]. #Remove the kettle from the range when the message "The kettle boils." is received. #Use the [[hot kettle]] on the [[teapot with leaves]] to create four servings of tea. This is the only step that grants Cooking experience. #Use the [[pot of tea]] on a cup to pour a cup of tea.
==Trivia== * The examine text says that this is nettle tea, however no nettles are used to make this cup of tea.

* [[Leather boots (Mage Training Arena)|Leather boots]] * [[Adamant kiteshield (Mage Training Arena)|Adamant kiteshields]] * [[Adamant med helm (Mage Training Arena)|Adamant medium helmets]] * [[Emerald (Mage Training Arena)|Emeralds]] * [[Rune longsword (Mage Training Arena)|Rune longswords]] * Empty

{{Infobox Scenery |version1 = Closed |version2 = Open |name1 = Cupboard |name2 = Open Cupboard |image1 = [[File:Cupboard (Creature of Fenkenstrain).png|250x250px]] |image2 = [[File:Open Cupboard (Creature of Fenkenstrain).png|250x250px]] |release = [[31 January]] [[2005]] |update = Creature of Fenkenstrain |members = Yes |quest = [[Creature of Fenkenstrain]] |location = [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]] |options1 = Open |options2 = Search, Shut |examine1 = This may be worth opening. |examine2 = This may be worth searching. |map = {{Map|name=Cupboard (Creature of Fenkenstrain)|x=3546|y=3563|plane=0|zoom=3|mtype=pin|mapID=-1}} |id1 = 5156 |id2 = 5157 }} The '''cupboard''' is located within the garden shed in the northern part of [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]], and is used during the [[Creature of Fenkenstrain]] [[quest]]. During the quest, the player must search the cupboard to find a [[garden brush]]. The brush is then used to create a [[extended brush|tool]] long enough to clean a fireplace of the [[conductor mould]]. To access the cupboard initially, the player needs the [[shed key]] obtained from the [[Gardener Ghost]] to open the shed door. Once the door is opened, the key is no longer required to enter the shed. The cupboard is searchable for another garden brush during and after the quest, provided the player does not currently have one. ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 20 February 2006 |update = Updates, updates and more updates... |change = The scenery was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== Closed= {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Cupboard (Creature of Fenkenstrain) (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Cupboard (Creature of Fenkenstrain).png|center|300x150px]] |- |31 January 2005 –

{{Infobox Item |name = Curator's medallion |image = [[File:Curator's medallion.png]] |release = [[8 November]] [[2018]] |update = The Portal Nexus |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Destroy |destroy = Pay 250 rubies, 100 cosmic runes, 500 fire runes and a Digsite Pendant to the Varrock Museum curator. |examine = Used to mount a Digsite pendant in your house. |value = 0 |alchable = No |weight = 0.200 |id = 22710 }} [[File:Curator's medallion detail.png|left|150px]] A '''curator's medallion''' is used to build a [[mounted digsite pendant]] within a [[player-owned house]] [[portal nexus]] room. It is obtained from [[Curator Haig Halen]], after having discovered the [[digsite pendant]] in the [[Varrock Museum]], in exchange for 1 [[digsite pendant]] of any charge, 250 cut [[rubies]], 500 [[fire rune]]s (combination runes will not work), and 100 [[cosmic rune]]s, costing {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Ruby|250}} + {{GEP|Cosmic rune|101}} + {{GEP|Fire rune|505}} + {{GEP|Ruby necklace|1}}}} coins.
[[Curator Haig Halen]] accepts noted [[rubies]] and any amount of rubies up to 250. The digsite pendant and the runes will not be accepted until the rubies have been delivered or the player has enough in their inventory to satisfy the remaining quantity. The remaining rubies (minimum of 1), digsite pendant, and runes must all be delivered at the same time, as the final rubies will not be accepted without the rest of the required items. The ability to deliver rubies piecemeal mostly benefits [[Ultimate ironmen]] who do not have access to the noting facilities of a bank.
The medallion is lost on [[death]] even though it is an untradeable item.
The [[clean necklace]] must be found before you are given the option to deposit rubies.
The medallion will be '''lost permanently''' if destroyed. Make sure you have the appropriate Construction level to add it to your player-owned house beforehand.

Currencies are typically persistent and stackable, and can be traded for a multitude of things in exchange. {{Has quick guide}} {{Infobox Quest |name = Current Affairs |number = 176 |image = [[File:Current Affairs.png|300px]] |release = [[19 November]] [[2025]] |update = Sailing is OUT TODAY! |members = Yes |series = None |developer = }} '''Current Affairs''' is the third quest released with the [[Sailing]] skill. It involves helping [[Arhein]] get past some political red tape, and teaches the player how to track currents using a [[current duck]].
==Details== {{Quest details |start = Start the Quest by speaking to [[Arhein]] on the [[Catherby]] docks. |startmap = 2803,3432 |difficulty = Novice |description = Help [[Arhein]] get past some political red tape and unlock the [[current duck]], a useful Sailing tool. |length = Short |requirements = * {{SCP|Sailing|22|link=yes}} {{Boostable|no}} {{Questreqstart|yes}} * {{SCP|Fishing|10|link=yes}} {{Boostable|?}} {{Questreqstart|yes}} *Completion of [[Pandemonium]] |items = * [[Charcoal]] (obtainable during quest) * 50 [[Coins]] |recommended = *'''Highly recommended:''' A [[boat]] docked at the [[Catherby]] docks - you will be required to sail nearby at the end of the quest |kills = |ironman = |leagueRegion = <poem> Takes place in {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} but is inaccessible due to Sailing being unavailable in the [[Demonic Pacts League]]. </poem> }}
==Walkthrough== ===Duck troubles=== {{Needed|[[charcoal]] (obtainable during this section)}} [[File:Current Affairs - Catherby Council Office.png|thumb|The player engages with Councillor Catherine in bureaucratic combat.]] {{Map|align=right|2835,3418|mtype=pin|caption=The starting point for tracking the current.}} [[File:Councillor Catherine chathead.png|left|frameless]] Talk to [[Arhein]] on the northern end of the [[Catherby]] docks, and ask him what's with the duck. He explains that a travelling salesman claimed a duck is able to accurately track currents. Unfortunately, Arhein is unable to test that theory, as the local councillor is threatening to fine Arhein for using non-human workers. After offering your help, he suggests you might want to talk to [[Councillor Catherine]].
Find her in the council office in north-east Catherby, just north of the [[Archery shop]]. Ignoring your concerns, she points out that you are not registered as a sailor to do business in Catherby, and hands you the [[form cr-4p]] to fill in. If you didn't bring charcoal, search the [[Cabinet (Current Affairs)|cabinet]] and grab some.
Click on the form with the charcoal in your inventory, and you will be presented with a series of nonsensical questions with three options. '''You can select any responses you want, but you will need to repeat the same answers later'''. This can be simplified by simply picking the first answer every time, as the order of the answers do not change later when being quizzed. Speak to her again to return the form. She explains that any change to the by-laws requires approval from the Mayor of Catherby, but the Catherby Data Protection Regulation prevents her from sharing their location.
Return to Arhein and ask him about the mayor. He explains that the mayor recently died; there have been 25 consecutive mayors, all of which have been fish. As nobody other than Catherine wanted the job, the citizens used fish to prevent her from becoming mayor. You need to sneakily replace the latest mayor before she realises, and Arhein suggests that [[Harry]] at the nearby fishing shop could help.
===Fishing a mayor=== {{Needed|50 [[coins]]}} Harry is located in the most eastern building in Catherby. Tell him you are here about the mayor, and he will sell you a [[mayoral fishbowl]] and [[tiny net]] for 50 [[coins]]. Fish the [[Mayor of Catherby]] from one of the two [[aquarium]]s in the shop.
Show Arhein the mayor and he will give the fish a mayoral chain and tell you to return to Catherine. Speak to her and after showing the mayor, she will refuse to do anything until you've reviewed your [[form cr-4p]] and ensured all the information is correct. Repeat your answers from before.
'''Note''': If you make any mistakes, Catherine will ask you to repeat only the incorrect answers after finishing the form, allowing you to choose new responses each time until they’re correct.
After successfully confirming your answers, she gives you [[form 7r4-5h]]. Use it on the [[Mayor of catherby|Mayor of Catherby]] to sign it, then return it to Catherine to finally change the by-law.
===Charting the current=== [[File:Current duck detail.png|80px|left|frameless]] Inform Arhein that the by-law has been changed. He will hand you his duck; he wants you to take it out on the ocean to test the theory. Head east in your boat until you find a ripple in the water just west of the [[Obelisk of Water]]. While on top of the ripple, click on the current duck to track the current. Follow the duck until it arrives at the shore where [[Holgart]] is. Collect the duck and return to Arhein to tell him you've charted the currents. He thanks you for your help and lets you keep the current duck and mayor.
'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
==Rewards== {{Quest rewards |name=Prying Times |image=[[File:Current Affairs reward scroll.png|centre]] |qp=1 |rewards= *{{SCP|Sailing|1,400}} [[Sailing]] [[experience]] *{{SCP|Fishing|1,000}} [[Fishing]] [[experience]] *Access to [[Sea charting/Current]] *The [[current duck]] *The [[mayor of Catherby]] *25 [[sawmill coupon (oak plank)]] }}

==Trivia== * Forms [[Form cr-4p|cr-4p]] and [[Form 7r4-5h|7r4-5h]] spell out "crap" and "trash", respectively in [[WP:Leet|leetspeak]]. *[[Councillor Catherine]] mentions the Catherby Data Protection Regulation, which is a play on the [[WP:General Data Protection Regulation|General Data Protection Regulation]]. * [[Form cr-4p]] gives you three options for a home port: Varrock, Falador, and Edgeville. None of these cities have ports or are even on a coast. *Using [[fish food]] on the [[Mayor of Catherby]] will consume it, resulting in the message "{{Mes|The mayor accepts your generous donation to his campaign.}}" *You can place the Mayor of Catherby in your player-owned home.

Chase for current current data. |examine2 = A friendly floaty duck. Collect for current current data. |map = No |id1 = 15152 |id2 = 15153 |leagueRegion = No }} }} [[File:Current duck detail.png|130px|left]] The '''current duck''' is a friendly floaty duck who helps the player with [[Sea charting/Current|charting currents at sea]]. The ability to chart currents is unlocked upon completion of [[Current Affairs]], which requires a [[Sailing]] level of 22.
The current duck follows currents until reaching a predetermined end point indicated with message {{mes|Your current duck comes to a stop.|colour=blue}}. It will despawn two minutes after it comes to a stop. The current duck will reappear in the tools compartment of the cargo hold on a player's boat once it is placed in the water, however it will not be retrievable from there until the current one despawns or is picked up. The current duck cannot be placed in a [[menagerie]].
Telekinetic grab does not work on the current duck. [[File:Current duck location ripples.png|thumb|left|200px|Ripples at sea from which a current duck can be placed.]]
==Dialogue== {{Hastranscript|npc}}
==Trivia== * The current duck's appearance is based on that of the {{Wp|bufflehead}}, a species of sea duck native to North America. * The current duck is a reference to the {{Wp|Friendly Floatees spill}} where a variety of plastic bath toys, including ducks, washed into the Pacific Ocean and were used to study ocean current. * The triple meaning of ''current'' is referenced in the examine text of the [[lightning rod]] charting object: "Current ducks become past ducks when measuring this type of current."

{{External|rs|rsc}} {{Infobox Item |name = Curry |image = [[File:Curry.png]] |release = [[8 May]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (8 May 2002) |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |edible = Yes |options = Eat, Drop |examine = It's a spicy hot curry. |value = 20 |weight = 1.500 |exchange = Yes |id = 2011 }} [[File:Curry detail.png|left|200px]] '''Curry''' is a type of [[food]] that restores 19 [[Hitpoints]] when eaten. An empty [[bowl]] will remain after consumption. It can be obtained by cooking [[uncooked curry]] on a [[fire]] or [[cooking range]], requiring level 60 [[Cooking]] and granting 280 experience when successful. When cooking, there is a chance to fail, resulting in [[burnt curry]]. The [[burn rate]] decreases as the player's [[Cooking]] level increases, and it will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 74. At 50 [[Construction]], a [[Demon butler]] can be hired, who can serve curry in [[Player-owned house]]s. The number of curries served is equal to the number of people in the house, up to 10. Curry is popular for fighting the [[Chaos Elemental|chaos elemental]] or [[Chaos Fanatic|chaos fanatic]] as the empty [[bowl]] prevents their special attacks from un-equipping [[Worn Equipment]] due to a full inventory. ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Cooking |skill1lvl = 60 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 280 |members = Yes |ticks = 4 |facilities = Cooking range |mat1 = Uncooked curry |mat1cost = No |output1 = Curry }} {{Instructions |step1 = Add a [[potato]] to a [[bowl of water]] to make an [[incomplete stew]] |step2 = Add [[cooked meat]] or [[cooked chicken]] to the incomplete stew to make an [[uncooked stew]] |step3 = Add 1 [[spice]] or 3 [[curry leaves]] to the uncooked stew to make an [[uncooked curry]] |step4 = Cook the uncooked curry on a [[range]] to make a finished [[curry]] }} ===Cooking chance=== {{Skilling success chart|label=Curry cooking chance |label1=Fire or Range|low1=38|high1=332|req1=60|color1=gray|image1=Curry.png |label2=Hosidius +5%|low2=50|high2=344|req2=60|color2=red|image2=Curry.png |label3=Hosidius +10%|low3=63|high3=357|req3=79|color3=blue|image3=Curry.png }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Curry}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 30 January 2006 |update = Runesquares, Harpie Bugs and new potato recipes! |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Curry detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Curry detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Curry (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Curry.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
30 January 2006 |30 January 2006 ⁠–
present |} {{Bowls}} [[Category:Cooking]] [[Category:Food]]

{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Curry leaf |image = [[File:Curry leaf.png]] |release = [[11 July]] [[2005]] |update = Farming |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = I could make a spicy curry with this. |value = 19 |weight = 0.028 |exchange = Yes |id = 5970 }} [[File:Curry leaf detail.png|left|130px]] A '''curry leaf''' is a large, yellow-green leaf which can be picked from a [[curry tree]], which is grown from a [[curry tree seed]] in a [[fruit tree patch]] using the [[Farming]] skill. 42 Farming is required to grow curry trees. Farmers will look after a growing curry tree in exchange for 5 full [[Bananas|baskets of bananas]] (these may be noted). They can also be looted from [[gourmet impling|gourmet]] or [[eclectic impling]]s.
==Uses== Players may add 3 curry leaves to an [[uncooked stew]] to make an [[uncooked curry]].
[[Group of Advanced Gardeners|Gardeners]] will watch over a growing [[watermelon seed|watermelon]] or [[Ironwood tree (Farming)|Ironwood]] patch in exchange for 10 curry leaves (these may be noted).
When you put 15 Curry leaves into a [[Compost bin]], it can be used to make [[Compost]].
==Products== {{Uses material list|Curry leaf}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Curry leaf}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Curry leaf}}
{{Farming produce}} [[Category:Fruit]]

{{External|rs|rsc}} {{otheruses|the spell in the [[Standard spellbook|standard spellbook]]|the category of spells|Curse spells|the developer|Mod Curse}} {{Infobox Spell |name = Curse |image = [[File:Curse.png]] |release = [[24 May]] [[2001]] |update = New magic system online! |members = No |level = 19 |spellbook = Normal |type = Combat |exp = 29 |cost = {{RuneReq|Body=1|Earth=3|Water=2}} |speed = 5 ticks |description = Reduces your opponent's defence by 5% |anim = [[File:Curse.gif|300px]] |sound = [[File:Curse.ogg]] }} [[File:Curse icon (mobile).png|left]] '''Curse''' is a level 19 [[Magic]] [[spell]]. When cast on an opponent, their [[defence]] is reduced by 5%. The spell gives 29 [[experience]] whether it hits or misses, making it a popular way to gain experience cheaply. The spell can only be cast if the target's stats haven't already been lowered, meaning you can not stack stat reduction with multiple spells in a row.
==Cost== {{Spell cost table |Rune1 = Water |Rune1num = 2 |Rune2 = Earth |Rune2num = 3 |Rune3 = Body |Rune3num = 1 |uses_pages_water = yes }}
==Failed Cursing== {{Main|Splashing}} Casting Curse while wearing full [[metal armour]] (including an [[elemental staff]] with no more than +10 magic points) and d'hide [[vambraces]] can give a magic attack as low as -65, which guarantees a "splash," or a missed hit. This provides very cheap Magic experience, as players can instantly recast the spell on the same target. Additionally, casting Curse grants players no experience in the [[Hitpoints]] skill and, thus, is useful to [[combat pure|pures]]. The usual method is to buy the Body runes needed for the cast, as well as an appropriate amount of one of the other two runes, and using the respective staff of the third rune. An expensive alternative is to buy a [[Mud battlestaff]], which provides an unlimited supply of both Water and Earth runes. [[Snakeskin boots]] are also a recommended item to bring when splashing as they give an additional -10 magic attack.
When doing this method, it is helpful to position a monster so that it is just on the edge of your screen, so that there is minimal distance between it and your spellbook.
{{Standard spellbook}} [[Category:Defence reduction]]

Stat draining curses are rarely used as they are easily negated with [[stat restoration]] items and damage dealing or [[Stun (status)#Spells|movement blocking]] spells are better. revision.text:
{{Infobox Scenery |name = Cursed Altar |image = [[File:Cursed Altar.png|206px]] |release = [[4 July]] [[2019]] |update = Forthos Dungeon |members = Yes |quest = No |location = [[Forthos_Dungeon#Altar_of_the_Sun|Forthos Dungeon]] |options = Pray-at |examine = An altar depicting an eclipsed moon, tainted by the Shaeded Beast. |map = {{Map|name=Cursed Altar|x=1802|y=9950|mapID=32|mtype=pin}} |id = 34836 }} The '''Cursed Altar''' is an [[altar]] found in the [[Altar (Forthos Dungeon)|Altar of the Sun]] within the [[Forthos Dungeon]]. The altar is cursed as a result of the player attempting to kill [[Olbertus]], who transformed into a [[Shaeded Beast]] and laid a curse on it. When this occurs, a message will appear in the player's chatbox: "''{{Colour|#c356ef|The Shaeded Beast curses the altar blocking its connection to the Gods.}}''"
Attempting to use the cursed altar will result player's prayer being fully depleted, and the player taking 1 damage per prayer point drained with a minimum of 5 and a maximum of 30, '''this damage can be [[Death|lethal]].''' In order to lift the curse, 100 eligible dragon bones must be offered to the [[sacred bone burner]] in the Crypt of the Moon (see [[Sacred Bone Burner#Faith level|here for more info]]).
Once the curse is lifted, a message will appear in the player's chatbox stating "''You sense the dark presence from the cursed altar vanish. {{Colour|#ff0000|You will now gain prayer xp from the Bone Burner.}}''"
{{Forthos Dungeon}}

{{Infobox Location |name = Custodia Mountains |image = [[File:Custodia Mountains.png|300px]] |release = [[23 July]] [[2025]] |update = Varlamore: The Final Dawn Out Now |members = Yes |location = [[Varlamore]] |music = [[Over the Mountains]] |map = {{Map|name=Custodia Mountains|1277,3390|zoom=1}} |type = mountain |leagueRegion = Varlamore }} {{Relative location |location = Custodia Mountains |north = Kebos Lowlands |east = Auburnvale |south = Tempestus |west = The Stranglewood }}
The '''Custodia Mountains''' are a mountain range that separates [[Varlamore]] and the [[Kebos Lowlands]], which are accessible after completion of the [[Children of the Sun]] quest. They were first explored by refugees escaping from [[Xeric]] during the [[Age of Strife]]. Travel between [[Auburnvale]] and the [[Kebos Lowlands]] is possible by walking through the mountains once player has unlocked both [[Varlamore]] and [[Great Kourend]]. A closed gatehouse blocks the path to [[the Stranglewood]].
==Places of interest== ===Border bridge=== North of the mountains is the bridge connecting the [[Kebos Lowlands]] to the Kingdom of [[Varlamore]] across the border. On the southern side of the border is secured by Varlamorian [[Border Guard (Varlamore)|border guards]] and on the northern side by [[Shayzien]]'s [[Soldier (Shayzien)|soldiers]] with a [[Sergeant (Shayzien)|sergeant]].
===Custodia Pass=== [[Custodia Pass]] is a mountain pass connecting [[Auburnvale]] to Custodia's lake.
===Lake=== The central lake has rowboats to cross it, enabling travel between [[Varlamore]] and the [[Kebos Lowlands]] sides of the mountains. It also has several [[Rod Fishing spot (lure, bait)|fly fishing spots]] on both sides.
===Mine=== [[Custodia Mountains mine|A mine]] north of the central lake contains [[iron rocks]], [[coal rocks]], [[mithril rocks]]. Four [[yew tree]]s can be found nearby.
===Stalker Den=== The [[Stalker Den]] dungeon can be found within the mountain range, accessible during and after the [[Shadows of Custodia]] quest, containing [[custodian stalker]]s that can be slain with varying [[Slayer]] requirements of 54, 67, and 76.
==Inhabitants== * [[Alpaca]] and their [[Alpaca cria|cria]] * [[Bat]] (level 6) * [[Bear Cub]] (level 15) * [[Black bear]] (level 19) * [[Border Guard (Varlamore)]] * [[Giant bat]] (level 6) * [[Grizzly bear]] (level 21) * [[Harpy eagle]] * [[Lynx]] (level 24) * [[Rabbit]] (level 2) * [[Sergeant (Shayzien)]] (level 84) * [[Soldier (Shayzien)]] (level 21) * [[Stag]] (level 15)
==Music== {{MusicList |Over the Mountains|This track unlocks in the Custodia Mountains. |Rugged Terrain|This track unlocks near the bridge border. }}
==Trivia== * Given how strongly [[Varlamore]] is influenced by Mesoamerican and South American civilizations, it is likely that the Custodia Mountains are partially inspired by the real world {{wp|Andes Mountains}}. * "Custodia" is a Latin word that means "guardian" or "safekeeping". As such, the name carries a deeper meaning given the mountains' role in the refugees' escape.
{{Varlamore}} {{Terrain}} [[Category:Terrain]]

revision.text:
'''Customer Support''' is the division of [[Jagex]] staff that interacts with [[account|players]]. They normally investigate [[abuse report]]s and [[rsw:Account Status|offence appeals]]. They also help out players with their technical problems and send them messages regarding their ''[[RuneScape]]'' accounts. Customer Support should NOT be used for quest help, walkthroughs etc. Additionally, the Community Forums are a good place to turn to if you are having problems.
==Overview== Customer Support helps players with technical, account and other issues regarding ''RuneScape''. There are 10 categories that everything falls into:
*'''Rules of Runescape''': Gives information on the in-game rules about ''RuneScape'', and the reasons why Jagex has these rules.
*'''Offence Appeals''': This provides information on what to do if your account receives a blackmark.
*'''Billing''': This gives information on payment options and billing for Membership.
*'''Reporting Bugs''': Information on bugs and glitches, and what to do to report them.
*'''Safety & Security Guidelines''': Information regarding protection for yourself and your computer.
*'''Password Support''': Lists information for passwords.
*'''Locked Account Recovery:''' Guidelines on what to do when your account is locked.
*'''Reporting Abuse''': Information about the Report Abuse system.
*'''Technical''': Java errors and problems regarding ''RuneScape'' and their solutions are listed here.
*'''Other''': Information that did not fit in the categories above goes here.
==See also== *[[rsw:Customer support updates|Customer Support updates]]
[[Category:Jagex]]

{{External|rs|rsc=Customs Officer}} {{Infobox NPC |version1 = Travel |version2 = Locations |name = Customs officer |image = [[File:Customs officer.png|250x250px]] |release = [[11 June]] [[2001]] |update = The island of Karamja is open |members = No |race = [[Human]] |location = [[Musa Point]] |gender = Female |options1 = Talk-to, Travel |options2 = Talk-to, Port Sarim, The Pandemonium |examine = Inspects peoples' packages. |map = {{Map|name=Customs officer|x=2950|y=3151|r=12|mtype=square}} |id1 = 14984 |id2 = 14985 |leagueRegion = Karamja }} [[File:Customs officer chathead.png|left]] A '''customs officer''' is found on [[Karamja]] at the port at [[Musa Point]]. The player must talk to her in order to take a boat back to [[Port Sarim]]. It costs 30 [[coins]] to depart. If a player is wearing the [[Karamja gloves]], the cost is lowered to 15 coins. Before the player leaves, she will search the player for any banned substances, such as [[Karamjan rum]]. If the player has any on themselves, it will be confiscated. Since this [[Items|item]] is necessary in the [[Pirate's Treasure]] [[Quests|quest]], the player must find some way to smuggle it past her. If the player has a [[ring of charos (a)]], the player can charm the customs officer into letting the player ride for free. ==Dialogue== {{Hastranscript|npc}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 22 May 2006 |update = Royal Trouble |change = *The NPC was graphically updated with the rework of Pirate's Treasure. *The "Pay-Fare" option was added, allowing for quick travel. }} {{Subject changes |date = 22 June 2005 |update = Rogues Den + Tweaks |change = The NPC's appearance was altered again with the second rework of female bodykits. }} {{Subject changes |date = 31 May 2005 |update = New Female Bodykit |change = The NPC's appearance was altered with the rework of female bodykits. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Customs officer (historical v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Customs officer (historical v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Customs officer (historical v3).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Customs officer.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Customs officer chathead (historical).png]] |[[File:Customs officer chathead (historical).png]] |[[File:Customs officer chathead (historical).png]] |[[File:Customs officer chathead.png]] |- |29 March 2004 –

revision.text:
{{Switch infobox |text1 = Cuthbert |item1 = {{Infobox NPC |name = Cuthbert |image = [[File:Cuthbert.png|290px]] |release = [[20 March]] [[2024]] |update = Varlamore: Part One |members = Yes |quest = [[The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute]] |location = [[Locus Oasis]] |options = Talk-to |examine = A rather large frog. |map = {{Map|x=1685|y=3003|r=3|mtype=square}} |id = 12955 |leagueRegion = Varlamore }} |text2 = Cuthbert, Lord of Dread |item2 = {{Infobox Monster |name = Cuthbert, Lord of Dread |image = [[File:Cuthbert.png|290px]] |release = [[20 March]] [[2024]] |update = Varlamore: Part One |members = Yes |combat = 1 |size = 1 |examine = Seems he could swim after all. |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 1 |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Crush]] |attack speed = 4 |hitpoints = 1 |att = 1 |str = 1 |def = 1 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |dlight = 0 |dstandard = 0 |dheavy = 0 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |id = 12957 |leagueRegion = Varlamore }} }} [[File:Cuthbert chathead.png|left]] '''Cuthbert''' is a talking frog north of [[Locus Oasis]]. Along with [[Gary]], [[Dave]], [[Jane]], and [[Sue]], Cuthbert is on strike over labour disputes with [[Marcellus]] that go back generations.
During the quest [[The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute]], the player is tasked with sabotaging Cuthbert during the frogs' election, resulting in Cuthbert's apparent death. Later on in the quest, Cuthbert returns as the self-proclaimed '''Lord of Dread''', whom the player must vanquish in pitched combat. [[Attack 6]] is heard during the fight with Cuthbert.
Although highly unlikely under most circumstances, Cuthbert, Lord of Dread is capable of damaging and killing the player. Additionally, Cuthbert can be killed with recoil damage. [[File:Dreadfully dangerous Cuthbert.gif|left|thumb|Despite the player's best efforts, Cuthbert, Lord of Dread's all-powerful attack slew them instantly.]]
==Dialogue== {{Hastranscript|speaksin}}
==Trivia== *During the [[Raging Echoes League]], players with the [[Guardian (Raging Echoes League)|Guardian]] relic had a very rare chance to summon the Echo Cuthbert [[Guardian thrall (Raging Echoes League)#Echo Cuthbert|guardian thrall]] when blowing the [[Guardian horn (Raging Echoes League)#Echo Cuthbert|guardian horn]], this also applies to [[Gridmaster]]'s [[Guardian]] relic. [[File:Guardian horn summoning (Gridmaster).webm|thumb|250px|left|loop|autoplay|A player blows the guardian horn to summon Echo Cuthbert.]] *It's possible that Cuthbert's name in conjunction with the title of the quest is intended as a reference to the character Cuthbert Lilly from the British children's TV show {{WP|ZZZap!}} *Cuthbert could also be a reference to Saint Cuthbert who lived on a small tidal islet near Lindisfarne—now known as St. Cuthbert's Isle—where he lived in a stone-walled cell.
{{The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute}} {{Avium Savannah}}
[[Category:Quest monsters]]

{{External|rs}} {{stub}} [[File:Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf drinking.png|thumb|250px|A cutscene that is played during [[Forgettable Tale...]]]] A '''cutscene''' is an animated sequence usually occurring during a [[quests|quest]] in which a player has no control, and are often used to show the storyline of a certain quest. Cutscenes also occur during some [[transportation]] sequences such as [[charter ship]]s, the [[eagle transport system]] and [[canoe]]s.
During a cutscene, a player cannot talk, move, or click on most things to perform actions they can normally do, except examining objects or [[Non-player character]]s. Although in some cutscenes, the player will say something above their heads without typing it.
There are currently only a few possible cutscenes that can be re-watched: *The [[Burning brazier]] replays cutscenes from [[Monkey Madness II]]. *The [[Pool of Dreams]] replays cutscenes from [[Dragon Slayer II]]. *The [[Draynor bank robbery]] can be replayed by speaking to the banker outside [[Draynor Village]] bank by paying 50gp per viewing. *The [[Memoriam Device]] replays cutscenes from [[Song of the Elves]]. *The introduction to Construction cutscene from [[Daddy's Home]] can be replayed by speaking to [[Old Man Yarlo]] after completion of the miniquest.

{{External|rs=Cyan crystal}} {{otheruses|the quest item used during [[Mourning's End Part II]]|the [[unobtainable item]]|Cyan crystal (Tale of the Righteous, interface item)}} {{Infobox Item |name = Cyan crystal |image = [[File:Cyan crystal (Mourning's End Part II).png]] |release = [[17 October]] [[2005]] |update = Mourning's Ends Pt II |members = Yes |quest = [[Mourning's End Part II]] |tradeable = No |bankable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Destroy |destroy = Resetting the light maze will generate a new crystal. |examine = A cyan crystal. |value = 1 |alchable = No |weight = 0.015 |id = 6643 }} [[File:Cyan crystal (Mourning's End Part II) detail.png|left|150px]] The '''cyan crystal''' is a [[quest item]] used in the [[Mourning's End Part II]] [[quest]]. It is obtained by solving the first part of the light puzzle in the [[Temple of Light]], found upon searching the chest in the blue room. It is needed in order to progress further through the puzzle.
Interestingly, whenever you attempt to alchemise the crystal with any alchemy spell, elven magic forbids it and a message will appear saying "You can't do that to elven crystal!".
Upon finishing the quest, the cyan crystal is the only remaining piece of the puzzle left in the player's inventory.
Furthermore, trying to bank it will result in the message: "Some of your items cannot be stored in the bank.", so it is recommended to destroy it, as it has no further use.
You can leave it in a pillar ''before'' completing the quest, certainly it is not possible afterwards, attempting to gives the message "The Temple of Light's safeguards are working fine for now, so I'd best not meddle with them." Destroying it gives the message "Resetting the light maze will generate a new crystal".
==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Cyan crystal (Mourning's End Part II)}}
{{Mourning's End Part II}}

revision.text:
{{External|rs}} {{Infobox NPC |name = Cyreg Paddlehorn |image = [[File:Cyreg Paddlehorn.png|130px]] |release = [[10 January]] [[2005]] |update = In Search Of The Myreque |members = Yes |race = [[Human]] |quest = [[In Search of the Myreque]] |location = [[Mort'ton]] |gender = Male |options = Talk-to |examine = A tall and imposing man who's more than familiar with boating. |map = {{Map|name=Cyreg Paddlehorn|x=3519|y=3284|r=3|mtype=square}} |id = 5046 |leagueRegion = Morytania }} [[File:Cyreg Paddlehorn chathead.png|left]] '''Cyreg Paddlehorn''' is the boatman and an associate of [[the Myreque]]. He can be found to the south-east of the town of [[Mort'ton]], near the bridge leading to the [[Barrows]]. After gaining his trust during the [[In Search of the Myreque]] [[Quests|quest]], Cyreg will offer to ferry players to an area in the centre of [[Mort Myre Swamp]], near [[the Hollows]], for the small price of ten [[coins]]; those wearing a [[ring of charos|ring of charos(a)]] can charm him into giving rides for free. In addition, although Cyreg himself is not present at the end point near the Hollows, [[Swamp Boaty|his boat]] can still be used to travel from there to Mort'ton, free of charge, serving as a handy shortcut to the southern parts of [[Morytania]], sparing players from a long journey through the swampland as well as attacks by [[ghast]]s, [[leech]]es and [[Feral Vampyre|feral vampyres]]. ==Dialogue== {{hastranscript|NPC}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 9 November 2017 |update = The Queen of Thieves & The Depths of Despair |change = Cyreg Paddlehorn no longer stands in such a curious pose. }} {{Subject changes |date = 17 July 2006 |update = Pyramid Plunder |change = The NPC's cross was removed. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Cyreg Paddlehorn (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Cyreg Paddlehorn v1.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Cyreg Paddlehorn.png|center|300x150px]] |- |10 January 2005 –
17 July 2006 |17 July 2006 –
9 November 2017 |9 November 2017 –
present |} ==Trivia== *After the [[In Search of the Myreque]] [[Quests|quest]], if a player speaks to Cyreg, he will say that he feels guilty for telling the player how to get to the [[Myreque Hideout]] because the player had unknowingly led [[Vanstrom Klause|Vanstrom]] straight to their hideout, which caused [[Sani Piliu]] and [[Harold Evans]] to be killed by Vanstrom. *Cyreg is the only fully human [[Non-player character|NPC]] in [[Mort'ton]], with the exception of [[Dampe]] and the [[afflicted]] members of the town cured during the [[Shades of Mort'ton]] quest. Despite this, neither the [[Loar Shade]]s nor the afflicted seem to have any interest in him. {{The Myreque}} {{In Search of the Myreque}}

[[File:Cyrisus (meleer) chathead.png|left]] }} '''Cyrisus''' is located deep in the [[Lunar Isle mine]], where he has been unconscious for some time. In [[Dream Mentor]], the [[player]] nurses him back to good health, but only known to the player at that point as "Fallen Man", by providing him with food and words of encouragement, until he is well enough to reveal to the player who he is. He requests that the player fetch him his favourite outfit from his bank, depending on what the player's [[combat level]] is based on.
Once he is dressed he reveals that he is incredibly skilled, being able to smith full sets of [[rune armour]], bake [[summer pie]]s and grow [[spirit tree]]s, and with a combat level of 126, he has 99 in most if not all combat skills. However, he is mortally afraid of combat. He says he got his skills by killing 300 [[chicken]]s a day for 30 years. The [[Oneiromancer]] suggests that the player help Cyrisus overcome this fear by entering [[Dream World]] with him to help him conquer his fears. Once the player enters Cyrisus's dreamland and vanquishes [[The Inadequacy|his feelings of inadequacy]], [[The Everlasting|inability to endure]], [[The Untouchable|pacifism]], [[The Illusive|inexperience]] and [[A Doubt|other doubts]] Cyrisus has, he overcomes his fear of combat. By way of thanks, he shares with the player [[experience|some knowledge]] he picked up during his time on Lunar Isle.
After Cyrisus leaves, his newfound lust for battle takes over. If the player [[NPC Contact|talks to him]] he will either be killing the [[Kalphite Queen]] with some Slayer masters, fighting [[TzTok-Jad]], or attending a meeting with various leaders of [[Gielinor]]. Since most of the time he's travelling around [[Gielinor]] looking for new adventures, it is impossible to find him at a specific location. In order to contact him you must use the [[NPC Contact]] lunar spell.
In [[While Guthix Sleeps]], he is recruited by the player to join a task force against Lucien. During the battle with Lucien, he is killed by Lucien's black instant kill spell. Following the quest, if the player attempts to contact Cyrisus with [[NPC Contact]], they will be met with the message: ''You take a moment of silence in honour of your fallen friend, Cyrisus.''
==Dialogue== {{hastranscript|NPC}}
==Trivia== *At the beginning of Dream Mentor, trying to give Cyrisus specific foods will give special dialogue. **Using [[purple sweets]] gives the message "Sweets? You do know they rot your teeth?" **Using [[cave nightshade]] gives the message "How evil! Are you trying to kill him!?" **Using a [[pumpkin]] gives the message "He doesn't look like he's into pumpkins." **Using an [[easter egg]] gives the message "Now is not the time for fancy chocolate." **Using a [[poison karambwan]] gives the message "How mean are you? You're supposed to be helping him!" *Cyrisus meeting with the leaders of Gielinor may be a possible reference to the [[Recipe for Disaster]] questline. *Killing 300 chickens a day for 30 years, accounting for leap years, roughly amounts to 3,287,100 chickens. If Cyrisus truly trained in this manner, he would have acquired enough experience to reach 99 in three combat skills, 62 in a fourth, as well as 99 [[Hitpoints]], 99 [[Prayer]] by burying 2,896,541 [[bones]], and 99 [[Cooking]] by successfully cooking 434,499 [[raw chicken|raw chickens]], in addition to easily having the materials to reach 99 [[Fletching]] and [[Woodcutting]] solely through the creation of [[headless arrow|headless arrows]] while having more than enough [[feather|feathers]] left over to reach 99 [[Fishing]] through [[fly fishing]]. *Despite being afraid of combat, Cyrisus still managed to obtain an [[Abyssal whip|Abyssal Whip]] and [[Barrows equipment]], which are obtained from [[Slayer]] monsters and the [[Barrows]] [[Minigames|minigame]], respectively. It is likely that he simply purchased the items from someone else. *Cyrisus's equipment during While Guthix Sleeps may be a reference to the equipment worn by an infamous player during the [[rsw:Falador Massacre|Falador Massacre]]. The player was notably wearing [[Ahrim's robetop]], [[Ahrim's robeskirt|robeskirt]], and an [[abyssal whip]] during the event. This equipment could be seen worn by [[Durial321]] during the [[World 666 event]]. *Cyrisus's bank is openable and seen during the [[Dream Mentor]] quest. As the player is required to take items out, place them in a chest and bring them to Cyrisus, the items inside his bank or the chest cannot be kept. The items shown are worth approximately {{Coins|{{GEP|Logs}}+{{GEP|Dragon chainbody}}+{{GEP|Ahrim's robetop}}+{{GEP|Karil's leathertop}}+{{GEP|Vial of water}}+{{GEP|Chisel}}+{{GEP|Antipoison(1)}}+{{GEP|Lobster}}+{{GEP|Hammer}}+{{GEP|Knife}}+{{GEP|Magic logs|1464}}+{{GEP|Empty plant pot}}+{{GEP|Strength potion(2)}}+{{GEP|Dragon med helm}}+{{GEP|Splitbark helm}}+{{GEP|Robin hood hat}}+230000+{{GEP|Abyssal whip}}+{{GEP|Ancient staff}}+{{GEP|Magic shortbow}}+{{GEP|Ranarr weed|594}}+{{GEP|Shark}}+{{GEP|Bucket}}+{{GEP|Rope}}+{{GEP|Torag's platelegs}}+{{GEP|Ahrim's robeskirt}}+{{GEP|Black d'hide chaps}}+{{GEP|Infinity boots}}+{{GEP|Ranger boots}}+{{GEP|Adamant boots}}+{{GEP|Air rune|52584}}+{{GEP|Blood rune|3524}}+{{GEP|Cosmic rune|9864}}}} [[coins]]. It also contains [[A small key|the key]] used to unlock [[Elena]]'s cell in [[Plague City]] and a [[Bird nest (seeds, 2005-2019)|now-discontinued bird nest variant]]. '''Dragonhide bodies''' are a type of [[Ranged armour]] worn in the [[torso slot]]. 40 [[Defence]] is required to wear those armour pieces in addition to a certain [[Ranged]] level, depending on the type of dragonhide. [[Dragon Slayer I]] is also required to wear the [[green body]]. They can be [[Crafting|crafted]] using three [[dragon leather]]s of appropriate colour.
==Types of d'hide bodies== *[[Green d'hide body]] - Requires 40 [[Ranged]] to wear. Can be crafted at 63 Crafting. [[Green d'hide body (t)|Trimmed]] and [[Green d'hide body (g)|gold-trimmed]] versions are also available. *[[Blue d'hide body]] - Requires 50 Ranged to wear. Can be crafted at 71 Crafting. [[Blue d'hide body (t)|Trimmed]] and [[Blue d'hide body (g)|gold-trimmed]] versions are also available. *[[Red d'hide body]] - Requires 60 Ranged to wear. Can be crafted at 77 Crafting. [[Red d'hide body (t)|Trimmed]] and [[Red d'hide body (g)|gold-trimmed]] versions are also available. *[[Hueycoatl hide body]] - Requires 70 Ranged to wear. Can be crafted at 78 Crafting. [[Hueycoatl hide|Hide]]s do not need to be tanned into [[dragon leather|leather]] to craft with. *[[Black d'hide body]] - Requires 70 Ranged to wear. Can be crafted at 84 Crafting. [[Black d'hide body (t)|Trimmed]] and [[Black d'hide body (g)|gold-trimmed]] versions are also available.
==[[Blessed body|Blessed d'hide bodies]]== These all have the same offensive stats of [[Black d'hide body]], more defensive stats, and an additional +1 [[prayer bonus]]. They can be obtained by completing a [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard]] [[Treasure Trail]]. *[[Ancient d'hide body]] *[[Armadyl d'hide body]] *[[Bandos d'hide body]] *[[Guthix d'hide body]] *[[Saradomin d'hide body]] *[[Zamorak d'hide body]]
{{Disambig}}

'''Dragonhide chaps''' are a type of [[Ranged armour]] worn in the [[leg slot]]. Dragonhide chaps only require a certain [[Ranged]] level, depending on the type of dragonhide. This means [[combat pure]] players can take advantage of their bonuses. They can be [[Crafting|crafted]] using two [[dragon leather]]s of appropriate colour.
==Types of d'hide chaps== *[[Green d'hide chaps]] - Requires 40 [[Ranged]] to wear. Can be crafted at 60 Crafting. [[Green d'hide chaps (t)|Trimmed]] and [[Green d'hide chaps (g)|gold-trimmed]] versions are also available. *[[Blue d'hide chaps]] - Requires 50 [[Ranged]] to wear. Can be crafted at 68 Crafting. [[Blue d'hide chaps (t)|Trimmed]] and [[Blue d'hide chaps (g)|gold-trimmed]] versions are also available. *[[Red d'hide chaps]] - Requires 60 [[Ranged]] to wear. Can be crafted at 75 Crafting. [[Red d'hide chaps (t)|Trimmed]] and [[Red d'hide chaps (g)|gold-trimmed]] versions are also available. *[[Black d'hide chaps]] - Requires 70 [[Ranged]] to wear. Can be crafted at 82 Crafting. [[Black d'hide chaps (t)|Trimmed]] and [[Black d'hide chaps (g)|gold-trimmed]] versions are also available.
==[[Blessed chaps]]== These all have the stats of [[Black d'hide chaps]], with an additional +1 [[prayer bonus]]. They can be obtained from completing a level 3 or 4 [[Treasure Trail]]. *[[Guthix chaps]] *[[Saradomin chaps]] *[[Zamorak chaps]] *[[Armadyl chaps]] *[[Bandos chaps]] *[[Ancient chaps]]
{{Disambig}}

In the quest, he should be given the [[ethenea]]. Prior to the quest, Da Vinci can only be found near the [[Chemist's house]] in [[Rimmington]], working on a [[Easel (scenery)|painting]] of a nearby island. After the quest, he can be found in both Rimmington and the [[Dancing Donkey Inn]] in [[Varrock]]. He is always accompanied by his associates [[Hops (Biohazard)|Hops]] and [[Chancy]]. He is also featured in the [[2018 Birthday event]], where he seeks the player's help to complete a display set so that he can paint a picture of it. {{Has quick guide|mini=1}} {{Infobox Miniquest |name = Daddy's Home |image = [[File:Daddy's Home.png|300px]] |release = [[26 August]] [[2020]] |update = Mahogany Homes |members = Yes |series = None |developer = Ashleigh B{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1367490819834466314|date=4 March 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/104407|archivedate=9 April 2022}} }} '''Daddy's Home''' is a [[miniquest]] released with the [[Mahogany Homes]] update, in which the player helps [[Old Man Yarlo|Marlo's father]] renovate a recently squatted house. ==Details== {{Quest details |description = Marlo's father requires someone to refurnish his disastrous house. |start = Speak to [[Marlo]] in the Estate Agent's house in north-east Varrock. |startmap = 3240,3474 |difficulty = Novice |length = Short |members = Yes |requirements = None |items = *10 [[plank]]s – (oak/teak/mahogany will '''not''' work) *5 [[bolts of cloth]] (can be bought from the [[Sawmill]] for 650 coins per bolt) *At least 16 [[nails]] of any type, e.g. [[steel nails]] (more are recommended as nails bend when building furniture. 100 is recommended at 1 [[Construction]], obtainable from the [[Sawmill]] during the quest) *[[Hammer]] (Obtainable during the quest from Yarlo) *[[Saw]] (Obtainable during the quest) |recommended = *Fast travel to several locations **[[Varrock]] to start the quest - [[Varrock Teleport]] or [[Ring of wealth]] to [[Grand Exchange]] or [[Skills necklace]] to [[Cooks' Guild]] or [[Chronicle]] **[[Lumberyard]] east of [[Varrock]] (1 trip) - [[Lumberyard Teleport]] or [[Ring of the elements]] to [[Earth Altar]] |leagueRegion = Not completable, as it requires access to Misthalin. }} ==Walkthrough== {{Map|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=Map for the miniquest |3240,3473,title:[[Marlo]],desc: |3240,3394,title:[[Old Man Yarlo]],desc: |3303,3493,title:[[Sawmill operator]],desc: }} ===Starting out=== Begin the miniquest by speaking to [[Marlo]] in the house of the [[Varrock]] [[Estate Agent]] in north-east Varrock. He will ask you if you would be willing to complete an off-the-books favour for him by helping his father renovate his recently acquired house, explaining that the landlord isn't exactly aware of his presence there. He will direct you to [[Old Man Yarlo]] in his house in south-east Varrock, south-west of [[Aubury's Rune Shop]]. There is a saw on the ground in the same building as Marlo. ===Yarlo's house=== '''''Items required:''' 10 [[planks]], 5 [[bolt of cloth|bolts of cloth]], a [[hammer]], and a [[saw]].''
'''''Items recommended:''' At least 60 [[nails]] of any type.'' Speak to [[Old Man Yarlo]] and he'll ask you to remove all of the old furniture in the house: a chair, a carpet, two tables, two stools, and his campbed. You must right click the carpet for the option to remove to appear. If you interrupt the cutscene you will have to rewatch it. Once this is done, speak with him again to be given the option to view a cutscene showing the wonders of the Construction skill, or skip it to watch later. Once this is done, Old Man Yarlo will ask you to build him new furniture. Everything except the bed can be built now, however the bed requires a special type of wood; search the [[crates (Daddy's Home)|crates]] in the kitchen to receive three [[waxwood log]]s, and bring them to the [[sawmill]]. [[File:Daddy's Home - removing daddy's furniture.png|thumb|300px|Removing furniture from the residence.]] {| class="wikitable" !Furniture!!Item requirements !Experience |- |Carpet||3 bolts of cloth |45 xp |- |2 wooden stools||2 planks and 4 nails in total |30 xp per stool |- |2 wooden tables||6 planks and 8 nails in total |87 xp per table |- |Wooden chair||2 planks and 2 nails |58 xp |- |Waxwood bed||3 waxwood planks and 2 bolts of cloth |207 xp |} ===Finishing up=== '''''Items required:''' 3 [[waxwood log]]s.'' Go to the [[Varrock sawmill]] and talk to the [[sawmill operator]] to receive 3 [[waxwood plank]]s. Since he knows of Old Man Yarlo, he'll provide them free of charge. Return to Old Man Yarlo's home and build the new furniture (chair, carpet, two tables, two stools, and the bed). Speak to [[Old Man Yarlo]] again, he'll thank you and offer the player the basics and benefits of [[Construction]]. Finally, return to [[Marlo]] to claim your reward. ==Reward== *{{SCP|Construction|400|link=yes}} experience **An additional {{SCP|Construction|544|link=yes}} experience is gained when building the furniture, for a total of 944 experience. *A [[player-owned house]] in [[Rimmington]] or 1,000 [[coins]] if you already own one. *[[Marlo's crate]], which contains 25 [[plank]]s, 50 [[mithril nails]], 5 [[steel bar]]s, 10 [[oak plank]]s, 8 [[Bolt of cloth|bolts of cloth]], 5 [[Teleport to house (tablet)|house teleports]], and 1 [[Falador teleport (tablet)|Falador teleport]], a total value of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Plank|25}}+{{GEP|Mithril nails|50}}+{{GEP|Steel bar|5}}+{{GEP|Oak plank|10}}+{{GEP|Bolt of cloth|8}}+{{GEP|Teleport to house (tablet)|5}}+{{GEP|Falador teleport (tablet)|1}}|c}}. ==Transcript== {{Hastranscript|miniquest}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Daddy's Home}} {{Miniquests}}

He can be found upstairs in the eastern wing of the [[Sisterhood Sanctuary]], just north of the [[The Nightmare]]'s arena.
Daer Krand came to the Sanctuary to research the [[Elixir of Everlasting]], a legendary potion that is said to extend the drinker's life indefinitely. However, being more adept in magic than [[Herblore]], he has a difficult time trying to recreate the potion.
During [[A Night at the Theatre]], the player seeks him out after finding his dead assistant in the [[Morytania Spider Cave]] on their quest to find some [[strange spider eggs]]. Daer Krand gives the player a bottle of [[Sulphuric acid]] to be able to get to the eggs sealed in the strong web back in the spider lair.

{{Infobox Monster |version1 = Prime |version2 = Rex |version3 = Supreme |name1 = Dagannoth Prime (Echo) |name2 = Dagannoth Rex (Echo) |name3 = Dagannoth Supreme (Echo) |image1 = [[File:Dagannoth Prime (Echo).png|190px]] |image2 = [[File:Dagannoth Rex (Echo).png|190px]] |image3 = [[File:Dagannoth Supreme (Echo).png|x300px]] |release = [[27 November]] [[2024]] |update = Leagues V: Raging Echoes OUT NOW! |removal = [[22 January]] [[2025]] |removalupdate = Bank QoL & Mini Menu Improvements |members = Yes |combat1 = 454 |combat2 = 454 |combat3 = 681 |size = 3 |examine1 = A legendary dagannoth king, rumoured to fly on the North winds. |examine2 = Firstborn of the legendary dagannoth kings. |examine3 = The dagannoth king responsible for the death of the Bukalla. |attributes = <!-- if no monster attributes apply, remove this parameter --> |xpbonus = |max hit1 = At least 49 |max hit2 = 48+ |max hit3 = 26 |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = No |attack style1 = [[Magic]] |attack style2 = [[Slash]] |attack style3 = [[Ranged]] |attack speed = 5 |slaylvl = None |slayxp1 = 2475 <!-- if not a slayer monster, remove this parameter --> |slayxp2 = <!-- if not a slayer monster, remove this parameter --> |slayxp3 = <!-- if not a slayer monster, remove this parameter --> |cat = Bosses, Dagannoth |assignedby = vannaka,chaeldar,konar,nieve,duradel |hitpoints1 = 1800 |hitpoints2 = 1800 |hitpoints3 = 1,800 |att1 = 255 |att2 = 400 |att3 = 255 |str1 = 255 |str2 = 400 |str3 = 128 |def = 255 |mage1 = 400 |mage2 = 0 |mage3 = 255 |range1 = 0 |range2 = 255 |range3 = 550 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab1 = 100 |dstab2 = 100 |dstab3 = 10 |dslash1 = 100 |dslash2 = 100 |dslash3 = 10 |dcrush1 = 100 |dcrush2 = 100 |dcrush3 = 10 |dmagic1 = 100 |dmagic2 = 10 |dmagic3 = 100 |dlight1 = 10 |dlight2 = 100 |dlight3 = 150 |dstandard1 = 10 |dstandard2 = 100 |dstandard3 = 150 |dheavy1 = 10 |dheavy2 = 100 |dheavy3 = 150 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 100 |id1 = override2266 |id2 = override2267 |id3 = override2265 |leagueRegion = Fremennik }} The '''Echo Dagannoth Kings''' are a more challenging variant of the [[Dagannoth Kings]] that are accessible during the [[Demonic Pacts League]]. To fight them, the player must carry a [[Fremennik echo orb]], which is dropped by the Dagannoth Kings.
==Mechanics== The fight consists of echo variants of [[Dagannoth Prime (Echo)|Dagannoth Prime]], [[Dagannoth Supreme (Echo)|Dagannoth Supreme]] and [[Dagannoth Rex (Echo)|Dagannoth Rex]]. The Echo kings share a health pool of 1,800 [[hitpoints]]. All three are immediately aggressive regardless of where the player is standing in the arena. They will be off-ticked, allowing you to pray against all three of them. They follow a 5-tick attack cycle; on the first tick Prime attacks with magic, the second tick Supreme with ranged, the third tick Rex with melee, then no attacks for the final two ticks. If Rex's attack is staggered, he will delay himself to align back on sync with the other Kings' attacks.
Upon spawning, Prime and Rex will simultaneously use all three protection prayers, while Supreme will have no prayers. Every 250 damage taken, the cave will rumble and the surrounding [[spinolyp]]s will launch spines across the arena, including one aimed at the player's position when used. Standing on poison will deal 6-7 damage every tick and inflict a poison status that starts at 2 damage. Unlike those in the standard and slayer caves, these are not attackable. Additionally, the Kings will swap prayers. Rex will be next in line to drop prayers, then the next instance will be Prime, after which it loops back to Supreme.
Upon reaching 350 health, the enrage phase begins; all of the Kings will drop their prayers, and poison will start to fall every 4th tick right after the melee hit. Once the health pool is fully depleted, all three Kings will die.
==Strategy== Use Prime to time your prayer switches. Damage is calculated when the animation starts, so if you are not praying properly at that time, you will take damage. A lot of mistakes with prayer switching happen due to panic or moving too fast, so try to get used to the rhythm instead.
Since the fight operates on a consistent 5 tick cycle, the following pattern can be followed always and is necessary for the enrage phase:
Starting the cycle with Pray Mage up and on Prime's animation tick:
# Switch to Ranged # Switch to Melee # Switch to Magic (Prepares for the next cycle) # Move (to avoid acid) # Click to attack (This tick is a 1-tick pause from the DKS)
Acid is only ever thrown during Prime's attack and, during phase 1, only at set health intervals.
Follow the 1 action per cycle rule. During phase 1, there is a 2-tick window where the player does not have to worry about prayer switching. Use that to relax.
During enrage, if you find yourself in poison, do not panic. It does not do that much damage (5 damage per tick). Stay on cycle and move out during the next cycle. Missing a prayer switch will cost a lot more health.
== Tips == Players should keep combo food in the event of a missed prayer, as the Kings can deal quite high damage.
Like the original, Echo Rex is not immune to binds and players who are struggling to flick all three Kings can choose to freeze him with (if playing {{DPIcon|Desert}}, {{DPIcon|Wilderness}} or have the [[Grimoire (Demonic Pacts League)|Grimoire relic]]) to keep Rex off them for a short duration, allowing them to focus more on Prime and Supreme. Prayers can be bypassed with sufficient prayer penetration, although the Kings' high defence stats mean that investing into accuracy nodes are recommended if hitting them with other combat styles.
Try to prioritise [[Protect from Magic]] if flicking cannot be maintained, as Rex and Supreme will generally be less accurate and the latter has a much lower max hit.
Players with tier 6 magic or melee mastery can alternatively ignore the unprotected King and focus on the King they are strongest to, though this will be slightly slower compared to killing them normally. Tier 6 range mastery will not have this issue and can simply focus on the unprotected King during the entire encounter.
Once enrage phase starts, it is important to keep moving to avoid getting hit by poison launched by the spinolyps. Likewise, the player should change target to the King they are strongest against, to end the phase quickly before the poison pools become too overwhelming.
==Drops== {{Main|Dagannoth_Prime#Drops}} {{Main|Dagannoth_Rex#Drops}} {{Main|Dagannoth_Supreme#Drops}} Dagannoth Kings (Echo) roll the same drops as regular Dagannoth Kings, in addition to a roll for one of their unique echo items. The player must deal at least 1 damage to each of the Kings in order to receive the full amount of loot (i.e. a drop from Rex, Prime, and Supreme), otherwise they will only receive a drop from the sole King targeted.
{{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=V's helm|quantity=1|rarity=1/25|gemw=No|raritynotes={{refn|group=d|In addition to having a 1/25 chance to drop, players will '''always''' receive V's helm on their 50th Dagannoth Kings (Echo) kill if they haven't received one yet.}}}} {{DropsTableBottom}}
==Past appearances== This boss has appeared in a previous [[temporary event]]: *[[Raging Echoes League]] ** The unique drops were the [[amulet of the monarchs]] and the [[emperor ring]]
==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 23 April 2026 |update = Leagues VI Changes |change = * Echo Dagannoth Rex's melee and ranged defence were reduced from 255 to 100. * Echo Dagannoth Prime's melee and magic defence were reduced from 255 to 100. * Echo Dagannoth Supreme's ranged defence was reduced from 550 to 150, and his magic defence was reduced from 255 to 100. }} {{Subject changes footer}}
==Gallery== <gallery> File:Dagannoth Prime (Echo).png|[[Dagannoth Prime (Echo)]] File:Dagannoth Rex (Echo).png|[[Dagannoth Rex (Echo)]] File:Dagannoth Supreme (Echo).png|[[Dagannoth Supreme (Echo)]] </gallery>
{{Demonic Pacts League}}

{{Infobox Item |name = Dagannoth bones |image = [[File:Dagannoth bones (blessed).png]] |release = [[20 March]] [[2024]] |update = Varlamore: Part One |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options = Break-down, Drop |examine = Bones blessed at an exposed altar. |value = 150 |weight = 1.500 |id = 29376 }} [[File:Dagannoth bones (blessed) detail.png|130px|left]] '''Blessed dagannoth bones''' are the blessed form of [[dagannoth bones]] obtained by using them on the [[exposed altar]] on the summit of [[Ralos' Rise]]. They are broken down with a [[chisel]] to obtain 100 [[blessed bone shards]] and 5 [[Crafting]] experience, which can then be sacrificed at the [[libation bowl]] at [[the Teomat]].
As each shard sacrificed gives 5 [[Prayer]] experience, each blessed bone gives 500 Prayer experience overall. If using a [[jug of blessed sunfire wine]] at the libation bowl instead of a regular [[jug of blessed wine]], this is increased to 6 Prayer experience per shard, or 600 Prayer experience per bone.
Players looking to bless bones in bulk may talk to [[Virilis]], found at the base of the exposed altar, to unnote any type of [[bones]] for a fee of 10 [[coins]] per bone.

{{External|rs=Dagannoth mother (Horror from the Deep)}} {{Otheruses|the quest boss fought during [[Horror from the Deep]]|the [[Nightmare Zone]] variant|Dagannoth mother (Nightmare Zone)}} {{Infobox Monster |name = Dagannoth mother |image = [[File:Dagannoth mother white.png|200px]] |release = [[17 November]] [[2004]] |update = Horror From The Deep |members = Yes |combat = 100 |size = 3 |examine = A horror from the ocean depths... |xpbonus = 5 |max hit = 9 ([[Melee]]), 12×2 ([[Ranged]]) |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Melee]], [[Ranged]] |attack speed = 4 |slayxp = 126 |cat = Dagannoth |assignedby = vannaka,chaeldar,konar,nieve,duradel |hitpoints = 120 |att = 78 |str = 78 |def = 81 |mage = 1 |range = 50 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 150 |dslash = 150 |dcrush = 150 |dmagic = 50 |dlight = 50 |dstandard = 50 |dheavy = 50 |elementalweaknesstype = Earth |elementalweaknesspercent = 35 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |id = 980,981,982,983,984,985,986,987,988 }} The '''Dagannoth mother''' is fought at the end of the quest [[Horror from the Deep]]. She cycles through different colours every 18 seconds to explicitly show her weaknesses. While fighting the Dagannoth Mother, it is possible to hide or [[safespot]] behind the nearby stalagmites. [[Protect from Missiles]] is advised as her Ranged attack is highly accurate. She can hit up to 9s with [[Melee]], and can hit double 12s with [[Ranged]]. [[Combat pure|Pures]] are advised to bring a [[ring of recoil]] and turn off [[auto-retaliate]] if not using melee. '''Note:''' The [[twinflame staff]] cannot be effectively used against her, as even when trying to cast other elemental spells, it will default to casting earth spells due to the Dagannoth mother's elemental weakness to earth. Once she is defeated, you will obtain a rusty casket. She can be fought in the [[Nightmare Zone]] after the quest is complete. Runes are provided in the arena. ==Weakness by colour== {|class="wikitable" !Image !Colour !Weakness !Attack Using |- |[[File:Dagannoth mother white.png|40px]] |White |[[Air spells]] |[[Wind Strike]], [[Wind Bolt|Bolt]], [[Wind Blast|Blast]], [[Wind Wave|Wave]], or [[Wind Surge|Surge]]. |- |[[File:Dagannoth mother blue.png|40px]] |Blue |[[Water spells]] |[[Water Strike]], [[Water Bolt|Bolt]], [[Water Blast|Blast]], [[Water Wave|Wave]], or [[Water Surge|Surge]]. |- |[[File:Dagannoth mother orange.png|40px]] |Orange |Melee |[[Melee]] attacks. |- |[[File:Dagannoth mother brown.png|40px]] |Brown |[[Earth spells]] |[[Earth Strike]], [[Earth Bolt|Bolt]], [[Earth Blast|Blast]], [[Earth Wave|Wave]], or [[Earth Surge|Surge]]. |- |[[File:Dagannoth mother red.png|40px]] |Red |[[Fire spells]] |[[Fire Strike]], [[Fire Bolt|Bolt]], [[Fire Blast|Blast]], [[Fire Wave|Wave]], or [[Fire Surge|Surge]]. |- |[[File:Dagannoth mother green.png|40px]] |Green |Ranged |[[Ranged]] attacks. |} ==Drops== ===100%=== {{DropsTableHead|leagueRegion=No}} {{DropsLine|name=Bones|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsLine|name=Rusty casket|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ==Dialogue== {{Hastranscript|npc}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 25 June 2025 |update = Summer Sweep Up: Combat |change = The Dagannoth mother now has a 35% elemental weakness to [[earth spells]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 31 July 2006 |update = Crossbows |change = The Dagannoth mother's orange form was recoloured. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Dagannoth mother (orange) (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Dagannoth mother orange.png|center|300x150px]] |- |17 November 2004 –

revision.text:
{{External|rs}} {{Otheruses|def=no|the robe set|Dagon'hai robes}} {{Infobox Organisation |name = Dagon'hai |release = [[27 March]] [[2007]] |update = What Lies Below |leader = [[Surok Magis]] |founded = [[Fifth Age]] or earlier }} The '''Dagon'hai''' are a secretive [[Zamorak]]ian organisation, situated in the [[Tunnel of Chaos]]. Before [[Defender of Varrock]], their leader [[Surok Magis]] can be found in [[Varrock]] in the [[Varrock Palace Library|palace library]]; he plays a pivotal role in the [[What Lies Below]] [[quest]].
A [[Dagon'hai history|history of their order]] can be found during and after the [[What Lies Below]] quest in the Varrock Palace Library.
==History== The Dagon'hai have existed at least since the early [[Fifth Age]]. During this time they were situated in Varrock. In those days, worship of Zamorak was not as much frowned upon, and the Dagon'hai had no trouble with the general population. However, the priests of [[Saradomin]] looked darkly upon them, and soon, a secret war was waged away from the eyes of the Varrock citizens. Priests of Saradomin were found dead in darkened streets, and Dagon'hai were put into cells and tormented.
The people of Varrock did nothing until the first [[Wizards' Tower]] was burned down. They turned against the Dagon'hai, and with both the people of Varrock and the priests of Saradomin against them, the Zamorakians were all but decimated. Their numbers shattered, they hid in the darkest houses of the most dimly lit streets of the city. The survivors delved deep into the most evil of arcane magic, with the intent of exacting retribution on the priests of Saradomin and the people of Varrock. Varrock may have fallen had they succeeded, but for a young guardsman who happened across the Elders of the Dagon'hai engaging in a sacrificial ritual. The guardsman sounded the alarm and the Dagon'hai, knowing they would be slaughtered, fled. The Elders stayed back to fight off pursuers and were slain. Those who fled went as far as a statue of Saradomin, where they disappeared under mysterious circumstances.
Currently the Dagon'hai live on, led by Surok Magis, but are in hiding. Three members can be found in the Tunnel of Chaos. According to one of them, Dakh'thoulan Aegis, there are other Dagon'hai hiding in similar tunnels elsewhere.
==Known members== [[File:Mishkal'un Dorn.png|right|120px]] *[[Surok Magis]] - the new leader of the Dagon'hai *[[Mishkal'un Dorn]] *[[Sil'as Dahcsnu]] *[[Dakh'thoulan Aegis]] *[[Elder Dag'eth]] *[[Elder Kree'nag]] *[[Elder La'nou]] *[[Sin'keth Magis]] *[[Dark Squall]] - Surok Magis in disguise *[[Mage of Zamorak (Ourania)|Mage of Zamorak]] (possibly)
==Trivia== *Surok Magis is the only member of the Dagon'hai whose name doesn't contain an apostrophe. *The name of the Dagon'hai is likely a reference to the H.P. Lovecraft short story Dagon, which makes mention of cultists worshiping evil beings that exist 'below' the water. This is itself a reference to the Mesopotamian deity of the same name.
{{Dagon'hai}} [[Category:Zamorakians]]

{{Infobox Location |name = Daimon's Crater |image = [[File:Daimon's Crater.png|300px]] |release = [[24 May]] [[2023]] |update = Bounty Hunter is Back! |aka = Bounty Hunter |members = Yes |floors = 1 |race = [[Humans]] |teleport = [[Bounty Hunter portal]], [[Ferox Enclave]] |music = {{*}} [[Map:Wilderness music|Wilderness tracks]]
{{*}} [[Wilderness (music track)|Wilderness]] (Classic mode) |map = {{Map|name=Daimon's Crater|x=3426|y=4064|zoom=1}} |type = settlement |leagueRegion = No }} '''Daimon's Crater''' is the location of the [[Bounty Hunter]] minigame and is only accessible on [[Server|worlds]] 318 (UK), 319 (US West), or 569 (AUS). To get to the crater, players must use the [[Bounty Hunter portal]] in the [[Ferox Enclave]]. ==History== Daimon's Crater is a large volcanic island that was once home to a group of demons. The demons had set up a fortress inside the dormant volcano at the centre of the island to mine rare minerals, but their activity reactivated the volcano, resulting in their demise. Years later, humans settled in the ruins of the island; believing themselves to be descendants of the demons, they began to hunt each other for fun. Currently, the crater is host to a battle arena where warriors from across the world come to battle other skilled opponents. ==Areas== The crater is split into 3 distinct sections, split up by pools of lava, with Fort Daimon sitting as a safezone in the center. Each section contains demonic sigils scattered across them that serve as potential spawn points when entering the PVP sections of the crater. [[File:Frozen Temple.png|thumb|width=350x350|The frozen temple, one of the locations on the crater.]] ===Frozen Temple=== The Frozen Temple can be found to the north. It is the smallest of the 3 areas, with the temple itself surrounded by gravestones and warriors who have been frozen solid. To the north-east of the temple, a [[Olaf's boat|shipwrecked boat]] can be found. ===Huntsman's Wood=== The Huntsman's Wood can be found to the west, filled with unhealthy-looking trees. A cave entrance can be seen, but can't be interacted with. To the far west of the wood lies a gate with catapults on top, and a watchtower nearby. On the other side of the gate, multiple Fremennik boats can be seen having ran aground. Basalt rocks can be found in the south-western part of the woods, lining up with the ones found near the [[Rogues' Castle]] on the mainland. ===Tower of Bounty=== The Tower of Bounty can be found to the east. The area is charred and filled with lava pools, with the tower itself being surrounded by a moat of lava. Inside the tower, a throne can be found. ==Features== * [[Poll booth]] * [[Loot chest]] * [[Coffer (Bounty Hunter)]] * [[Pool of Refreshment]] that also restores [[Special attacks|special attack]] energy === Bank chests === There are two [[bank chest]]s in the crater, which players can use to re-gear and replenish food, as well as bank their loot. Due to the requirement that players be on a Bounty Hunter world to access them, as well as the location requiring players to teleport through the Ferox Enclave, players that are simply looking for a quick bank chest are recommended to instead use the chest south of the [[Pool of Refreshment|pools of refreshment]] in the Enclave. ==Personalities== * [[Emblem_Trader#Daimon's_Crater|Emblem Trader]] * [[Corrupted Warrior (Bounty Hunter)|Corrupted Warrior]] ==Trivia== *The humans who settled in Daimon's Crater may have been [[Fremennik]], as multiple Fremennik boats can be seen washed ashore on the west of the island, as well as a ruined boat which is located at the northern tip of the island. *The bank chests in the crater are currently the northern-most bank chests in [[Gielinor]]. {{Bounty Hunter}}

{{Infobox NPC |name = Dallas Jones |image = [[File:Dallas Jones.png|120px]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2018]] |update = Dragon Slayer II |members = Yes |race = [[Human]] |quest = [[Dragon Slayer II]] |location = [[Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers]] |gender = Male |options = Talk-to |examine = A researcher from the Varrock Museum. |map = {{Map|name=Dallas Jones|x=2920|y=3145|r=3|mtype=square}} |id = 8100,8101,8102,8103,8104 |leagueRegion = Karamja }} [[File:Dallas Jones chathead.png|left]] '''Dallas Jones''' is a researcher from [[Varrock]], whose area of expertise lies in [[Dragon (race)|dragons]]. He chose this area of expertise because his father used to live on [[Crandor]], before its destruction, and his death left him with great interest in dragons. He has spent the last fifteen years trying to learn more about the dragon race.
During [[Dragon Slayer II]], he investigates the destruction of [[Crandor]]. He is located in the [[Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers]] pub on [[Musa Point]], where he will give the player a brief summary of [[Dragon Slayer I]]. After spoken to, he will appear in [[Elvarg]]'s den underneath [[Crandor]].
He is ultimately killed by [[Galvek]] immediately after [[Zorgoth]] awakens the dragon.
==Dialogue== {{hastranscript|speaksin}}
==Trivia== * His name is a reference to the movie franchise and its eponymous protagonist, {{WP|Indiana Jones}}. **It is currently unknown if he is related in any way to [[Anna Jones|Louisiana 'Anna' Jones]], another researcher with an Indiana Jones-themed name. *Dallas's line, "Just think once before you speak please.", is in reference to a popular humorous screenshot of a player responding verbatim to an inappropriate comment made by another player.
{{Dragon Slayer II}} [[Category:Deceased characters]]
